text.title: 邪能图腾之陨
text.objectives: 击败图加·鲜血图腾。与军事顾问维多利亚谈一谈，她可以把你传送到纳瓦罗格那里开始战斗。
text.description: 我们在至高岭的联络人纳瓦罗格报告说，图加·鲜血图腾终于再度现身了。$b$b他给我寄来了一个传讯水晶，以及相关的说明。$b$b我可以把你传送到纳瓦罗格那里，他会带你去图加那里。但是有个问题。$b$b纳瓦罗格需要额外的魔法能量来抵御图加的邪能魔法。你去之前得准备点虚空碎片。
text.completion: Thunder Totem and countless lives are saved. One more crisis down in this war against the Legion.

english.title: Feltotem's Fall
english.objectives: Defeat Tugar Bloodtotem. Speak with War Councilor Victoria, she will teleport you to Navarrogg to begin.
english.description: Our Highmountain contact, Navarrogg, reports that Tugar Bloodtotem has finally resurfaced.$b$bHe's sent a message crystal along with some instructions for me.$b$bI can teleport you to Navarrogg and he will take you to Tugar's location, but there is one problem.$b$bNavarrogg requires additional magical power to fend off Tugar's fel magicks. You will need some Nethershards before you go.
english.completion: Thunder Totem and countless lives are saved. One more crisis down in this war against the Legion.

text.title: 雁过留痕
text.objectives: 垂降到洞窟里，然后遵循苔丝的指示。
text.description: 你准备好了吗，$ct？我会引导你一步步完成这个计划的。所以你绝对安全！首先，看到我身后的垂降点了吗？你得从那里进入洞穴。祝你好运！
text.completion: That couldn't have gone better if I had done it myself. Good work, Shadowblade.

english.title: This Time, Leave a Trail
english.objectives: Rappel down into the cave, then follow Tess's instructions.
english.description: Are you ready, $ct? I will walk you through every step of the plan. You'll be perfectly safe! First thing's first: You see that rappel point behind me? That's your way down into the cave. Good luck!
english.completion: That couldn't have gone better if I had done it myself. Good work, Shadowblade.

objectiveDetails.description: 拾取灌注邪能的火药箱

text.title: 雁过留痕
text.objectives: 垂降到洞窟里，然后遵循莉莉安的指示。
text.description: 不用紧张，$ct。如果真有人能完成这个任务，那一定是你！……大概吧。使用我身后的垂降点，进入洞窟吧。$b$b什么？别摆出那副表情。你进入洞窟后，我再给你进一步的指示。
text.completion: That couldn't have gone better if I had done it myself. Good work, Shadowblade.

english.title: This Time, Leave a Trail
english.objectives: Rappel down into the cave, then follow Lilian's instructions.
english.description: Here goes nothing, $ct. If anybody can pull this off, you can! ...Probably. Just use the rappel point behind me to get into the cave.$b$bWhat? Don't make that face. I'll give you more instructions once you're in the cave.
english.completion: Even I couldn't have done better myself. Great job, |3-6($ct).

objectiveDetails.description: 拾取灌注邪能的火药箱

text.title: 不听话的仆人
text.objectives: 在达拉然的5个人身上测试阿卡扎曼扎拉克的仆人。
text.description: 我喜欢跟你合作，$n。要不要继续一起发财？大法师卡德加花了大把的时间派遣仆从去执行天知道是什么的任务。像我俩这么有生意头脑的人，说不定能想出更廉价的替代方法呢？$b$b<阿卡扎曼扎拉克递给你一块小水晶。>$b$b这个小坏蛋能用稀薄的空气——以及你之前收集的奥法之尘制造一个仆从。$b$b你何不带着她去城里试试呢？亲眼看看她的效果吧！
text.completion: You make a pretty good business partner, bud! I'll see what I can do to get ol' Khadgar on board with these new servants. $B$BI tell ya I'm gonna make a fortune!$B$BOh, don't think I forgot you. I've got somethin' special in mind for ya!

english.title: Servant to No One
english.objectives: Test Akazamzarak's Servants on 5 people in Dalaran.
english.description: I like workin' with ya, $n. How's about we keep this gold train a-rollin'?$B$BArchmage Khadgar spends an inordinate amount of time sending his servants off to do who knows what. What if an enterprising duo such as ourselves found a cheaper alternative?$B$B<Akazamzarak hands you a small crystal.>$B$BThis bad boy will form a servant right out of thin air - and a few pounds of the dust you swept up.$B$BWhy not take it into town and try her out? See for yourself!
english.completion: You make a pretty good business partner, bud! I'll see what I can do to get ol' Khadgar on board with these new servants. $B$BI tell ya I'm gonna make a fortune!$B$BOh, don't think I forgot you. I've got somethin' special in mind for ya!

text.title: Avocation of Antonidas
text.objectives: Recover the three discs of Antonidas' unfinished project and return them to Kalec in your order hall. Speak to Archmage John Nicholas in Northrend, at the Purple Parlor about the Tri-Disc of the Arcane. Speak with Khadgar about the Tri-Disc of Fire. And speak with Archmage Cedric near the Dalaran Crater about the Tri-Disc of Frost.
text.description: Archmage, I've found something you may be interested in. An old journal of the late Archmage, Antonidas. In it, he speaks of a project he was working on that I think we may be able to finish.$b$bIt was a sort of flying disc that could attune itself to the rider's magical attunement.$b$bBut I need your help tracking down the pieces. From what I could gather, he gave them to trusted friends and allies through the years. Perhaps you could persuade them to give us the pieces.

english.title: Avocation of Antonidas
english.objectives: Recover the three discs of Antonidas' unfinished project and return them to Kalec in your order hall. Speak to Archmage John Nicholas in Northrend, at the Purple Parlor about the Tri-Disc of the Arcane. Speak with Khadgar about the Tri-Disc of Fire. And speak with Archmage Cedric near the Dalaran Crater about the Tri-Disc of Frost.
english.description: Archmage, I've found something you may be interested in. An old journal of the late Archmage, Antonidas. In it, he speaks of a project he was working on that I think we may be able to finish.$b$bIt was a sort of flying disc that could attune itself to the rider's magical attunement.$b$bBut I need your help tracking down the pieces. From what I could gather, he gave them to trusted friends and allies through the years. Perhaps you could persuade them to give us the pieces.

text.title: 下落不明：伊崔格
text.objectives: 找到伊崔格。
text.description:
你认识伊崔格吗？他是个很有名望的兽人战士，带领着我们的部队对抗附近的邪怒纳迦。

不幸的是，纳迦在最近的一次冲突中抓走了我们的许多士兵。伊崔格前去追赶，却没有返回。我担心他出了什么事。

请你找到他！
text.completion: The filthy naga ambushed me. I will not fail again.

english.title: Missing in Action: Eitrigg
english.objectives: Find Eitrigg.
english.description:
Are you familiar with Eitrigg? He is the worthy orc warrior who was leading our forces against the Felrage naga nearby.

Unfortunately the naga captured many of our soldiers during a recent skirmish. Eitrigg went after them and has not returned. I fear something terrible has happened to him.

Please try to find him!
english.completion: The filthy naga ambushed me. I will not fail again.

text.title: 邪怒行动
text.objectives: 消灭督军卡兹亚塔和邪须。
text.description:
我不喜欢看到纳迦与燃烧军团结盟。这可是新情况，不能忽视。

纳迦督军卡兹亚塔和他的走狗，海巨人邪须都得为邪怒纳迦袭击我们部队的事负责。

我们必须给他们一个教训，让他们知道跟恶魔勾结是不会有好下场的！
text.completion: With their leaders defeated, the Felrage naga will not be preying on our warriors again. Still, we should keep an eye on them in the future.

english.title: Operation Felrage
english.objectives: Kill Warlord Kaz'jatar and Felbeard.
english.description:
I do not like to see naga aligned with the Burning Legion. That is something new and cannot be ignored.

The naga warlord, Kaz'jatar, and his skrog toady, Felbeard, are responsible for the Felrage's attacks on our forces.

We must teach them that it does not pay to consort with demons!
english.completion: With their leaders defeated, the Felrage naga will not be preying on our warriors again. Still, we should keep an eye on them in the future.

text.title: 随叫随到
text.objectives: 吹响海拉之角，指引克瓦迪尔摧毁三个军团传送门。
text.description:
你在冥狱深渊强化了海拉之角，现在，使用它的时机到了。我找到了三个需要清除的军团传送门。

去邪怒海滩寻找维库人的船骸吧。然后召唤克瓦迪尔，让他们做自己最擅长的事情：破坏！
text.progress: Did the Qualds respond to your call, $n?
text.completion: Well done, $n. The kvaldir will be useful tools in the battles to come.

english.title: Kvaldir on Call
english.objectives: Blow Helya's Horn and direct the kvaldir to destroy the three Legion portals.
english.description:
You empowered Helya's Horn in Helheim, and now is the time to use it. I have located three Legion portals we should eliminate. 

Seek out the vrykul shipwreck on Felrage Strand. Call the kvaldir and have them do what they do best: destroy!
english.progress: Did the Qualds respond to your call, $n?
english.completion: Well done, $n. The kvaldir will be useful tools in the battles to come.

objectiveDetails.description: 摧毁第三个军团传送门
摧毁第二个军团传送门
摧毁第一个军团传送门

text.title: 噢，多罗莉亚，我亲爱的多罗莉亚
text.objectives: 在达拉然的魔术旅馆寻找多罗莉亚。
text.description:
喂！我们真是闪亮的探险二人组，对吧？

找回了我的财产后，我们又出现了一条崭新的道路。我跋山涉水来到这里，并不只是为了挫败恶魔的入侵，不！我来这里是为了寻找我亲爱的、挚爱的多罗莉亚。在屠龙的间隙，我也需要休息。就在休息时，我做了一个梦，不，是个预兆。它告诉我，多罗莉亚被绑架到了一座飘浮在空中的城市！

那一定是达拉然。快，侍从，骑上坐骑，到达拉然最著名的旅店来见我。动作要快！
text.completion: Blast, I didn't think he would find me again so fast.

english.title: Oh Doloria, My Sweet Doloria
english.objectives: Seek out Doloria in the Legerdermain Lounge in Dalaran.
english.description:
What ho! We are quite the dashing pair of adventurers, aren't we?

Now that we have secured my belongings, a new path unfolds before us. I did not journey here simply to thwart the demon invasion, no! I came here in search of my beloved, my loved, Doloria. Whilst resting between slaying of dragons, I had a dream, nay, a vision. It told me Doloria had been kidnapped and taken to a floating city in the sky!

It must be Dalaran. Quickly squire! Mount up and meet me at Dalaran's famous inn. Make haste!
english.completion: Blast, I didn't think he would find me again so fast.

text.title: 白费心机
text.objectives: 消灭“山匪”，找到多罗莉亚被盗的“珠宝”，并将她“赎回”。
text.description:
哦对，没错，我，呃，被关在这里，当然是，呃，不得已的，随便了。

听着，伙计，你可别说出去啊，老麦克斯跟我是绝对没可能的，但是他的心地确实很善良。我一直都想躲开他，可他总能找到我！我只是不忍心把真相告诉他而已。

我有主意了，你不如去为我干掉几个那种非常魁梧、有两个脑袋的“山匪”。这么说好了，他们偷了我的一些珠宝，你可以用珠宝来为我赎身。

慢慢来，别受伤了。起码别重伤了。
text.progress: Kill "Hill Bandits" to find Dolorias stolen "Jewelry" and buy her "release"
text.completion: <Doloria gives you a sly wink from behind her mask>$B$BUh, no, haven't seen her for a few days, not sure who you're talking about.

english.title: A Fool's Errand
english.objectives: Kill "Hill Bandits" to find Doloria's stolen "Jewelry" and buy her "release".
english.description:
Oh yea sure, I'm, um, held here against my, you know, will, or something.

Look bud, between you and me old Max here has no chance, but his heart is in the right place. I keep trying to run away and hide but he keeps finding me! I just don't have it in me to upset him with the truth.

I've got an idea. Why don't you go kill some of those really big two headed "Hill Bandits" for me. Let's say they stole some jewelery from me, and you can use it to buy my freedom.

Take your time, don't get hurt. Much.
english.progress: Kill "Hill Bandits" to find Dolorias stolen "Jewelry" and buy her "release"
english.completion: <Doloria gives you a sly wink from behind her mask>$B$BUh, no, haven't seen her for a few days, not sure who you're talking about.

text.title: 任务：搜索行动
text.objectives: 救出8队被俘的战士。
text.description:
我一定要让这些纳迦为他们的暴行付出代价。

他们和他们的海巨人走狗趁我们与燃烧军团作战的时候抓走了我们的战士。这群不知廉耻的家伙！

我们必须救出那些士兵，不能让他们被当作奴隶卖掉，或者更惨……
text.completion: Our soliders will be back in action soon, and the Felrage naga will think twice before messing with us again!

english.title: Mission: Search and Rescue
english.objectives: Rescue 8 squads of Captured Warriors.
english.description:
I will make these naga pay for their audacity. 

They and their skrog lackeys captured our warriors while we were fighting the Legion. They have no honor!

We must rescue our fallen soldiers before they are sold as slaves, or worse...
english.completion: Our soliders will be back in action soon, and the Felrage naga will think twice before messing with us again!

text.title: 下落不明：达利乌斯·克罗雷领主
text.objectives: 搜寻达利乌斯·克罗雷领主。
text.description:
你认识达利乌斯·克罗雷领主吗？他是个很有名望的吉尔尼斯战士，带领着我们的部队对抗附近的邪怒纳迦。

不幸的是，纳迦在最近的一次冲突中抓走了我们的许多士兵。达利乌斯前去追赶，却没有返回。我担心他出了什么事。

请你找到他！
text.completion: Thanks. I was ambushed by a dozen naga and skrog! At least I took quite a few down before they overwhelmed me...

english.title: Missing in Action: Lord Darius Crowley
english.objectives: Search for Lord Darius Crowley.
english.description:
Are you familiar with Lord Darius Crowley? He is the worthy Gilnean warrior who was leading our forces against the Felrage naga nearby. 

Unfortunately the naga captured many of our soldiers during a recent skirmish. Lord Darius went after them and has not returned. I fear something terrible has happened to him.

Please try to find him!
english.completion: Thanks. I was ambushed by a dozen naga and skrog! At least I took quite a few down before they overwhelmed me...

The naga warlord, Kaz'jatar, and his skrog toady, Felbeard, are responsible for the Felrage's attacks on our forces.

english.completion: With their leaders defeated, the Felrage naga won't be launching any more raids for awhile! Still, we should keep an eye on them in the future.

text.title: “卑微的”请求
text.objectives: 去风暴之眼瞭望台与你的访客见面。
text.description: $ct，外面来了位……客人。她想进来，但在没有得到允许前，卫兵是不会让她通过的。$b$b请尽快到瞭望台去见见她吧。
text.completion: You're in charge here?

english.title: A "Humble" Request
english.objectives: Meet your visitor at Storm's Eye Overlook.
english.description: $ct, we've received a... visitor. She orders entry, but the guards will not let her pass without approval.$b$bPlease head up to the overlook as soon as you are able.
english.completion: Ты здесь $gглавный:главная;?

objectiveDetails.description: Return 5 Silithyst to the Horde collector

text.title: 万千之力
text.objectives: 使用玛加萨的传送门，前往千针石林与她见面。
text.description: 我知道我在这里不受欢迎，我和我的恐怖图腾也没有得到邀请加入你和你萨满的行列。但我来找你是有所求的。$b$b军团正在袭击我的家园。我丢失了一些对我来说……非常珍贵的物品，而且我找不到其他帮手了。我很不愿意向你求助，但我只能这么做。如果你肯帮忙，我愿意让我的人民帮你对抗燃烧军团。
text.completion: Let's not keep my tribe waiting.

english.title: The Power of Thousands
english.objectives: Take Magatha's portal and meet her in Thousand Needles.
english.description: I know I am not well liked here, and my Grimtotem and I were not invited to join you and your shaman here. However, I come to you with a proposition.$b$bThe Legion is attacking my home. I've lost possession of some things that are... dear to me, and I have nowhere else to turn to. It pains me to ask... but I request your aid. If you help, I offer my people in service against the Legion.
english.completion: Не будем заставлять мое племя ждать.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用前往千针石林的传送门

text.title: 巫婆之怒
text.objectives: 在黑云峰击败$1oa个恶魔。
text.description: 这些恶魔闯入我的家，抢走我的东西，还掳走了我的人民？我要让他们见识见识我的怒火。消灭他们，孩子。相信你这点本事还是有的。
text.completion: Fel blood has never been sweeter.

english.title: The Crone's Wrath
english.objectives: Defeat $1oa demons on Darkcloud Pinnacle.
english.description: These demons come into my home, take my things, and capture my people? They will see my wrath. Destroy them, child. Surely you are capable of at least that.
english.completion: Никогда еще оскверненная кровь не была так сладка.

text.title: 蛇与石
text.objectives: 在黑云峰找到末日石或者阿利卡拉。
text.description: 恶魔进攻时，抢走了我的两件宝物：我的伙伴阿利卡拉和末日石。$b$b虽然死亡对阿利卡拉不算什么，可军团对他一定有什么阴谋。而末日石……这么强大的神器应该属于我，而不是军团。我们必须分头去找他们。$b$b看在这个世界的份上，你一定要小心。我可不想看到你笨手笨脚地毁灭了世界。
text.progress: Greetings, Farseer. What have you found?
text.completion: I reclaimed Arikara. Did you find the Doomstone?

english.title: Snakes and Stones
english.objectives: Find either the Doomstone or Arikara on Darkcloud Pinnacle.
english.description: When the demons attack, they captured two very powerful possessions of mine: my companion Arikara and the Doomstone.$b$bWhile death matters not to Arikara, the Legion surely has ulterior plans for him. And the Doomstone... such an artifact of power belongs in my hands, not theirs. We must split up to find them.$b$bFor the world's sake, do be careful. I don't need you clumsily destroying everything.
english.progress: Greetings, Farseer. What have you found?
english.completion: Arikara came back to me. What about the Stone of Rock? You have found it; him?

text.title: 打破锁链
text.objectives: 从牢笼中释放$1oa个被俘的恐怖图腾成员。
text.description: 燃烧军团别想愚弄恐怖图腾。救出我的人民，我们会在今后的战斗中报答你的。
text.completion: The Legion cannot break the Grimtotem.

english.title: Breaking Chains
english.objectives: Free $1oa Captured Grimtotem from Prison Cages.
english.description: The Legion shall not make fools of the Grimtotem. Free my people, and we will grace you with our aid in the coming battle.
english.completion: Легиону не сломить племя Зловещего Тотема.

objectiveDetails.description: 释放被俘的恐怖图腾成员

text.title: 被污染的沼泽
text.objectives: 从盲眼沼泽的灵魂身上抽取邪能。
text.description: 我还没去村子里侦察过，但是南面正在进行更危险的实验。他们在用更多邪能魔法污染沼泽中不安的灵魂！$b$b我会调整这个邪能图腾，好让它抽出他们灌注进那些灵魂里的邪能。$b$b请尽量治疗那些灵魂，这样甚至还可能为他们带来安宁。$b$b如果你愿意的话，我还可以把你送过去！
text.completion: You've done those souls a great favor. I hope they find peace.$B$BLet's cut off these experiments at the source now.

english.title: The Tainted Marsh
english.objectives: Drain the fel energies from the spirits of the Blind Marshlands.
english.description: I wasn't able to scout inside the village yet, however, there are more dangerous experiments going on to the south. They were befouling the unquiet spirits in the marshlands with more fel magic!$b$bI will rework this fel totem to draw out the fel energies they infused in those spirits.$b$bPlease, cure what spirits you can, perhaps it will even give them some peace.$b$bIf you want, I can even send you there!
english.completion: Ты $gоказал:оказала; несчастным душам огромную услугу. Надеюсь, они обретут покой.$b$bА теперь давай разберемся с организаторами этих кошмарных экспериментов.

text.title: 联合势力
text.objectives: 在达拉然与大法师卡德加交谈。
text.description: 破碎群岛上遍布着各种各样的势力。如果我们想要有机会战胜燃烧军团，就必须将他们联合起来。向他们证明你的价值，然后向我汇报。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. We still have a long road ahead of us to rid this world of the Legion, but this brings us one step closer.

english.title: Uniting the Isles
english.objectives: Speak to Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran
english.description: There are a great number of factions here on the Broken Isles. We must unite them if we want to stand a chance against the Legion. Prove your worth to them and report back to me.
english.completion: Превосходно, $n. Нам все еще предстоит немало сделать для того, чтобы изгнать Легион из этого мира, но теперь мы на шаг ближе к цели.

text.title: 恶魔干扰
text.objectives: 跟预言者努波顿谈一谈，前往破碎海滩，然后在邪能要塞与塞拉赞恩会面。
text.description: 我们在破碎海滩侦察时，发现了一件令人不安的事。$b$b军团正企图驾驭艾泽拉斯的元素之力。而且，他们就快成功了。$b$b我们得不惜一切代阻止他们。我可以打开一道传送门，送你去邪能要塞见塞拉赞恩。她会告诉你详细情况的。
text.completion: The Legion is forcing Azeroth to bend to its will. We cannot allow this any longer!

english.title: Demonic Disruption
english.objectives: Speak to Farseer Nobundo to go to the Broken Shore, then meet Therazane at the Garrison of the Fel.
english.description: While scouting on the Broken Shore, we have stumbled upon something quite unsettling.$b$bThe Legion is attempting to harness the powers of Azeroth's elements. What is more, they are succeeding.$b$bWe must stop them at all costs. I can open a portal for you to meet Therazane at the Garrison of the Fel. She will update you on the situation.
english.completion: Легион хочет поставить Азерот на колени. Мы не должны этого допустить!

objectiveDetails.description: 与预言者努波顿交谈，进行传送

text.title: 恢复平衡
text.objectives: 收集3个稳定水晶。
text.description:
考瓦斯发来了一份邪能之槌号的状况报告。它遭到了重创，而且比以前更丑了，虽然它早就丑得不能再丑了……

它的船身也开始侧倾了——要我说的话，还挺好笑的。但是不知道为什么，考瓦斯一点都不这么觉得。

总之，萨格拉斯之墓周围有她修理舰船所需的稳定水晶。

只要你一声令下，我就会派一队伊利达雷蝙蝠骑手跟你一起去。我本来也想去的，但是……
text.progress: Have you secured the materialss for repairing the Fel Hammer, $n?
text.completion: It'ss a shame the batriderss didn't make it. Even more reason to blast the hell out of the Legion as soon as the Fel Hammer'ss weaponss core iss operational again.

english.title: Restoring Equilibrium
english.objectives: Obtain 3 Stabilizing Crystals.
english.description:
Kor'vass sent a report on the status of the Fel Hammer. It suffered major damage, and is now even uglier than before if that'ss even possible...

It hass also begun listing to one side - rather comically, I might add. For some reason, Kor'vass doesn't find this nearly as entertaining as she should.

Anyway, there are stabilizer crystalss around the Tomb of Sargerass she could use for repairss.

Say the word and I will direct a squadron of illidari batriderss to accompany you. I'd come too, but...
english.progress: Тебе удалос-сь раздобыть материалы для ремонта "Молота С-скверны", $n?
english.completion: It's a pity about the dead riders on the slopes. But we're standing up for them! As soon as the core of the S-square Hammer is repaired, we will bring down its power on the Legion.

text.title: 兄弟姐妹
text.objectives: 在邪能要塞治疗$1oa个受伤的萨满。
text.description: 在你赶到之前，你的人一直在努力抵抗军团。但血肉之躯太过孱弱，他们已经伤痕累累了。没有你的帮助，他们肯定会死在恶魔手上的。快去帮助他们吧。
text.completion: I provided cover as the weaker of your people retreated. They will return to the Maelstrom safely.

english.title: Brothers and Sisters
english.objectives: Heal $1oa Injured Shaman  in Garrison of the Fel.
english.description: Your people were trying to stop the Legion before you arrived, but flesh is weak and they accumulated too many wounds. Without your aid, they will surely perish at the hands of the demons. Go, help them.
english.completion: Те из твоих союзников, что оказались слабее, получили мою защиту. Они смогут спокойно вернуться к Водовороту.

text.title: 元素核心
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个火焰能量核心，$2oa个流水能量核心，$3oa个土地能量核心和$4oa个大气能量核心。
text.description: 这里的艾瑞达正在滥用艾泽拉斯所有元素的力量，使用邪能魔法强迫元素屈从于他们的意志。他们之所以能够成功，是因为军团开发出了对应各种元素的奇怪能量核心。$b$b不能再让军团继续伤害我们的世界了。把他们干掉，取回他们的能量源。
text.progress: Nobody should force the elements to bend to their will. Show the Legion that their understanding is flawed.
text.completion: It seems the Doomstone is pulsating with energy.

english.title: Elemental Cores
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Fire Power Cores, $2oa Water Power Cores, $3oa Earth Power Cores, and $4oa Air Power Cores.
english.description: The eredar here are abusing the power of all of Azeroth's elements, forcing them to their command using their fel magics. They succeed to do this through curiosities the Legion has developed, cores of power that correspond to each element.$b$bDo not allow the Legion to continue abusing our world. Kill them and take the sources of their power.
english.progress: Nobody should force the elements to bend to their will. Show the Legion that their understanding is flawed.
english.completion: Камень Рока пульсирует от наполняющей его энергии.

text.title: 洪荒烈火
text.objectives: 消灭斩焰者巴拉斯塔加斯。
text.description: 那头怪物！山上有头自称“斩焰者”的恶魔，正在使用我的国度的力量。他从火焰之地抽取力量，把我们世界的火焰与他的世界的邪火混合在一起，所以你的萨满才会牺牲。$b$b他极其强大，先知。你一定要击败他，不管付出什么代价！
text.completion: Ah, you've awoken. I have heard tale of what happened.

english.title: Conflagration
english.objectives: Kill Barastagax the Flameripper.
english.description: That fiend! Up on the hill, a demon who calls himself "The Flameripper" is using the power of my realm. Your shaman die as he draws power from the Firelands, mixing the fire of our world with the unholy flame of his.$b$bHe is extremely powerful, Farseer. You must take him down, whatever the cost!
english.completion: О, ты $gпришел:пришла; в себя. Мне рассказали, что случилось.

text.title: 阴影中的骚动
text.objectives: 与斯坦索姆的格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵见面。进入后，找到瑞文戴尔男爵和他坐骑的遗体，然后举行仪式，获取这个坐骑。
text.description: 我们必须同时用物质和非物质的方法来净化骑甲。物质方面，我们得前往斯坦索姆。$b$b在瘟疫爆发前，那里十分繁荣，而且盛产圣水，足以净化最黑暗的魔法。那里也许还有几箱没有用过的圣水，可以供我们使用。$b$b然后，我们只要把足够的神圣能量注入骑甲，它就能制伏瑞文戴尔的坐骑——影鬃了。$b$b你准备好了就去斯坦索姆的仆役之门吧。
text.completion: That was quite the encounter, wouldn't you say Highlord $n? Reminds me of my glory days.$B$BNevertheless we'll be keeping a more watchful eye on Stratholme from now on. But that's not important right now.$B$BWe should move on to the ceremony and have you claim your prize!

english.title: Stirring in the Shadows
english.objectives: Meetup with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stratholme. Once inside, locate the remains of Lord Rivendare and his mount and perform the ritual to claim it as your own.
english.description: We must now purify the barding by both material and immaterial means. For the material, we need to travel to Stratholme.$b$bWhen it thrived, before the plague, it produced holy water capable of cleansing even the darkest of magics. There still may be caches of it lying untouched there that we can use.$b$bThen it's just a matter of imbuing enough holy power into the barding to make sure it overcomes the will of Rivendare's mount, Shadowmane.$b$bTravel to the service gate of Stratholme when you're ready.
english.completion: Нешуточная битва выдалась, $n, правда? Прямо как в мои молодые годы.$b$bПожалуй, нам теперь нужно будет повнимательнее присматривать за Стратхольмом. Впрочем, сейчас это неважно.$b$bДавай уже приступим к церемонии и вручим тебе заслуженный трофей!

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“阴影中的骚动”场景战役

text.title: 命由天定
text.objectives: 将药酒交给金刚不坏彭戍。
text.description:
多亏了你的迅速反应，我们的教派正在康复，大宗师。

现在，还有一名武僧需要我们的救治，但愿还不算迟！
text.completion: Grandmaster $n, these old bones grow weary. Our future depends on you to continue the fight against the Legion.$B$BSo long as you remain a beacon of light in the darkness, hope remains!

english.title: A Time for Everything
english.objectives: Give the Curative Brew to Iron-Body Ponshu.
english.description:
Our order is recovering thanks to your quick actions, Grandmaster. 

There is just one more monk we need to attend to before it is too late!
english.completion: Я уже стар, великий мастер $n. Теперь исход нашей войны против Легиона зависит только от тебя.$b$bНо пока ты несешь свет, рассеивающий тьму, надежда будет жить!

text.title: 7.2 Class Hall - Maximillian of Northshire - Aqcuisition - Track Mail Sent

english.title: 7.2 Class Hall - Maximillian of Northshire - Aqcuisition - Track Mail Sent

text.title: 甲虫的召唤
text.objectives: 前往希利苏斯向督军格尔库克报到。
text.description: 甲虫的召唤活动今天开始了。去安其拉之门跟你的阵营领袖谈一谈吧。
text.completion: And who are you? $n?$B$BAhh... yes, I believe I've heard mention of you before. Welcome to Silithus, $n.$B$BToday, we celebrate our heritage as sons of Kalimdor. Furthermore, we prove that the Horde will always grind those puny Alliance into the ground.$B$BAre you with me?

english.title: Call of the Scarab
english.objectives: Report to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
english.description: The Call of the Scarab event is occurring today. Speak with your faction's leader near the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.
english.completion: And who are you? $n?$B$BAhh... yes, I believe I've heard mention of you before. Welcome to Silithus, $n.$B$BToday, we celebrate our heritage as sons of Kalimdor. Furthermore, we prove that the Horde will always grind those puny Alliance into the ground.$B$BAre you with me?

text.title: 甲虫的召唤
text.objectives: 前往希利苏斯向大元帅斯诺·落雪报到。
text.description: 甲虫的召唤活动今天开始了。去安其拉之门跟你的阵营领袖谈一谈吧。
text.completion: And who are you? $n?$B$BAhh... yes, I believe I've heard mention of you before. Welcome to Silithus, $n.$B$BToday, we celebrate the fabled war history of Kalimdor. Furthermore, we prove that the Alliance will always show the Horde their inferiority.$B$BAre you with me?

english.title: Call of the Scarab
english.objectives: Report to Field Marshal Snowfall in Silithus.
english.description: The Call of the Scarab event is occurring today. Speak with your faction's leader near the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.
english.completion: And who are you? $n?$B$BAhh... yes, I believe I've heard mention of you before. Welcome to Silithus, $n.$B$BToday, we celebrate the fabled war history of Kalimdor. Furthermore, we prove that the Alliance will always show the Horde their inferiority.$B$BAre you with me?

text.title: 久等的代言人
text.objectives: 在虚空之光神殿与贝蒂尔德·深砧谈一谈。
text.description:
大祭司，我们得到消息说，有个非常奇怪的访客来到了虚空之光神殿：麦格尼·铜须，也就是代言人本人！

他来我们的教团有什么事呢？你最好快回虚空之光神殿去，前线这里有我们守着。
text.completion: Thank ye for coming so quickly, High $C. King Magni, or I suppose I should say 'The Speaker,' thinks he's found a hidden Titan vault!

english.title: The Speaker Awaits
english.objectives: Speak with Betild Deepanvil in Netherlight Temple.
english.description:
High Priest, we've received word from Netherlight Temple of a most curious visitor: Magni Bronzebeard, the very Speaker himself!

What could he want from our order? You'd best head back to Netherlight, we'll hold down the front here.
english.completion: Спасибо, что не $gзаставил:заставила; себя ждать, $gверховный жрец:верховная жрица;. Король Магни – или, точнее сказать, "Вестник" – полагает, что отыскал неизвестное хранилище титанов!

text.title: 水下宝库
text.objectives: 乘坐布莱恩在阿苏纳的船，前往水下宝库。
text.description:
你好，大祭司。代言人刚才告诉我们，地下深处艾泽拉斯的核心传来了一种呼唤。

那个声音告诉他，大漩涡附近有个失落的泰坦宝库。我们不知道里面有什么，但是他感觉与圣光有关，也和你有关！

布莱恩弄了艘船等你，就在阿苏纳的海岸边。当然，为了及时记录，我也会陪你一起去。我可不能白白浪费这样的大好机会！
text.completion: Tis our greatest honor ta present ye with this steed, High $C. An' thank ye for leading us, ye are truly blessed by the Light, an' so are all of us for havin' ye.
text.completed: 向虚空之光神殿的贝蒂尔德·深砧复命。

english.title: The Sunken Vault
english.objectives: Take Brann's vessel in Azsuna to the Sunken Vault.
english.description:
'Ello, High Priest. The Speaker has just been telling us of a calling of sorts, coming from deep in the core of Azeroth.

The voice is telling 'im there's a lost Titan vault out there, near the Maelstrom. We dun know what's inside, but he's got tha feelin' it's got somethin' ta do with the Light, and you!

Brann's got a vessel waitin' for ye, off the coast of Azsuna. Of course, I'll be accompanying ye as well, for cataloguing purposes. Can't go and let a chance like this go to waste!
english.completion: It is a great honor for me to present to you this sentinel, $ghigh priest:high priestess ;. And thank you for guiding us. Verily, the Light blessed you - and all of us - with the fact that you are with us.
english.completed: Return to Betild Deepanvil in Netherlight Temple.

objectiveDetails.description: 乘坐潜水艇前往水下宝库

text.title: 告知议会
text.objectives: 向恐痕裂隙的辛菲儿·疫誓复命。
text.description:
我来处理这个囚犯，你还是返回恐痕裂隙吧。

把我们的发现告诉其他人。我们需要他们的帮助，才能处理坎雷萨德的问题。
text.completion: Thank you for bringing me news of Jubeka. It could not have come at a better time.$B$BWe've received information on Kanrethad's whereabouts.

english.title: Informing the Council
english.objectives: Return to Shinfel Blightsworn in Dreadscar Rift.
english.description:
I'll deal with this prisoner, but you should head back to Dreadscar Rift. 

Let the others know what we've discovered. We will need their help dealing with Kanrethad on the Broken Shore.
english.completion: Thank you for bringing me news of Jubeka. It could not have come at a better time.$B$BWe've received information on Kanrethad's whereabouts.

text.title: 威慑力
text.objectives: 击退千光神殿中的军团的威胁，然后消灭传送门守护者维萨尔和佐塔顿。
text.description: 恶魔们好像正在操控神殿里的一股远古能量。他们已经用邪能魔法成功扭曲腐化了这片神圣的土地。$b$b在发动决战之前，我们一定要消灭这股恶魔势力。
text.completion: Our fight doesn't end here, $n.

english.title: Presence of Power
english.objectives: Repel the Legion threat from the Temple of a Thousand Lights, then Slay Portal-Keeper V'thaal and Zor'thaduun.
english.description: The demons appear to be harnessing an ancient power within the Temple itself. They've managed to twist and corrupt these sacred grounds with fel magic.$B$BWe must remove the demonic presence before we press our final advance.
english.completion: Наша битва не закончится здесь, $n.

objectiveDetails.description: 在神殿外与法罗迪斯王子见面

text.title: 摧毁巢穴
text.objectives: 进入邪能图腾洞穴，破坏图加的阴谋。
text.description: 我们必须阻止图加的阴谋。这些怪物必须死，产生它们的源头也一样！$b$b我想我知道它在哪儿。这附近原本住着一群中立的卓格巴尔，但恶魔和邪能牛头人却联手把他们赶走了。它肯定在那儿。$b$b到那里去，从源头上阻止他们制造邪能怪物吧！
text.completion: You have saved Thunder Totem and we owe you yet another debt.$B$BIt's a shame that Tugar wasn't there. As long as he lives, we are in danger.$B$BI will do everything I can to find him, and then we will finish this... together.

english.title: Destroying the Nest
english.objectives: Enter the Feltotem Caverns and ruin Tugar's plot.
english.description: We have to put an end to Tugar's plot. These abominations must be destroyed, as well as their source!$b$bI think I know where. A group of neutral drogbar had a settlement nearby, but were pushed out by concerted demon and fel tauren attacks. That must be the place.$b$bGo there and stop their fel monster production at its source!
english.completion: Ты $gспас:спасла; Громовой Тотем, и мы снова в долгу перед тобой.$b$bЖаль, конечно, что Тугара там не оказалось. Пока он жив, всем нам угрожает опасность.$b$bЯ сделаю все возможное, чтобы отыскать его, и когда найду, мы покончим с ним раз и навсегда... вместе.

text.title: 挑衅者瓦祖尔
text.objectives: 消灭挑衅者瓦祖尔。
text.description:
那上面有个讨厌的恶魔领主，他已经叫嚣了几小时了。

你可以去让他闭嘴吗？我的头都疼了！
text.completion: It'ss about time you shut that demon up. Thanksss...

english.title: War'zuul the Provoker
english.objectives: Kill War'zuul the Provoker.
english.description:
There'ss some obnoxious demon lord up there who's been yelling for hourss. 

Would you please shut him up already? I'm getting a terrible headache!
english.completion: Этому демону давно пора было заткнуть пас-с-сть. С-спасибо...

text.title: 迷离的时光之路
text.objectives: 完成5个时空漫游地下城。
text.description: 迷雾之星闪烁不定的光芒照耀着大地，令大地笼罩在一片诡异的迷雾中。这颗星星与迷雾在大地上投下深重的阴影，遮蔽了它的秘密和危险。在它的影响持续期间，新的道路将被打开，通往遥远的空间与时间。没有哪位贤者真正了解这一预兆的涵义，但英勇的行为总会得到幸运的眷顾。
text.completion: Ah, $n, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

english.title: A Shrouded Path Through Time
english.objectives: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
english.description: The shrouded star flickers upon the land with its intermittent light ushering in an eerie mist upon the land. This star and the mists bring deep shadows to the land hiding its secrets and dangers. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.
english.completion: Ah, $n, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

text.title: Avocation of Antonidas
text.objectives: Recover the three discs of Antonidas' unfinished project and return them to Kalec in your order hall. Speak to Archmage John Nicholas in Northrend, at the Purple Parlor about the Tri-Disc of the Arcane. Speak with Khadgar about the Tri-Disc of Fire. And speak with Archmage Cedric near the Dalaran Crater about the Tri-Disc of Frost.
text.description: Archmage, I've found something you may be interested in. An old journal of the late Archmage, Antonidas. In it, he speaks of a project he was working on that I think we may be able to finish.$b$bIt was a sort of flying disc that could attune itself to the rider's magical attunement.$b$bBut I need your help tracking down the pieces. From what I could gather, he gave them to trusted friends and allies through the years. Perhaps you could persuade them to give us the pieces.

objectiveDetails.description: Report to Ilthine Sunsong on the south side of the lake
Report to Theldurin the Lost on the east side of the lake
Report to Tu-Luak on the north side of the lake

text.title: 突袭瓦尔莎拉
text.objectives: 击退瓦尔莎拉的燃烧军团部队。
text.description: 军团在我们的土地上游荡。去找到他们的部队，消灭威胁，否则就迟了！
text.completion: We must continue our fight.

english.title: Assault on Val'sharah
english.objectives: Repel the Burning Legion forces throughout Val'sharah.
english.description: The Legion's moves across our lands. Find their forces and remove the threat before it is too late!
english.completion: Мы должны продолжать сражаться.

objectiveDetails.description: 到黑鸦堡垒与加洛德·影歌见面

text.title: 吾爱，汝在何方
text.objectives: 帮多罗莉亚维持她的“幻象”，并在旅馆里打听多罗莉亚的去向。
text.description: 真是命运弄人啊！我们拿到了珠宝，可以赎回我的挚爱，可她却失踪了！我们得问问这座豪华旅店中的客人。也许他们知道她遭受了什么样的不幸。
text.completion: Well, she has been taken, but we shall never rest. Join me as my Follower, lead my troops, perform missions for me! Together we will find her!

english.title: Where Art Thou, My Sweet
english.objectives: Help to maintain Doloria's "illusion" and ask around the Inn to see where Doloria disappeared to.
english.description: What poor fate! Here we are with the jewelry to buy my beloved's freedom, and she has disappeared! We must inquire of the patrons of this fine establishment. Perhaps they know what befell her.
english.completion: Well, she has been taken, but we shall never rest. Join me as my Follower, lead my troops, perform missions for me! Together we will find her!

text.title: 海盗湾
text.objectives: 前往阿苏纳的亡者海湾，与苔丝·格雷迈恩和特塞斯会面。
text.description: 我们在破碎海滩取得了一些进展，我觉得现在该让无冕者的精妙战术登场了。$b$b我们得到消息说，主岛屿外有个巨大的洞穴，一些强大的恶魔正聚集在那里，密谋毁灭我们。苔丝和特塞斯已经制定了一个计划，但是他们需要你帮忙才能成功。他们正在阿苏纳的亡者海湾等你。
text.completion: Straighten up, Shadowblade. We've got work to do.

english.title: The Pirate's Bay
english.objectives: Meet up with Tess Greymane and Tethys at Dead Man's Bay in Azsuna.
english.description: While we've made some progress on the Broken Shore, I think it is time for the more subtle tactics of the Uncrowned.$b$bWe've received word of a large cave off the main island, where powerful demons meet to plot our downfall. Tess and Tethys have formulated a plan, but they need your help to see it through.They are waiting for you at Dead Man's Bay in Azsuna.
english.completion: Straighten up, Shadowblade. We've got work to do.

text.title: 被偷走的灵魂
text.objectives: 释放15个被偷走的灵魂。
text.description:
奥丁选中的强者之魂被散落在永恒战场上的灵魂之泉囚禁了。他们原本注定会成为瓦拉加尔，可他们的光明未来却被偷走了。

现在，你可以让他们重新获得应有的地位。摧毁那些灵魂之泉，释放他们吧！
text.completion: With the Valarjar leading the vanguard, our offensives will be glorious!

english.title: Stolen Souls
english.objectives: Free 15 stolen souls.
english.description:
Odyn's worthy are held captive by soul fonts scattered around the Eternal Battlefield. They were destined to become Valarjar before their futures were stolen.

Now, you can restore them to their rightful places. Destroy the soul fonts to release them!
english.completion: With the Valarjar leading the vanguard, our offensives will be glorious!

text.title: 伪造的指令
text.objectives: 把伪造的指令放在指定的地方。
text.description: 一旦你击败派瑞克丝，消息就会像野火一样传遍本地，她的同伙肯定会立刻听到风声。我让特塞斯模仿她的笔迹伪造了一些指令。这应该可以把他们赶走，这样就能为我们再争取一点时间。$b$b把伪造的指令放在指定的地方。你马上就能看到效果了。
text.completion: They ran right past us on their way out.

english.title: False Orders
english.objectives: Plant the False Orders in the marked locations.
english.description: As soon as you take down Prix, word will spread like wildfire amongst the crew in the area. I had Tethys forge some orders in her handwriting that should send them away and buy us some more time.$b$bPlant the orders in the marked locations. You should see the results rather quickly.
english.completion: They ran right past us on their way out.

objectiveDetails.description: 放置第二批伪造的指令
放置第一份伪造的指令

text.title: 乔拉齐的召唤
text.objectives: 向暗影大厅的乔拉齐·拉文霍德公爵复命。
text.description: 这样一来，计划的第一阶段就完成了。我们最好回到乔拉齐那里，把消息告诉他。
text.completion: Welcome back, Shadowblade. I assume you've retrieved the gunpowder?

english.title: Jorach's Calling
english.objectives: Return to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt in the Hall of Shadows.
english.description: And with that, the first phase of the plan is complete. It's best we return to Jorach and bring him the news.
english.completion: Welcome back, Shadowblade. I assume you've retrieved the gunpowder?

text.title: 突袭阿苏纳
text.objectives: 击退阿苏纳的燃烧军团部队。
text.description: 恶魔对我们的生存造成了严重打击，对我们土地上所有的居民都是一种威胁。$b$b请消除他们的威胁，否则就迟了。
text.completion: I'm afraid our fight has only brought us so far. We must press our attack before the Legion advances beyond their stronghold within the Temple of a Thousand Lights!

english.title: Assault on Azsuna
english.objectives: Repel the Burning Legion forces throughout Azsuna.
english.description: The demons strike at the heart of our existence, posing a threat to all who inhabit our lands.$B$BRemove the threat before it is too late.
english.completion: Увы, пока что мы вынуждены слишком много сил тратить на оборону. Нужно перейти в решительное наступление, пока Легион не продвинулся дальше своего оплота в храме Тысячи Огней!

objectiveDetails.description: 在沙考尔的巢穴与法罗迪斯王子见面

text.title: 突袭风暴峡湾
text.objectives: 击退风暴峡湾的燃烧军团部队。
text.description:
燃烧军团，我们世界的宿敌，竟敢来攻击风暴峡湾！

勇士，战场呼唤着你的英勇！找到那些军团的部队，然后消灭他们！
text.completion: Just beyond these cliffs, the forces of the Legion are gathering for their assault. For every moment that passes their number grows.$B$BWe must strike soon before we are overwhelmed!

english.title: Assault on Stormheim
english.objectives: Repel the Burning Legion forces throughout Stormheim.
english.description:
The eternal foe of our world, the Burning Legion, dare to attack the land of Stormheim!

Champion, now is your call to valor! Find the forces of the Legion and eradicate them!
english.completion: За этими утесами собираются силы Легиона. Они готовятся к наступлению. С каждой минутой враг становится все сильнее.$b$bМы должны ударить по ним в самое ближайшее время, иначе они задавят нас числом!

text.title: 突袭至高岭
text.objectives: 击退至高岭的燃烧军团部队。
text.description:
我的一生中目睹了无数混乱与威胁的诞生与消亡，但我从未见到过有人如此肆无忌惮地漠视生命。

恶魔灼烧了我们的大地，令我们的同胞痛不欲生，但我们绝不能坐视他们威胁到我们历尽千辛万苦创造的一切。

时势造英雄，$n。是时候了，站出来抗击燃烧军团吧！
text.completion: My apologies, $n. I hope Aviash and I did not offend you. One cannot be too careful during times like these.

english.title: Assault on Highmountain
english.objectives: Repel the Burning Legion forces throughout Highmountain.
english.description:
In my years I have seen disturbances and threats come and go, but never before have I seen such brazen disregard for life. 

The demons may scorch our lands and cause suffering amongst our kin, but we must not stand idly by while they threaten what we have fought so hard to create.

Rise to the occasion, $n. The time has come to stand against the Burning Legion!
english.completion: Прошу извинить меня, $n. Надеюсь, мы с Авиашем тебя не обидели. В нынешние времена никакая осторожность не бывает излишней.

text.title: 捷报
text.objectives: 与达拉然的大法师茉德拉谈一谈。
text.description: 你该回肯瑞托了。他们肯定都想知道这个好消息！
text.completion: I am relieved that you have dealt with immediate threat. We barely have enough resources for the Broken Shore as it is!$B$BStill we have something for you...

english.title: A Triumphant Report
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Modera in Dalaran.
english.description: You should return to your Kirin Tor. I have no doubt they will want to hear the good news!
english.completion: Я рада, что ты $gликвидировал:ликвидировала; насущную угрозу. Нам едва хватает ресурсов для кампании на Расколотом берегу!$b$bНо для тебя найдется подарок...

text.title: 六人议会的礼物
text.objectives: 在紫罗兰城堡中举起你的武器，接受六人议会的礼物。
text.description: $n，如果没有你的话，燃烧军团的那些强大特工可能还在艾泽拉斯四处游荡，威胁着我们在这场战争中取得的成果。$b$b这样的功绩不能光靠口头表扬。$b$b如果你愿意接受的话，我们会拿出一部分力量，正式表彰你对抗黑暗的英勇事迹。
text.completion: We hope the increased power to your weapon will prove useful on the Broken Shore and beyond.

english.title: A Gift From the Six
english.objectives: Raise your weapon and receive the Council of Six's gift in the Violet Citadel.
english.description: $n, without you some of the Legion's strongest agents would still be roaming Azeroth, threatening to undermine all that we've accomplished in this war.$B$BSuch a deed merits more than mere recognition.$B$BIf you would accept it, we would like to formally reward your heroism in the face of such darkness with a portion of our power.
english.completion: We hope the increased power to your weapon will prove useful on the Broken Shore and beyond.

text.title: 黑暗预兆
text.objectives: 与达拉然的大法师茉德拉谈一谈。
text.description: 我们没法独自击败库鲁尔。$b$b传送门稳定后，我会通知你的。我们要一起让这个魔王伏诛。$b$b在此期间，你应该把瓦祖恩的死讯，以及库鲁尔回归的消息告诉肯瑞托。
text.completion: Any luck out there?

english.title: Dark Omens
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Modera in Dalaran.
english.description: We won't be able to defeat Kruul alone.$B$BOnce the portal has stabilized I will send word so we can bring the Highlord to justice.$B$BIn the meantime, you should inform the Kirin Tor of Vazuun's death - and Kruul's return.
english.completion: Ну что, как успехи?

text.title: 安东尼达斯的爱好
text.objectives: 与守护者圣殿的大法师卡雷谈一谈。
text.description: 大法师卡雷请你去守护者圣殿。他发现了一件事，急需跟你商量。$b$b请尽快去找他吧。
text.completion: Archmage, I've found something you may be interested in. An old journal of the late Archmage Antonidas. In it, he speaks of a project he was working on that I think we may be able to finish.$B$BIt was a sort of flying disc that could attune itself to the rider's magical specialization.$B$BBut I need your help tracking down the pieces. From what I could gather, he gave them to trusted friends and allies through the years. Perhaps you could persuade them to give us the pieces.

english.title: Avocation of Antonidas
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Kalec in the Hall of the Guardian.
english.description: Archmage Kalec has requested your presence back in the Hall of the Guardian. He's discovered something he wishes to urgently speak with you about.$b$bPlease see him at your earliest convenience.
english.completion: Supreme Magician, I found something interesting for you. It's an old diary of now deceased supreme wizard Antonidas. In it, he describes his work on a project he never finished in his life. But maybe we can do it. It's about some floating disk that adapts to its owner's magical specialty. I'll need your help finding fragments of this device. It seems that Antonidas gave them away to his loyal friends and trusted allies in his time. Perhaps you can persuade them to give the fragments to us.

text.title: 燃烧之心
text.objectives: 与卡德加谈谈有关三分火碟的事，然后按照他的指示行动。
text.description: 他提到的第一块组件是火焰飞碟。他在调查熔火之心的入口时对它进行了灌魔。$b$b可是，飞碟内涌动的能量太过强大，无法控制，他就让卡德加把飞碟带到了卡拉赞，看看那里有没有关于火焰控制的藏书。$b$b也许你应该跟卡德加谈谈，搞清那个飞碟后来怎么样了。
text.progress: Was Khadgar able to remember what he did with the piece?
text.completion: You've recovered it! And it is as Antonidas wrote, still surging with great fire magic!

english.title: Burning Within
english.objectives: Speak with Khadgar about the Tri-Disc of Fire. Follow his instructions after you speak with him.
english.description: The first piece he spoke of was that of fire. He imbued it while investigating the entrance to the Molten Core.$b$bHowever, the power surging through it was too great to control, so he asked Khadgar to take it to Karazhan and see if there were any books on the subject of controlling fire.$b$bPerhaps you should speak with Khadgar and find out what became of the disc.
english.progress: Was Khadgar able to remember what he did with the piece?
english.completion: You've recovered it! And it is as Antonidas wrote, still surging with great fire magic!

objectiveDetails.description: 使用传送门前往奥图鲁斯的密室
（可选）使用传送门前往卡拉赞

text.title: 极寒之心
text.objectives: 与达拉然巨坑附近的大法师塞德瑞克谈一谈，了解三分冰碟的情报。
text.description: 安东尼达斯制作的下一块飞碟灌注了冰霜魔法。他写道，他与同僚大法师塞德瑞克一起举行了一个仪式，把冰霜之力引导到飞碟中，可是他们两个人的合力太强，把太多的能量灌注到了这块飞碟里。$b$b如果我没记错的话，塞德瑞克就在达拉然的旧址——达拉然巨坑旁帮忙监督重建工作。$b$b希望他知道飞碟的下落。
text.progress: After the devastation that befell Dalaran's original home, who knows where that disc may be.
text.completion: Ogres took it? Those beasts will grab anything they can I suppose.$B$BRegardless, it's excellent you were able to find it.

english.title: Chilled to the Core
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Cedric near the Dalaran Crater about the Tri-Disc of Frost.
english.description: The next piece Antonidas made was imbued with frost magic. He wrote about a ritual to channel frost energy into the disc with his fellow Archmage, Cedric, but their combined strengths forced too much energy into the disc.$b$bIf I recall, Cedric is helping oversee the reconstruction of Dalaran near the crater where Dalaran once resided.$b$bHopefully he knows where to find the disc.
english.progress: After the devastation that befell Dalaran's original home, who knows where that disc may be.
english.completion: Ogres took it? Those beasts will grab anything they can I suppose.$B$BRegardless, it's excellent you were able to find it.

objectiveDetails.description: 与大法师塞德瑞克交谈

text.title: 近在咫尺
text.objectives: 与达拉然的大法师塞琳德拉谈一谈，了解三分魔碟的情报。
text.description: 第三块飞碟灌注了安东尼达斯自己的奥术魔法。当时，他正处在力量的巅峰期。但跟其他两块飞碟一样，它最终没有完成。$b$b他提到，他把这块飞碟送给了大法师塞琳德拉……$b$b她不就是达拉然的传送门训练师吗？她肯定知道这块飞碟的下落！$b$b快，去和她谈谈。
text.progress: Did she have it?
text.completion: To think it was right here in Dalaran the whole time.

english.title: Close to Home
english.objectives: Speak to Archmage Celindra about the Tri-Disc of the Arcane here in Dalaran.
english.description: The third piece of the disc was infused with Antonidas' own arcane magic. He did this at the height of his power, but like the other two discs, was unable to finish his work on it.$b$bHe wrote that he gave the piece to Archmage Celindra...$b$bIsn't she the portal trainer here in Dalaran? She must know where the piece is!$b$bQuickly, go speak with her.
english.progress: Did she have it?
english.completion: To think it was right here in Dalaran the whole time.

text.title: 为瓦尔莎拉而战
text.objectives: 击败瓦尔莎拉的恐惧元老加拉托克。
text.description:
这场进攻开始时，我就觉得恶魔早知道我们的计划，他们对我们的一举一动都了如指望。如果我们想要终结这一切，就必须全力攻击这头野兽的心脏。

你的努力说明，光靠勇气是打不赢这场战斗的，还需要意愿和牺牲。我请求你再度与盟友们一起踏上战场，终结这场疯狂。
text.completion: You have sacrificed for our lands, brave $C.$B$BYour perseverance has inspired our brothers and sisters to stand against the Burning Legion.

english.title: Battle for Val'sharah
english.objectives: Defeat Dread Vizier Gra'tork in Val'sharah.
english.description:
From the very start of these attacks I've felt as though the demons knew our plans, as if they anticipated our every move. If we are to put an end to this we must focus our attacks at the heart of the beast.

Your efforts have shown these battles are not won by bravery alone, but willingness and sacrifice. I ask that you stand on the battlefield once more among allies to bring this madness to an end.
english.completion: Ты многим $gпожертвовал:пожертвовала; ради спасения наших земель, |3-6($c).$B$BТвоя стойкость воодушевила наших братьев и сестер и придала им сил противостоять Пылающему Легиону.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭恐惧元老加拉托克
与加洛德·影歌交谈，开始最终突袭

text.title: 勇士：达利乌斯·克罗雷领主
炎魔之王的攻势
text.objectives: 向燃烬渠的炎魔领主斯莫德隆报到。
text.description: 战场的另一头传来了斯莫德隆的召唤，萨满。这次轮到他的国度遭到入侵了。$b$b情况看来很紧急。我会负责这里的善后工作。
text.completion: I will not allow such insolence!

english.title: The Firelord's Offense
english.objectives: Report to Firelord Smolderon in Cinder Run.
english.description: Smolderon calls from across the battlefield, shaman. Now it is his realm being violated.$b$bIt seems urgent. I will clean up here.
english.completion: Я не потерплю подобной наглости!

text.title: 先祖与敌人
text.objectives: 前往德拉丝的祖先位于瓦尔莎拉的家园，寻找她过去的遗物。
text.description: 我参加破碎海滩之战的唯一目的就是想证明自己，但我开始怀疑自己是否有这个资格了。$b$b你看，我在破解恶魔符文时，发现了我家族的徽记。燃烧军团怎么会知道月牙家族的徽记？这对我来说是个谜，但我相信你能找出我的祖先与敌人之间的联系。$b$b他们村子的遗迹就位于瓦尔莎拉。
text.completion: What business do you have here? Have you come to scavenge what the harpies left behind?

english.title: Ancestors and Enemies
english.objectives: Head to Delas' ancestral home in Val'sharah and recover relics from her past.
english.description: I want nothing more than to prove myself by joining our offensive on the Broken Shore, but I'm beginning to doubt my worthiness.$B$BYou see, I found my family's sigil among the demonic runes I've been deciphering. Why the Moonfang crest would be known to the Legion is a mystery to me, but I trust you'll be able to find what connection lies between my ancestors and my enemies.$B$BWhat's left of their village can be found in Val'sharah.
english.completion: What business do you have here? Have you come to scavenge what the harpies left behind?

text.title: 鬼母的礼物
text.objectives: 在紫罗兰城堡中举起你的武器，接受六人议会的礼物。
text.description:
虽然我们已经把力量都给你了，我们还是想送给你一次……神器外观方面的……强化。

我们代表六人议会、达拉然和艾泽拉斯，再次感谢你，$n。
text.completion: It is small compensation for the deed you have accomplished, I hope it is enough.

english.description:
While we have already given you what power we can, we would like to present to you a... cosmetic... upgrade to your artifact.

On behalf of the Council of Six, Dalaran, and Azeroth, we thank you again, $n.
english.completion: It is small compensation for the deed you have accomplished, I hope it is enough.

text.title: The Folly of Levia Laurance
text.objectives: Ask around the city for information on Levia Laurance.
text.description:
Levia Laurance was once a member of the Kirin Tor, long ago, and a good friend. Dabbling in shadow magic got her banned from the city, but she knows the streets too well to keep her out for good.

Levia has disappeared, and I'm gravely concerned. Her work may have attracted the attention of the Legion. It has before. It would be very dangerous for all of us if her knowledge fell into their hands.

She was last seen at the Militant Mystic. Ask around there and see if you can pick up her trail.

text.title: 助祭之难
text.objectives: 帮助雷特森调查莱维娅的仪式。
text.description:
事实上，议会对阿加莎知之甚少，但她可不是一般的魅魔。她在萨亚德中有许多盟友，而且以擅长指挥小鬼大军淹没敌人而著称。

想找到她的下落是件愚蠢的事情，但雷特森·焰怒有债必还。

来吧，我们检查一下，你的这位小法师是碰上了什么样的邪能之力……
text.progress: Убери от меня этих бесов!
text.completion: The amount of power this Levia channeled into this portal is impressive, if unnecessary. Unfortunately, if we don't get it stable, it's likely to collapse and take us with it. $B$BSufficed to say, that would end your mission pretty quick.$B$BI have to concentrate to keep this open, so I'll need your help...

english.title: The Acolyte Imperiled
english.objectives: Help Ritssyn investigate Levia's ritual.
english.description:
Truthfully, the Council knows little of Agatha, but she is more than just your average succubus. She has many allies within the sayaad, and is known to command armies of imps that swarm and overwhelm her foes.

To seek her out is folly, but Ritssyn Flamescowl repays his debts.

Come, let us examine what manner of fel powers this little mage of yours was stumbling her way through...
english.progress: Убери от меня этих бесов!
english.completion:
Количество энергии, которую Левия направила в этот портал, впечатляет, хотя в этом вряд ли была необходимость. Проблема в том, что если нам не удастся стабилизировать его, то он схлопнется и заберет нас с тобой. $B$BВ этом случае твое предприятие закончится, едва успев начаться.

Мне нужно будет полностью сосредоточиться, чтобы удержать его открытым, так что потребуется твоя помощь...

text.title: 追踪气味
text.objectives: 跟随法姆巴尔找到莱维娅。
text.description:
我就不跟你一起进传送门了，$c。我已经帮你找到了你的法师的下落，所以我欠茉德拉的债算是还清了。

不过，我还可以借你一头地狱犬，帮你把这个法师找出来。如果她真的像茉德拉说的那样强大，那为了大家着想，还是不要让她留在阿加莎那里比较好。

祝你好运，$c，你最好把法姆巴尔完好无损地带回来。
text.completion: What... what is going on? $B$BWho are you?

english.title: Following the Scent
english.objectives: Follow Fhambar to Levia's location.
english.description:
You will have to continue through the portal without me, $c. I have assisted you in locating your mage's whereabouts, so I consider my debt to Modera paid.

However, I will lend you one of my felhounds to help track this mage down. If she is as powerful as Modera says, then it would be in everyone's best interest that Agatha not be allowed to keep her.

Best of luck, $c, and try to bring Fhambar back in one piece.
english.completion: Что... что происходит? $B$BТы кто?

text.title: 地狱之象
text.objectives: 打断3个地狱火仪式。
text.description: 你听到了吗，萨满？大地在轰鸣，想要抗拒军团的意志。这些艾瑞达自以为很聪明，想要用他们的意志扭曲艾泽拉斯的力量。$b$b军团居然胆敢腐化我的国度？他们已经用艾泽拉斯的岩石制造了许多地狱火——那是我的岩石！现在他们还想让这些新生的地狱火活过来。$b$b去破坏他们愚蠢的仪式吧。碾碎他们！让他们看看艾泽拉斯的真正力量！
text.completion: I laughed as their infernals crumbled. They return to Azeroth, as they belong.

english.title: Infernal Phenomena
english.objectives: Interrupt 3 Infernal Rituals.
english.description: Do you hear that, shaman? The rumble of the earth as it tries to fight against the Legion's will. Their half-witted eredar are attempting to bend the forces of Azeroth to their will.$b$bHow dare the Legion think they can corrupt my domain? They have assembled their infernals from Azeroth's stone - MY stone! Now they try to bring these new infernals to life.$b$bSabotage their foolish rituals. Crush them! Show them Azeroth's true power!
english.completion: Мне было отрадно видеть, как их инферналы рассыпаются на куски. Теперь камень, из которого их создали, снова возвращен в недра этого мира.

text.title: 武装达拉然
text.objectives: 穿过艾萨斯的传送门，前往达拉然之塔。
text.description:
卡萨纳提尔现在无力阻止我们调动他在夜之子灵魂石里的力量了。目前为止，我们还算幸运——我们的盟友一直在阻止武器被破坏的消息传出去。

我们得趁运气还在，立刻修好达拉然的武器阵列。

噢——武器平台暂时不能进入。你应该不恐高吧？我来打开传送门。
text.completion: Well done, Archmage $n! Dalaran can defend herself once again.$B$BFor all of our sakes, let us hope that the shields keeping Kathra'natir imprisoned do not fail before we are able to find a safer solution.

english.title: Arming Dalaran
english.objectives: Travel to the Dalaran Spire via Aethas' portal.
english.description:
Kathra'natir is powerless to stop us from harnessing his energy within the Nightborne Soulstone. We have been lucky thus far - our allies have kept news of the sabotage from spreading. 

We should repair Dalaran's weapons array immediately while luck is still on our side.

Oh - the weapon platform is a bit inaccessible. I trust you are not afflicted by a fear of heights? I will open a portal.
english.completion: Отлично, верховный маг $n! Теперь Даларан снова готов к обороне.$b$bБудем надеяться, что щит удержит Катра'натира внутри камня, пока мы не придумаем, как поступить с ним дальше.

text.title: 控制水晶
text.objectives: 去恐痕裂隙找裘碧卡·碎影。
text.description:
有我照顾，坎雷萨德会没事的，但是这些存有他的邪能魔法的水晶必须小心处理。

如果有任何一颗破碎了，里面的能量就会自己回到我们的朋友身上。我应该不用提醒你这样会造成多大的破坏。

我会把水晶收集起来，我们恐痕裂隙见。
text.completion: The crystals will be safe here, with each of the council members watching over them.$B$BKanrethad is still recovering, but is well enough to speak.

english.title: Crystal Containment
english.objectives: Meet Jubeka Shadowbreaker in Dreadscar Rift.
english.description:
Kanrethad will be safe in my care, but something must be done about these crystals that hold his fel magic.

If any should break, the energy inside would find its way back to our friend. I shouldn't need to tell you how devastating it would be if that were to happen.

I will gather the crystals and meet you back at Dreadscar Rift.
english.completion: The crystals will be safe here, with each of the council members watching over them.$B$BKanrethad is still recovering, but is well enough to speak.

text.title: 紧急警告
text.objectives: 与战术家蒂德菲尔谈一谈。
text.description:
<这名士兵脸色苍白，身负重伤，显然正承受着巨大的痛苦。>

从突袭……破碎海滩……就一直……被囚禁……

<他战栗了一下。>

恶魔……他们在集结……准备……

必须逃跑……来警告你。一定要……阻止他们！

text.description:
被邪能腐化的生物正在山谷中肆虐，它们已经没救了，但是我们还可以帮助其他的生物。

拿上这些法力根茎药膏，对你看到的任何动物使用。如果它们还没被邪能魔法彻底腐蚀，这种药膏或许可以治好它们的伤口。

The valley is swarming with fel-corrupted creatures who are beyond saving, yet there still may be some that could use our help.

Take this manaroot salve and apply it to any animals you see. If the fel magic hasn't taken hold, the salve might be able to mend their wounds.

text.description: 大领主，格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵有要事想跟你商量。$b$b请尽快到你的职业大厅——圣光之愿礼拜堂去见他吧。

text.title: 着手准备
text.objectives: 从一位皮匠手上获得一套石皮皮革骑甲。如果你不是皮匠，也不认识皮匠，还可以从拍卖行购买。
text.description: 不知道你还记不记得，我以前帮助过年轻的圣骑士获得他们的第一匹装甲坐骑。$b$b那个任务非常冗长，需要花费数月收集材料，还得跑遍艾泽拉斯各地。$b$b幸好，时代变了，现在我们已经拥有了绝大部分材料。话虽如此，我还是想帮你获取一种新坐骑，一种与你的大领主的名号相符的坐骑。$b$b首先，我只需要你为我们弄一套骑甲来，要牢固、厚实而且沉重。
text.progress: How goes the search for the barding? Find anything suitable yet?
text.completion: <Grayson examines the barding.>$B$BThis is... well, a good start, Highlord. But I think it will have to be strengthened a bit.

english.title: Preparations Underway
english.objectives: Obtain a Stonehide Leather Barding from a leatherworker. You may also obtain it from the auction house if you're not a leatherworker or don't know a leatherworker.
english.description: As you may or may not recall, I once helped young paladins obtain their first armored mount.$b$bIt was a tedious task that involved months of obtaining materials and sending them all over Azeroth.$b$bThankfully, times have changed and we now have most of those materials at hand. That being said, I wish to help you obtain a new mount, something worthy of your title as Highlord.$b$bIn order for us to begin, I only require that you obtain a barding for us. Something strong, thick, and heavy.
english.progress: Ну что, как там дела с доспехом? Удалось раздобыть что-нибудь подходящее?
english.completion: < Grayson's taking a good look at the armor. >$b$bThat's a good start, $gSupreme Lord: Supreme Lady... But I think it needs a little strengthening.

text.title: 达拉然之锤
text.objectives: 与达拉然的奥拉尔德·施米尔谈一谈。
text.description: 如果我们想让这件骑甲配得上将要穿戴它的那匹马，就得将它升级一下。现在它只能防止你被人从坐骑上踢下来。$b$b与达拉然的奥拉尔德·施米尔谈一谈。他是个优秀的铁匠，知道怎么调整这件骑甲，让它更适合我们的需要。
text.completion: Greetings, Highlord. What can I help you with?$B$B<You explain what you need to Alard as he looks over the barding.>$B$BI see. I can certainly help you with your upgrading this, but I'll need a few things first.

english.objectives: Speak with Alard Schmied in Dalaran.
english.description: Should we wish to make this barding worthy of the steed who will bear it, we'll need to upgrade it. Right now it's just good for not getting you kicked off your mount.$b$bSpeak with Alard Schmied in Dalaran. He's a fine smith and will know how to modify this barding into something more befitting our needs.

text.title: 皮革传说
text.objectives: 让奥拉尔德升级骑甲，然后把将它交还给你职业大厅里的格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵。
text.description: 我们可以开始了吗？我的意思是，我来负责干活儿，而你只要在旁边看就好！$b$b<奥拉尔德朝你咧嘴一笑，然后开始干活。>
text.progress: How'd it go? Was Alard able to upgrade the barding?
text.completion: <Grayson examines the barding.>$B$BThis is perfect. Exactly what I expected from Alard. Now that we have everything together, there is but one task left.

english.title: Leather to Legendary
english.objectives: Have Alard upgrade the barding and return with it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker at your order hall.
english.description: Let's begin, shall we? I mean, I'll be doing all the work, but you get to watch!$b$b<Alard grins a wide smile at you and begins working.>
english.progress: How are you? Did Alard manage to modify the armor?
english.completion: < Grayson's watching the horse's armor. >$b$bIt's just perfect. Well, that's not what I expected from Alard, though. Now we have everything we need, only one thing left to do.

text.title: 神圣牧师：鲑鱼溪调查
text.objectives: 前往瓦尔莎拉的鲑鱼溪。
text.description:
我们在海滩上找到了一些伪造的指令。这些指令会用邪能影响阅读者，让对方相信这些指令是真的。它命令黑鸦堡垒攻击一块位于堡垒南侧的“恶魔飞地”。他们所说的飞地，只可能是鲑鱼溪！

这些指令真的能让亡灵攻击鲑鱼溪吗？你得立刻前往那里警告他们，或是提供援助。

|cFF660000专精：神圣牧师|r
text.completion: A bit late for the warning, eh? Still, I appreciate that we haven't been forgotten.

english.title: Holy: The Bradensbrook Investigation
english.objectives: Go to Bradensbrook in Val'sharah.
english.description:
We have uncovered forged orders from the Shore. They have a fel influence about them. They guide the reader to believe they are legitimate. It orders Black Rook Hold to attack a "demonic enclave" just south of their walls. There's only one enclave they could be talking about, Bradensbrook!

Is it possible these would be able to convince the undead to attack Bradensbrook? You should head there immediately and either warn them, or render aid.

|cFF660000Specialization: Holy Priest|r
english.completion: Немного поздновато для предостережения! Но все равно спасибо, что не забыли про нас.

text.title: 支援前线
text.objectives: 帮助鲑鱼溪东部、西部和南部防线上的伤员。
text.description:
我们当初在这里定居时，那个堡垒只是个无人问津的破城堡，阴森而安静。后来，死去的精灵突然复活了。在你的帮助下，我们本以为事情已经解决了。可现在，简直就像有千军万马在攻击我们一样！

我们的防线需要更多的医疗支援。亡灵越来越多，几轮攻势下来，我们剩下的卫兵越来越少。我们欢迎所有来帮助伤员的人！
text.completion: You've saved many lives this day, $C. Bradensbrook thanks you.

english.title: Aid on the Front Lines
english.objectives: Give aid to the wounded on the east, west, and south defense lines of Bradensbrook.
english.description:
When we settled here, that Hold was just a quiet creepy place that we avoided. Then the elves came back from the dead. With your help we thought it was mostly handled. But now it feels like an army is attacking us!

We could use more healing at our defense lines. More undead arrive and we have less and less protectors each wave. Any aid to our wounded would be welcomed!
english.completion: Сегодня ты $gспас:спасла; множество жизней, |3-6($c). Браденсбрук благодарит тебя.

text.title: 肃清幽魂
text.objectives: 消灭鲑鱼溪附近复生的精灵和幽魂。
text.description:
鲑鱼溪即将遭受猛烈攻击。但我相信，只要齐心协力，我们就能提前减缓对方的攻势。

在处理指挥官的同时，我们应该尽量多解决一些不安的幽魂。

只要让他们群龙无首并且元气大伤，我们应该就有时间去找艾德里斯·索恩了。
text.progress: Yeah, I see you're a real peacemaker, |3-6($c).
text.completion: We realize these spirits are misguided, but we have to care about the living more than the dead at this point.$B$BThe attacks should ease off for a while.

english.title: Quieting the Spirits
english.objectives: Slay risen elves and spirits near Bradensbrook.
english.description:
An overwhelming attack on Bradensbrook is imminent. Together I believe we can blunt the spear before it is cast.

While we are dealing with the commanders, we should put down as many unquiet spirits as we can.

With their leaders down and their numbers culled, that should give us time to find Erdris Thorn.
english.progress: Yeah, I see you're a real peacemaker, |3-6($c).
english.completion: Понятно, что эти духи были введены в заблуждение, но нам сейчас гораздо важнее судьбы живых, чем мертвых.$b$bТеперь у нас будет небольшая передышка.

text.title: 影歌回归
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉的鲑鱼溪外找到加洛德·影歌。
text.description:
唔，我们的防线情况好多了，谢谢你。这真是件好事，因为我们需要休息！

话虽如此，我们注意到有一群更大、更残忍的亡灵从农场那边过来了。他们本来不会让我们好过的，但是那个叫影歌的家伙已经回到这里，还把那些亡灵都干掉了。他正在抵挡从黑鸦堡垒过来的援军。

我猜他应该需要帮手。我们能够坚持到你和影歌解决掉这个麻烦。
text.completion: I had hoped this town had found peace after what we've all been through. Somehow restless dead have been stirred into a fury. We need to stop it.

english.title: Shadowsong's Return
english.objectives: Find Jarod Shadowsong outside Bradensbrook in Val'sharah.
english.description:
Well our lines are doing a lot better, thanks to you. A good thing too, because we need the rest!

That being said, we noticed a big group of bigger, meaner risen coming from the farmstead. They would've given us a hard time, but that Shadowsong fellow has returned and killed them all. He's holding off reinforcements coming from the hold.

I'm guessing he could use a hand. We can hold here until you and Shadowsong sort this out.
english.completion: Я очень надеялся, что этот город наконец-то сможет вздохнуть спокойно после всех свалившихся на него бед. Что-то взбудоражило неупокоенных мертвецов. Нужно разобраться с этим.

text.title: 重中之重
text.objectives: 获取$1oa块魔石矿石和一颗苏拉玛蓝宝石。
text.description: 我最近一直在处理这片土地上的矿石，它的名字叫做魔石。我发现它具有可观的硬度和耐久度。这种矿石的需求量一定会很大的。$b$b此外这里还有邪能页岩，不过这种矿石受到的污染太严重，可能不太合适你这套骑甲。$b$b你知道的，我还喜欢用闪亮的东西，比如宝石，来装饰我的作品。我听说苏拉玛的精灵有一种特别漂亮的宝石。或许你可以给你的骑甲弄一颗。
text.progress: I doubt you'll have a problem getting the leystone, but the sapphire might be a bit harder to acquire.
text.completion: You got them! Now to upgrade your barding.$B$BNever say a blacksmith can't improve on a leatherworker's work, I always say. I mean never. I mean... well you know what I mean.

english.title: A Few Things First
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Leystone Ore and a Suramarian Sapphire.
english.description: Lately I've been working with the ore of this land, leystone it's called. I've found its qualities to hold remarkable strength and durability. We'll need a lot of it for this.$b$bThere is felslate, but that's a probably too tainted for what you're looking to do with this barding.$b$bYou know, I also like to adorn my pieces with something sparkly, like a jewel. I've heard that the elves of Suramar have particularly beautiful ones. Perhaps you could acquire one for this project.
english.progress: С силовым камнем у тебя проблем точно не возникнет, а вот сурамарский сапфир придется поискать.
english.completion: Ты $gдостал:достала; все, что нужно! Значит, можно приниматься за работу.$b$bНет такого изделия из кожи, которое бы кузнец не смог сделать еще лучше. То есть смог бы... то есть... в общем, ты меня $gпонял:поняла;!

text.title: 近在眼前
text.objectives: 刺杀渗透的人偶。
text.description:
你好，暗影之刃。

我没有等你就自己先开始了，希望你别生气。面对无脑亡灵时，我就控制不了自己。

对，你没听错。泰利尔，就是那个在暗影大厅里站了好多个月的泰利尔，是一个恐惧魔王的亡灵走狗。

像他那样的人还有很多——他们混迹在我们的主城里，隐藏在贵族中间，不断扩大自己的权力和影响力，而且几乎没法察觉。
text.completion: We have shown the demons why they should truly fear the darkness. Now, Lord Ravenholdt has something for you from his personal collection.

english.title: Hiding In Plain Sight
english.objectives: Assassinate the infiltrating homunculi.
english.description:
Greetings, Shadowblade.

I hope you are not too upset that I began without you, I have a bit of trouble controlling myself around the mindless undead.

Yes, you heard me right. Taerir, the very Taerir that has been standing in the Hall of Shadows for many months now, was the undead pawn of a dreadlord.

And there are more of them - in our cities, rising through the ranks of the aristocracy, growing in power and influence, and nearly undetectable.
english.completion: Мы показали демонам, почему им следует страшиться теней пуще огня. Кстати, лорд Черный Ворон приготовил для тебя подарок – да еще из своей личной коллекции!

text.title: 恐惧渗透者
text.objectives: 与暗影大厅的莉莉安·沃斯交谈。
text.description:
暗影之刃，我们收到了一封渡鸦送来的信，里面的消息非常让人不安。

我们当中有一个人，一个能够进出暗影大厅的盟友，并不像表面上那么简单。

相信莉莉安已经开始解剖他们的尸体了。你最好快点。
text.completion: You don't really know if an ally is an undead pawn under the control of a dreadlord until you carve into them a bit.

english.title: Dread Infiltrators
english.objectives: Speak with Lilian Voss in the Hall of Shadows.
english.description:
Shadowblade, we have received a raven with most troubling news.

One of our own, an ally that walked our very Hall of Shadows, is not who they seem.

I believe Lilian has already begun dissecting their corpse. You'd best hurry.
english.completion: So come and find out who's yours and who's the undead puppet in the hands of the lord of horror. Don't let every gut out...

text.title: 斩首行动
text.objectives: 消灭鲑鱼溪的复活的队长。
text.description:
艾德里斯·索恩曾是拉文凯斯的部队中不可或缺的指挥官。听说他把我们当成了燃烧军团，我心里很难过。要打败他可不容易。

我们必须阻止他的小队长，不能让他们顺利围攻鲑鱼溪。只要击败了他们，应该就可以拖住他的部队，好让我们找到并解决他。就让我们开始这个残忍的任务吧。
text.completion: That should disorganize the assault for some time, but we must get to the bottom of this. I sensed a fel taint about those leaders, did you?

english.title: Cutting off the Heads
english.objectives: Slay the risen squad leaders in Bradensbrook.
english.description:
Erdris Thorn was a key commander of Ravencrest's forces. To hear him confusing us for the Legion fills me with a great sadness. He will be a difficult foe to defeat.

We must stop his squad leaders from forming up for a focused assault on Bradensbrook. Defeating them should delay his forces long enough for us to find and deal with him. Let us begin our grim task.
english.completion: На некоторое время мы внесли сумятицу в их ряды, но нам нужно устранить первоисточник угрозы. Мне показалось – или сподвижники Эрдриса и правда подверглись порче Скверны?

text.title: 腐化之源
text.objectives: 在英雄之眠找到腐化的源头，并且终结腐化。
text.description:
这三个人有点不对劲，他们身上有种令人不安的……邪能污染。我认为他们比其他亡灵苏醒得更晚，虽然不知道为什么。我要诅咒军团，诅咒他们的恶行！

增援部队正在从黑鸦堡垒的英雄之眠鱼贯而出。我们必须赶过去，努力截住新的这批部队。
text.completion: The attacks on Bradensbrook should relent for now. We must still deal with Lord Erdris, and soon.

english.title: Source of the Corruption
english.objectives: Find the source of the corruption at Heroes' Rest and end it.
english.description:
There was something wrong with those three, they had a fel taint about them that was... unsettling. I believe they were somehow woken later than the other risen. Curse the Legion and their meddling!

The reinforcements are streaming out of Black Rook Hold from Heroes' Rest. We must make our way there and see if we can stop the source of these new troops.
english.completion: Теперь нападения на Браденсбрук должны прекратиться. Но нам еще предстоит разобраться с лордом Эрдрисом, и лучше с этим не затягивать.

text.title: 知识就是力量
text.objectives: 提供职业大厅资源，解锁神器知识。
text.description:
通过我们在破碎群岛的战役，你已经为你的古代神器注入了能量。但随着燃烧军团的入侵加剧，我们必须尽快解锁这把武器的潜力。

我们可以稍后再进行缓慢稳妥的研究。但现在，我们得加快进度了。

将我们的职业大厅资源投入对武器历史的研究，我们就能加快你的神器获得能量的速度了。

我们可以开始了吗，$ct？
text.progress: Applying the resources gathered by our order will allow us to make quick progress.
text.completion: Learning more about your artifact weapon will help hasten our victory over the Legion.$B$BIf you supply me with order resources, I can provide research notes on your weapon. Read them, and learn how to take greater advantage of the power you infuse into your artifact.$B$BDeath to our enemies!

english.title: Knowledge is Power
english.objectives: Provide Order Resources to unlock artifact knowledge.
english.description:
Throughout our campaign on the Broken Isles, you have infused your ancient artifact with power. But as the Legion invasion intensifies, it becomes crucial to unlock more of your weapon's potential.

There is a time for slow, steady progress. But today, we must hasten our efforts.

By devoting our order's resources to studying the weapon's history, I believe we can rapidly enhance the value of the power you apply to the artifact.

Shall we begin, $ct?
english.progress: Ресурсы, добытые нашим орденом, позволят нам быстро продвинуться в наших изысканиях.
english.completion: Чем больше мы знаем о твоем артефактном оружии, тем ближе наша победа над Легионом.$b$bЕсли ты предоставишь в мое распоряжение ресурсы оплота класса, я смогу снабдить тебя исследовательскими записями о твоем оружии. Проштудируй их и узнай, как более эффективно использовать силу, которой ты насыщаешь свой артефакт.$b$bСмерть нашим врагам!

text.title: 为风暴峡湾而战
text.objectives: 击败风暴峡湾的总指挥官艾里克苏斯。
text.description:
经过你的努力，盾憩岛上的燃烧军团部队已经被消灭了，但是他们的攻击还在继续。

只有一个办法才能终结这一切——你必须深入敌阵，找到他们的指挥官，然后终结他邪恶的生命！
text.completion: Well done, $n! Well done indeed!$B$BThe Legion will rue the day they set their sights on the land of Stormheim.

english.title: Battle for Stormheim
english.objectives: Defeat Lord Commander Alexius in Stormheim.
english.description:
Your efforts have destroyed the Legion's forces upon Shield's Rest, yet they continue to press their assault.

There is only one way to end this - you must venture into the midst of our foe, find their commander, and remove his vile head!
english.completion: Хорошая работа, $n! Ты просто молодчина!$b$bЛегион теперь проклянет тот день, когда впервые обратил свой взор к Штормейму.

text.title: 伊利达雷大师：希丝克斯
伊利达雷大师：薇希萨夫人
伊利达雷大师：无名秘术师
Furthering Knowledge
text.objectives: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
text.description:
We have learned so much already about these artifacts it is incredible. 

Our researchers have been busy preparing notes for you and with a few more resources I am sure they can be used as a crash course in gaining more artifact knowledge. 

This is only the first step, with more resources we should have additional courses to help you catch up on your studies.
text.progress: With even more order resources, I can scribe further notes about your artifact weapon's history and potential.$B$BThis knowledge will be crucial for infusing your weapon with additional power.$B$BBring me those resources as soon as you can. The Legion must fall!
text.completion: The order resources you have provided are crucial to further empowering your weapon.$B$BHere, take these notes. Read the research and apply the knowledge you have learned.$B$BOnward to victory!

english.objectives: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
english.description:
We have learned so much already about these artifacts it is incredible. 

Our researchers have been busy preparing notes for you and with a few more resources I am sure they can be used as a crash course in gaining more artifact knowledge. 

This is only the first step, with more resources we should have additional courses to help you catch up on your studies.
english.progress: If I have more resources at my disposal, I can prepare another set of records for you about the history and potential of your weapon. $b$bLeave these resources to me as soon as possible! The Legion must fall!
english.completion: Предоставленные тобой ресурсы оплота класса исключительно важны для дальнейшего усиления твоего оружия.$b$bВот, возьми эти записи. Ознакомься с ними и примени полученные тобой знания на практике.$b$bВперед, к победе!

text.title: 挫败双子
text.objectives: 与军事顾问维多利亚谈一谈，传送到莱斯特身边并击败他。
text.description:
我收到了大法师卡莱的消息！肯瑞托已经找到了莱斯特·法师之矛的下落。他们可以打开一道传送门，通往他的身边！

如果你准备好面对他了，我可以让这里的法师打开通向扭曲虚空的传送门。
text.completion: So Raest has fallen, and in his hubris has taken his brother with him. I mourn for them both, but his brother most of all. $B$BKaram Magespear was truly a beacon of the Light. I only hope that the stories of his sacrifices live throughout the ages. $B$BYou have done well, $n.

english.title: Thwarting the Twins
english.objectives: Speak with War Councilor Victoria to be teleported to Raest's location and defeat him.
english.description:
I have news from Archmage Karlain! The Kirin Tor have found Raest Magespear and can open up a portal to his location!

If you are ready to face him, I can have the mages here open the portal into the Twisting Nether.
english.completion: So Raest has fallen, and in his hubris has taken his brother with him. I mourn for them both, but his brother most of all. $B$BKaram Magespear was truly a beacon of the Light. I only hope that the stories of his sacrifices live throughout the ages. $B$BYou have done well, $n.

text.title: Knowledge is Power
text.objectives: Provide Order Resources to unlock artifact knowledge.
text.description:
Boss, you've been working every angle on the Broken Isles, infusing that ancient artifact of yours with power. But those demons won't give up, and we really need to unlock more of your weapon's potential... and I mean pronto!

Slow, steady progress is one thing. But today, we need to get busy.

Here's the deal. You fork over our order's resources so I can study the weapon's history, and I'll get you a way to up the value of the power you apply to that artifact.

How does that sound, $ct?
text.progress: This is a great deal, boss! Applying the resources gathered by our order will let us make big-time progress.
text.completion: Learning more about your artifact weapon will sure speed up our victory over the Legion, boss.$B$BIf you supply me with order resources, I can whip up research notes on your weapon. Read 'em, and in no time you'll be taking greater advantage of the power you infuse into your artifact.$B$BLet's do this!

text.title: 知识就是力量
text.objectives: 提供职业大厅资源，解锁神器知识。
text.description:
你真是破碎群岛的灾星，从我们的敌人那里夺取了大量能量灌注进你的古代神器里。但我们决不能自满，还得进一步解锁你那把武器的潜力！

我们可以稍后再进行缓慢稳妥的研究。但现在，我们必须加快进度了。

将我们的职业大厅资源投入对武器历史的研究，我们就能加快你的神器获得能量的速度了。而力量总是令人陶醉。

我们可以开始了吗，$ct？
