text.title: 紧急信息
text.objectives: 启动控制台，接收来自马顿的信息。
text.description: 我们收到了贝拉斯的斥候从马顿发来的紧急信息！我想你最好来听一下。
text.completion: Lady S'theno went down to lend a hand, but this sounds like it's getting serious!

english.title: An Urgent Message
english.objectives: Activate the console to receive the message from Mardum.
english.description: We received an urgent message from one of Belath's scouts down on Mardum! I think you had better listen to it.
english.completion: Леди С'тэно уже отправилась на помощь, но ситуация, судя по всему, куда серьезнее, чем мы предполагали!

text.title: 战术商讨
text.objectives: 在苍穹要塞的蜜酒大厅与奥丁见面。
text.description: 战争领主$n！我们来谈谈接下来的行动计划吧！
text.completion: It is good to see you again, my friend.

english.title: Tactical Planning
english.objectives: Meet with Odyn in Skyhold's Great Mead Hall.
english.description: Battlelord $n! We should discuss our next moves!
english.completion: It is good to see you again, my friend.

text.title: The Archmage Accosted
text.objectives: Confront Archmage Xylem.
text.description:
With the barrier dispelled, Archmage Xylem is finally within reach!

Hopefully he'll be cooperative in returning the Iris...

english.title: The Archmage Accosted
english.objectives: Confront Archmage Xylem.
english.description:
With the barrier dispelled, Archmage Xylem is finally within reach!

Hopefully he'll be cooperative in returning the Iris...

text.title: 传送逃离
text.objectives: 向达拉然的大法师卡雷复命。
text.description:
克希雷姆虽然逃跑了，但是他的传送门还留下了一丝痕迹。

既然你已经帮他的学徒摆脱了腐化，我会让他们努力找到接近他的办法的。一旦有了发现，我会警告肯瑞托的。

我只有一个请求，你面对大法师时，请尽量饶他一命。我相信，虽然他被那个暗影附身了，但他的内心还留有善良的本性。

再见，$n。
text.completion: So Xylem has been corrupted by shadow magic and has escaped with the Focusing Iris? This is not good.$B$BThe Kirin Tor will pool our efforts with those of his apprentici-- I mean, apprentices. We must track down the archmage before he does something drastic.$B$BWe will be in touch.

english.title: A Portal Away
english.objectives: Return to Archmage Kalec in Dalaran.
english.description:
Xylem may have escaped, but a trace of his portal remains.

Now that you have freed his apprentices from his corruption, I will set them to work trying to find a way to reach him.  Once I find something, I will alert the Kirin Tor.

I only ask that when you do confront the Archmage, that you try to spare his life. I believe that the good man he once was still exists beneath the shadow that has taken him.

Farewell, $n.
english.completion: Ксилем попал под воздействие темной магии? И ему удалось скрыться со Средоточием? Плохо.$B$BКирин-Тор объединит силы с его учениками. Его нужно найти, пока он не натворил дел.$B$BЕсли у нас будут новости, мы дадим тебе знать.

text.title: 近在眼前
text.objectives: 刺杀渗透的人偶。
text.description:
你好，暗影之刃。

我没有等你就自己先开始了，希望你别生气。面对无脑亡灵时，我就控制不了自己。

对，你没听错。泰利尔，就是那个在暗影大厅里站了好多个月的泰利尔，是一个恐惧魔王的亡灵走狗。

像他那样的人还有很多——他们混迹在我们的主城里，隐藏在贵族中间，不断扩大自己的权力和影响力，而且几乎没法察觉。
text.completion: We have shown the demons why they should truly fear the darkness. Now, Lord Ravenholdt has something for you from his personal collection.

english.title: Hiding In Plain Sight
english.objectives: Assassinate the infiltrating homunculi.
english.description:
Greetings, Shadowblade.

I hope you are not too upset that I began without you, I have a bit of trouble controlling myself around the mindless undead.

Yes, you heard me right. Taerir, the very Taerir that has been standing in the Hall of Shadows for many months now, was the undead pawn of a dreadlord.

And there are more of them - in our cities, rising through the ranks of the aristocracy, growing in power and influence, and nearly undetectable.
english.completion: Мы показали демонам, почему им следует страшиться теней пуще огня. Кстати, лорд Черный Ворон приготовил для тебя подарок – да еще из своей личной коллекции!

text.title: 为至高岭而战
text.objectives: 击败至高岭的邪能指挥官艾瑞克托尔。
text.description: 我们的防线越发强大，但军团仍然在猛攻雷霆图腾。要想终结这场疯狂，只有一个办法——我们必须齐心协力，捣毁他们的部队核心，从而中止所有这些攻击。
text.completion: Our efforts today have prevailed over the Legion's presence, though let us not be remiss - our journey has only just begun.

english.title: Battle for Highmountain
english.objectives: Defeat Fel Commander Erixtol in Highmountain.
english.description: Our defenses have grown in strength, yet the Legion continues to press their assault on Thunder Totem. There is but one way to put an end to this madness - we must strike at the heart of their forces together and bring these attacks to an end.
english.completion: Сегодня мы сумели одержать важную победу над Легионом, но расслабляться рано – это только начало.

objectiveDetails.description: 与拉善·天角交谈，开始最终突袭

text.title: 为阿苏纳而战
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳击败邪能指挥官瑟瑞塔斯。
text.description: 必须阻止那个策划袭击的卑鄙恶魔。我能让大家靠近他，但是到了那里，我就只能指望你和你的盟友帮忙击垮恶魔大军了。
text.completion: With the fall of their commander the Legion's presence in Azsuna will be more manageable for our defenders to make headway. For your efforts, we may see the end of these attacks once and for all.

english.title: Battle for Azsuna
english.objectives: Defeat Fel Commander Xeritas in Azsuna.
english.description: The vile demon commanding the assault must be stopped. I can get us close, but once we're there I'll rely on you and your allies to help bring down the demonic forces.
english.completion: С гибелью командира демонов нашим защитникам станет намного легче сдерживать Легион в Азсуне. Благодаря тебе мы положим конец этим атакам раз и навсегда.

objectiveDetails.description: 与法罗迪斯王子交谈，开始最终突袭

text.title: 问题……暂时解决……
text.objectives: 与达拉然的大法师茉德拉谈一谈。
text.description: 你该回去向肯瑞托复命了。相信他们肯定在等着我们胜利的消息。我会找到艾德里斯领主的，到时候再联系你。
text.completion: I am relieved that you have dealt with immediate threat. We barely have enough resources for the Broken Shore as it is!$B$BStill we have something for you...

english.title: The Matter Resolved... For Now...
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Modera in Dalaran.
english.description: You should return to the Kirin Tor. I have no doubt they will want to hear of our success. I will find Lord Erdris, and then I will contact you.
english.completion: Я рада, что ты $gликвидировал:ликвидировала; насущную угрозу. Нам едва хватает ресурсов для кампании на Расколотом берегу!$b$bНо для тебя найдется подарок...

objectiveDetails.description: 加入勇士阿夸克里斯的军队

text.title: 终止传导
text.objectives: 摧毁千光神殿的军团导管。
text.description: 我们最终的任务依然是切断燃烧军团与其他世界的联系。$b$b我会把你送到力量源头附近，但是对导管的最后一击必须由你完成。
text.completion: With the conduit destroyed, now may be our only chance.

english.title: A Conduit No More
english.objectives: Destroy the Legion's Conduit at the Temple of a Thousand Lights.
english.description: One final task remains to sever the Burning Legion's connection to other worlds.$B$BI'll provide you transportation to get you close to the source of power, but you must deliver the final blow to the conduit.
english.completion: Проводник уничтожен, и это наш шанс. Другого может не представиться.

text.title: 惊恐世界的低语
text.objectives: 前往索拉查盆地与麦格尼见面，并听取警告。
text.description: 勇士！艾泽拉斯需要我们的帮助。$b$b<麦格尼·铜须的话在你的脑海中回荡，仿佛来自某个幽深而古老的地方。艾泽拉斯的世界之魂想要向代言人发出警告，但某种力量干扰了讯息的传递。>$b$b<麦格尼敦促你前往索拉查盆地帮助他，那里是冰冷的诺森德大陆最生机勃勃的地方。>
text.completion: This warning is an ill omen indeed, $n. It seems the fate of Azeroth is tied to that of Argus, the homeworld of the Legion.$B$BWe must uncover the Dark Titan's plan! I believe the Speaker's connection to the world soul will prove crucial to our efforts.$B$BStay vigilant, Archdruid. We must trust in Magni's guidance... and Azeroth's as well.

english.title: Whispers of a Frightened World
english.objectives: Meet Magni in Sholazar Basin and hear the warning.
english.description: "Champion! Azeroth needs our help."$b$b<Magni Bronzebeard's words echo in your mind, as if rising from somewhere deep and ancient. Azeroth's world soul seeks to deliver a warning to the Speaker, but some force is interfering with the message.>$b$b<Magni has urged you to travel to Sholazar Basin, the vibrant heart of frozen Northrend, to aid him.>
english.completion: This warning is an ill omen indeed, $n. It seems the fate of Azeroth is tied to that of Argus, the homeworld of the Legion.$B$BWe must uncover the Dark Titan's plan! I believe the Speaker's connection to the world soul will prove crucial to our efforts.$B$BStay vigilant, Archdruid. We must trust in Magni's guidance... and Azeroth's as well.

objectiveDetails.description: 在造物者悬台与麦格尼会面
在索拉查盆地与麦格尼会面
（可选）使用达拉然的传送门前往龙眠神殿

text.title: 怒火试炼
text.objectives: 与奥丁谈一谈，开启怒火试炼场景战役。完成场景战役并获取你的奖励。
text.description: 我想邀请你参加一场荣耀的试练。$b$b我每年都会为我最出色的战士举办一场试练，以证明我号令着这片土地上最强大的战士。在这次的试练，我将选择你作为我的勇士。$b$b如果你在试练中获胜，我也会给出配得上你成就的奖励。$b$b你可以好好花时间准备一下，等准备好后再回来告诉我。
text.completion: That was truly a grand exposition of $C skill. I was truly impressed at how you handled Asrea. She will be missed.$B$BBut now on to a grander event. The prize which you so rightfully deserve.

english.title: The Trial of Rage
english.objectives: Speak with Odyn to begin the Trial of Rage scenario. Complete the scenario and claim your prize.
english.description: I wish to extend to you a prestigious invitation.$b$bEvery year I hold a trial for my finest warrior to prove that I command the strongest in this land. I have chosen you to be my champion in this trial.$b$bShould you succeed in completing the trial, I have a prize that will be worthy of your accomplishments awaiting you at the end.$b$bTake what time you need to prepare yourself. Come back and speak with me when you're ready to begin.
english.completion: Truly, it was an impressive demonstration of martial arts. You've done so spectacularly: you've done it; with Azria. We're gonna miss her. Now, now let's move on to the most important thing - the award that you fully $gdeserved: deserved;.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“怒火试炼”场景战役

text.title: 神之邀约
text.objectives: 在你位于苍穹要塞的职业大厅内与奥丁谈一谈。
text.description: 战争领主$p，奥丁请你返回苍穹要塞觐见他。$b$b请在方便时尽快前往。
text.completion: Battlelord $n, I have an offer you may be interested in...

english.title: A Godly Invitation
english.objectives: Speak with Odyn at your order hall in Skyhold.
english.description: Battlelord $p, Odyn has requested an audience with you back in Skyhold.$b$bPlease meet with him at your earliest convenience.
english.completion: Voivoda $p, I have an offer that should interest you...

text.title: 水晶另计
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个阿古尼特水晶。
text.description: 图拉扬很安全，我们可以开始反击了。$b$b先说重点，我们必须先从坠毁点尽可能地回收物资。$b$b尽管圣光保佑着我们，我们的战舰还得依赖水晶能量来为防御和武器系统供能。为了反击敌人，我们必须尽可能多地采集能量。$b$b你必须冒险进入坠毁点，回收一切可以回收的水晶。当你深入战场时，请留意伊米拉的行踪。她和我们分开了，很可能需要增援。
text.progress: I hope you brought backup with you.
text.completion: You brought crystals with you? Thank the Light, that's just what we need!

english.title: Crystals Not Included
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Argunite Crystals.
english.description: Turalyon is safe, and we can start to fight back.$b$bFirst things first, we must secure what supplies we can from the crash.$b$bEven though we are blessed by the Light, our ships still rely on crystal technology. From powering our defenses to arming our weapons, we will need to collect as much as we can to fight back against the enemy.$b$bVenture out into the crash and retrieve what crystals you can. While you are out there, keep an eye out for Y'mera. She was separated from us, and will need help.
english.progress: Надеюсь, ты $gпривел:привела; с собой подмогу.
english.completion: Ты $gпринес:принесла; кристаллы? Хвала Свету! Это как раз то, что нужно!

text.title: 安全的环境
text.objectives: 到救赎岗哨与暗夜女猎手塞琳会面。
text.description:
莱瑟拉被击败后，她的诱捕者很快也会风流云散。而那些冥顽不灵的人就尝尝我的利刃吧。

这片海滩上再也不会有妄图腐化艾泽拉斯的野生动物的人了。

这里的工作暂时结束了。我们救赎岗哨见吧。我想在更安全的环境下跟你谈谈。
text.completion: You've done so much so quickly here on the Broken Shore. Impressive, $n.

english.title: Secured Surroundings
english.objectives: Meet Nighthuntress Syrenne at Deliverance Point.
english.description:
With Lexera defeated, her band of trappers will quickly disband. Those that refuse will meet my blade.

These shores will be free of those who wish to corrupt Azeroth's wildlife.

Our work here is done for now. Let us meet at Deliverance Point. There is more I wish to discuss in secured surroundings.
english.completion: За короткое время ты столько всего $gсделал:сделала; на Расколотом берегу... Очень впечатляет, $n.

text.title: 召血者的消息
text.objectives: 与恐痕裂隙的莫苏尔·召血者谈一谈。
text.description:
术士！我有恐痕裂隙的消息。

渡鸦传来了莫苏尔·召血者的消息，要求你立刻前往恐痕裂隙见他！
text.completion: Our task will not be easy, but when this is over it is we who will be the true masters of Xoroth.

english.title: Bloodbringer's Missive
english.objectives: Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in Dreadscar Rift.
english.description:
Warlock! We have news from Dreadscar Rift. 

A message arrived by raven from Mor'zul Bloodbringer, with instructions that you meet him in Dreadscar Rift immediately!
english.completion: Это будет непростое дело, но когда все закончится, мы станем полноправными хозяевами Зорота.

text.title: 建造传送门
text.objectives: 收集5块邪能页岩，3颗混沌尖晶，以及1瓶不屈药水。这些物品可以通过专业技能收集制作，或者从拍卖行采购。
text.description:
如果我们想与克索诺斯保持联系，就需要一道特别持久的传送门。不幸的是，我们没法凭空召唤出这样的传送门。

我需要你去收集必需的材料。拿到材料后，我就让莫尔葛立刻开工。

这是你要收集的材料清单。
text.progress: Have you the necessary materials?
text.completion: Excellent. This Unbending Potion should shore up the Felslate enough to hold the portal's structure, and these Chaotic Spinel crystals should focus the portal's magic nicely.$B$BI will set the mo'arg to work posthaste.

english.title: If You Build It
english.objectives: Collect 5 Felslate, 3 Chaotic Spinel and an Unbending Potion. These can be gathered and crafted using profession skills or purchased on the Auction House.
english.description:
If we wish to achieve a sustained connection to Xoroth, we'll need a particularly resilient portal. Unfortunately, we can't just summon this one up from the ground.

I will need you to gather the requisite materials. Once we have them, I will have the mo'arg begin construction at once. 

Here's the list of what you'll need.
english.progress: Необходимые материалы у тебя с собой?
english.completion:
Прекрасно. Зелье непреклонности придаст сланцу Скверны дополнительную прочность, необходимую для несущих конструкций портала, а кристаллы шпинели Хаоса послужат средоточием его магии.

Я велю мо'аргам сей же час приниматься за работу.

text.title: 邪能核心
text.objectives: 在破碎群岛的军团突袭中，从指挥官身上收集一个过载的邪能核心。
text.description:
虽然术士打开通向军团世界的传送门已经变得相对简单了，但是开启长期传送门所需的力量要大得多。

就拿这座传送门来说，我们需要一种邪能充盈的能量源。

我知道军团的指挥官会使用强大的邪能核心来控制他们的战舰。如果你能击败其中一艘战舰的指挥官，应该就能拿到他们的核心了。
text.progress: Do you have the core?
text.completion: I sense the fel energy emanating from the core the moment you entered Dreadscar Rift. $B$BI think this will suit our needs.

english.title: Fel to the Core
english.objectives: Collect an Overcharged Fel Core from the commander of a Legion Assault on the Broken Isles.
english.description:
While it has become relatively easy for a warlock to open a brief window into the realms of the Legion, a sustained portal requires significantly more power.

For this, we will need a power source brimming with fel energy. 

I know that the commanders of the Legion use powerful fel cores to control their warships. If you can defeat the commander of one of these ships, you should be able to take their core.
english.progress: Ядро у тебя?
english.completion:
Я ощутил эманацию энергии Скверны в тот самый миг, когда ты $gвернулся:вернулась; в разлом Зловещего Шрама. 

Думаю, это ядро отлично подойдет для наших нужд.

text.title: 火上浇油
text.objectives: 前往瓦尔莎拉的失落之光岩洞，从那里的枭兽身上收集50份枭兽血液。
text.description:
光有个强大的核心还不足以驱动传送门。跟所有的强大引擎一样，它还需要燃料。不过，邪能引擎需要燃烧生命之力才能开动。

我们需要具有强大魔力的血液才能维持邪能核心的运转，以及和克索诺斯的联系。幸好，我对这种事很有经验，我知道在哪里可以获得这样的东西。

你得先准备个罐子之类的容器。
text.progress: Have you bled the owlkin dry?
text.completion: That's... quite a bit of blood. I am impressed, $n.$B$BI really should just start stockpiling this stuff. It has so many uses!

english.title: Give Me Fuel, Give Me Fire
english.objectives: Collect 50 Owlbeast Blood from Owlbeasts within Lostlight Grotto in Val'sharah.
english.description:
A powerful core will not alone be able to power the portal. Like any powerful engine, it will require fuel - though an engine of fel energy must burn life force to thrive.

We will need blood potent in magical energy to keep our fel core running and sustain our connection to Xoroth. Fortunately, I have experience in these matters, and I know just the place where we can get some.

You'll need a jar or something.
english.progress: Ну что, ты $gвыдавил:выдавила; из совухов всю кровь до капли?
english.completion:
Сколько крови... Я впечатлен, $n.

Давно уже пора заготавливать ее впрок. Она много для чего может пригодиться!

text.title: 赫尔努拉斯的爪牙
text.objectives: 使用你的魅魔的诱惑技能，在破碎海滩的黑暗监牢询问克索诺斯教徒。
text.description:
恐惧魔王赫尔努拉斯会送给他的副官们一种召唤石，可以召唤并束缚克索诺斯的恐惧战马来为他们效命。我相信，这种石头可以帮助我们引出愤怒战马。

目击报告说，有些克索诺斯教徒在破碎海滩上帮助军团。想必他们的首领应该有一块赫尔努拉斯的石头。

你的魅魔应该可以从那些教徒嘴里套出真相。去问问看有没有教徒知道他们首领的去向。
text.completion:
Итак, теперь нам известно, где находится лидер ритуалистов. 

Если нам повезет, у нее окажется один из камней призыва Хел'нурата.

english.title: The Minions of Hel'nurath
english.objectives: Use your Succubus' Seduction to question Xorothian Cultists within the Dark Stockades in the Broken Shore.
english.description:
The dreadlord Hel'nurath gifts his lieutenants with calling stones to call and bind the dreadsteeds of Xoroth to their service. I believe one such stone will help us draw out the Wrathsteed. 

Some Xorothian cultists have been spotted helping the Legion's efforts on the Broken Shore. It would be safe to assume their leader has one of Hel'nurath's stones.

Your succubus should be able to entice the truth out of the cultists. Find one who knows of their leader's whereabouts.
english.completion:
Итак, теперь нам известно, где находится лидер ритуалистов. 

Если нам повезет, у нее окажется один из камней призыва Хел'нурата.

text.title: 恐惧领主的召唤
text.objectives: 前往破碎海滩的黑暗监牢，从妖术师祖瑞瓦身上收集一块克索诺斯召唤石。
text.description: 据教徒所说，你想要找的首领应该在她的塔楼里监视着黑暗监牢的行动。
text.progress: I trust you found the stone?
text.completion: Long have I waited to get my hands on one of the dreadlord's calling stones. Were it not for our current task, we could outfit an army with dreadsteeds.$B$BHowever, this will serve a greater purpose. With the lure of this stone, Arax'ath will not be able to restrain the Wrathsteed. So long as we can keep the portal open long enough, it will come.

english.title: The Dreadlord's Calling
english.objectives: Collect a Xorothian Calling Stone from Zuriwa the Hexxer within the Dark Stockades in the Broken Shore.
english.description: According to the cultist, the leader you seek should be in her tower overseeing the operations in the Dark Stockades.
english.progress: Надеюсь, тебе удалось раздобыть камень?
english.completion:
Long time ago I dreamed of taking possession of one of the stones of the call of the lord of horror. If we did not have more important and urgent matters, we could provide the horses of death a whole army.

But specifically, this stone will have a more important task. When the steed of anger hears the call, Araks'at will not be able to restrain it. So if the portal remains open long enough, it will come.

text.title: 克索诺斯的愤怒战马
text.objectives: 在恐痕裂隙的召唤平台完成仪式，奴役愤怒战马。
text.description:
时候到了，准备也完成了。你准备好后，我们就会撕开一个通向克索诺斯的空洞，让阿拉萨斯和他的愤怒战马无所遁形。

跟我前往召唤平台吧。我们去那里开始仪式。

做好准备，$n。这个任务可不容易。
text.completion: The Wrathsteed is prepared for your binding, Netherlord. It will not be easy to enslave, its will is strong.$B$BI have to say, I'm a bit jealous. Never before have I seen such a ferocious beast, our disciples have it barely held in check.

english.title: The Wrathsteed of Xoroth
english.objectives: Complete the ritual on the Summoning Platform in Dreadscar Rift to enslave the Wrathsteed.
english.description:
The time has come and the preparations have been made. When you are ready, we will tear a hole into Xoroth, and force the Arax'ath and the Wrathsteed out of hiding.

Follow me to the summoning platform. From there we will initiate the ritual.

Prepare yourself, $n. This will not be an easy undertaking.
english.completion:
Скакун готов, |3-6($ct). Подчинить его будет непросто – у него сильная воля.

Признаться, я тебе даже завидую немного. Никогда прежде мне не доводилось видеть такого свирепого коня – ученикам едва удается его сдерживать.

text.title: 圣盾祭坛
text.objectives: 击败孟菲斯托斯，并将阿格拉玛之盾放在永夜祭坛上。
text.description:
勇士，我们已经准备好突袭萨格拉斯之墓了。

我研究了艾格文的笔记，她正是那位击败了黑暗泰坦的化身的守护者。她说，如果她的结界遭到了破坏，只要把阿格拉玛之盾放置在永夜大教堂的祭坛上，就会触发一种保护机制。

你是夺得了创世之柱的英雄，$n。集结你的盟友，进入大教堂吧。要小心：孟菲斯托斯会尽一切力量来阻止你放置圣盾。你不能失败！

english.title: Altar of the Aegis
english.objectives: Defeat Lord Mephistroth and place the Aegis of Aggramar upon the Altar of Eternal Night.
english.description:
Champion, we are ready to assault the Tomb of Sargeras.

I studied the writings of Aegwynn, the Guardian who defeated the Dark Titan's avatar. She said that if her wards were compromised, a failsafe could be triggered by placing the Aegis of Aggramar upon an altar in the Cathedral of Eternal Night.

You are the hero who acquired the Pillars of Creation, $n. Gather your allies and enter the Cathedral. Be warned: Mephistroth will use all his power to stop you from placing the Aegis. You must prevail!

text.title: 开始修建
text.objectives: 使用抗魔联军建筑桌捐献抗魔联军战争物资，用于修建法师塔、虚空干扰器或者指挥中心。
text.description:
物资已经到手了。现在需要有人来决定该怎么使用它们。

嗯。看来得让你来拿主意，毕竟你是个$ct嘛！

是时候了，选择一个建筑作为努力的目标吧。
text.completion: Good on ya, mate! Not that there's a bad choice to be made, of course, but it's important to keep a positive attitude when surrounded by an infinite number of demons looking to kill ya.$B$BAs you gather additional supplies, come on back and I'll see they get assigned to the fortification of your choice.$B$BPhew! That was a mouthful, right? I'd say it's time for a pint.

english.title: Begin Construction
english.objectives: Use the Construction Table to donate Legionfall War Supplies to the construction of the Mage Tower, Nether Disruptor, or Command Center.
english.description:
We've got the supplies. Now someone needs to decide what to do with 'em.

Hmm. Looks like it's your call, being the $ct and all!

Time to pick a building to focus on.
english.completion: Отличный выбор! Не то чтобы остальные варианты плохие, просто я стараюсь не терять позитивный настрой – видишь ли, это очень важно, когда вокруг полным-полно демонов, мечтающих тебя прикончить.$b$bСоберешь еще припасов – возвращайся ко мне, и я прослежу, чтобы они пошли на пользу делу.$b$bФух! Напряженный выдался денек, да? Пора опрокинуть пару кружек.

text.title: 击垮军团
text.objectives: 在破碎海滩消灭100只恶魔。
text.description:
邪能风暴一直源源不断地将恶魔渣滓输送到海滩上。基尔加丹相信，他的大军无穷无尽，他的资源永不枯竭。

我们要让他看看，他错得有多么离谱。

冲进他们的阵地里去当中大杀四方吧，$ct。斩杀一只又一只的恶魔，让恶魔的鲜血浸透你的双手。让他们哭喊着求你饶命，让他们尖叫着滚回扭曲虚空。
text.completion: I have spent a lifetime hunting the wicked and making them pay for their crimes. When I strike a demon down, I feel a measure of justice has been served.$B$BYou have been an instrument of retribution this day, Huntmaster. Had you walked a different path, you might have made a worthy Warden.

english.title: Strike Them Down
english.objectives: Slay 100 demons on the Broken Shore.
english.description:
The Felstorm continues to rain demon scum upon these shores. Kil'jaeden believes his army infinite, his resources inexhaustible.

We will show him how wrong he is.

Cut a swath of retribution through their ranks, $ct. Strike down demon after demon, until your weapons are bathed in their blood. And when they cry out for mercy, send them screaming back into the Nether.
english.completion: I have spent a lifetime hunting the wicked and making them pay for their crimes. When I strike a demon down, I feel a measure of justice has been served.$B$BYou have been an instrument of retribution this day, Huntmaster. Had you walked a different path, you might have made a worthy Warden.

text.title: 保卫破碎群岛
text.objectives: 在破碎群岛击败一次恶魔突袭。
text.description:
虽然我们正在尽力从军团手中收复破碎海滩，但也不能让破碎群岛的其他地方落入军团的魔掌。

基尔加丹已经向破碎群岛各处派出了部队，威胁着你的新盟友的家园。在这个危急时刻，你必须回应他们的呼唤。

请迅速击退这些恶魔的突袭，$ct。抗魔联军会牢牢守住破碎海滩的。
text.completion: A fine victory, Archdruid.$B$BBut do not grow complacent! Fight back against the Legion wherever they strike.

english.title: Defending Broken Isles
english.objectives: Defeat a Legion Assault in the Broken Isles.
english.description:
In our zeal to reclaim the Broken Shore from the Legion, we cannot allow the rest of this land to fall into the demons' foul grip.

Kil'jaeden has dispatched his forces across the Broken Isles, threatening the homelands of the allies you have made. You must answer their call in this hour of need.

Turn back these demon assaults with haste, $ct. The Armies of Legionfall will see that the Broken Shore remains secured.
english.completion: Ты $gдобился:добилась; победы, |3-6($ct).$b$bНо расслабляться нельзя. Продолжай отбивать нападения Легиона.

text.title: 实现预言
text.objectives: 在破碎海滩完成8个世界任务。
text.description:
这辈子我看过无数幻象。有一些令我充满希冀……其他的则令人绝望。

我们距离战胜基尔加丹只有咫尺之遥，我已经预见到了。但是幻象只代表未来的方向，要成为现实，还需要努力。

这个重担就落在了你的肩上，$n。你已经付出了许多，但接下来还有更多的事情要做。在破碎海滩的战场上奋斗吧，我们要塑造一个没有燃烧军团的未来！
text.completion: Step by step, we march closer to victory. We must not relent!$B$BOnly through courage and persistence will we stop the insidious evil that threatens the soul of this world.

english.title: Self-Fulfilling Prophecy
english.objectives: Complete 8 World Quests on the Broken Shore.
english.description:
In my life, I have witnessed many visions. Some filled me with hope... others, with despair.

Victory over Kil'jaeden lies within our grasp. I have foreseen it. But visions only show us where our path might lead. They require effort to become reality.

That effort falls upon your shoulders, $n. You have done much, but more is needed. Fight on the battlefields of the Broken Shore and forge a destiny free from the Legion's grasp!
english.completion: Каждый шаг приближает нас к победе, но мы ни в коем случае не должны ослаблять давление на врага!$b$bТолько доблесть и упорство помогут нам окончательно одолеть зло, угрожающее сгубить саму душу нашего мира!

objectiveDetails.description: 在破碎海滩完成世界任务

text.title: 捍卫我们的事业
text.objectives: 在你的职业大厅成功完成1个抗魔联军任务。
text.description:
你的组织作出了卓越贡献，$ct。你的勇士们也多次成功击退了军团的入侵。

在我们为突袭萨格拉斯之墓做准备期间，也不能让恶魔站稳脚跟。我们要在所有战场上打击他们的气焰，我们还要寻找他们的弱点并加以利用。

派出你们组织的勇士吧，$n。他们的任务对我们这场战役的成败至关重要……尤其是在我们即将直面基尔加丹的关键时刻。
text.completion: Excellent work, Huntmaster! When this war is finally won, I believe I owe you and your order champions a banquet to honor your heroism.$B$BSay, that sounds like something that Odyn fellow would say. Not that I've met him myself, of course...

english.title: Championing Our Cause
english.objectives: Successfully complete a Legionfall mission at your Class Order Hall.
english.description:
Important work has been done by your order, $ct. Your champions have succeeded time and again in undermining the Legion's invasion.

As we make preparations for our assault on the Tomb of Sargeras, we need to keep the demons off balance. By pressuring them at every turn, we will expose vulnerabilities that can be exploited to our advantage.

Send out your order's champions, $n. Their missions are vital to the success of our campaign... especially as our confrontation with Kil'jaeden draws closer.
english.completion: Excellent work, Huntmaster! When this war is finally won, I believe I owe you and your order champions a banquet to honor your heroism.$B$BSay, that sounds like something that Odyn fellow would say. Not that I've met him myself, of course...

text.title: 擒贼擒王
text.objectives: 在破碎海滩消灭稀有精英恶魔指挥官。
text.description:
破碎海滩上挤满了燃烧军团的渣滓，每只恶魔都应该被碎尸万段。

但是有些恶魔特别狡猾。那些强大的恶魔集结了自己的手下，为他们的罪恶行径卖命。

击败这些恶魔勇士后，你就可以让他们的同类们闻风丧胆。摧毁燃烧军团的士气，就可以赢得这场战争。
text.completion: We must take every opportunity to shatter the will of Kil'jaeden's army.$B$BWhen they see their mightiest champions crumble to dust, they will realize that the vaunted Legion is doomed to fall.

english.title: Take Out the Head...
english.objectives: Slay Rare Elite Demon Commanders on the Broken Shore.
english.description:
The Broken Shore swims with Legion filth, each demon deserving of a swift and merciless end.

But some are more insidious than the rest. Powerful combatants rallying others to their perfidious cause.

Strike down these demon champions and you will fill the hearts of their kin with fear and doubt. Break the Legion's spirit and we will break its back.
english.completion: We must take every opportunity to shatter the will of Kil'jaeden's army.$B$BWhen they see their mightiest champions crumble to dust, they will realize that the vaunted Legion is doomed to fall.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭破碎海滩的稀有精英

text.title: 碎片收集时间
text.objectives: 在破碎海滩收集$1oa块虚空碎片。
text.description: 你肯定注意到了，恶魔死后会留下一些虚空碎片，那是扭曲虚空的能量结晶。我正在进行的实验需要大量的这种碎片……确切来说，是$1oa块。$b$b你干嘛要用那种眼神看着我？我们早就讨论过了吧，我仔细算过的。$b$b我需要的，不多不少，就是$1oa块碎片。少了不够，多了不行。$b$b不要质疑我的算法。快去吧！
text.progress: Do you have the shards? I hope you kept an accurate count. If you counted wrong, I simply can't be held responsible for the consequences.
text.completion: It has been pointed out to me that I can, on occasion, get a bit carried away.$B$BThis... <clears throat> might possibly have been one of those times.$B$BA single Nethershard will suffice for my purposes. I'm certain you can put the rest to good use.$B$BLet's not speak of this again.

english.title: Shard Times
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Nethershards on the Broken Shore.
english.description: As you have surely noticed, a slain demon leaves behind Nethershards, solidified residual energy from the Twisting Nether. I require a significant quantity of them for an experiment I'm conducting... $1oa shards, to be precise.$b$bWhy are you looking at me like that? We've had this conversation before. I did the math.$b$bI need exactly $1oa shards. Fewer would be inadequate. More would be absurd.$b$bDon't question my methods. Go!
english.progress: Ты $gсобрал:собрала; осколки Пустоты? Их ровно столько, сколько нужно? Если ты $gошибся:ошиблась;, я за последствия не отвечаю!
english.completion: Мне уже не раз говорили, что иногда меня немного заносит.$b$bВот и в этот раз... <прокашливается> я немного увлекся.$b$bВообще-то, для моих целей вполне достаточно одного осколка Пустоты. Не сомневаюсь, что ты найдешь остальным достойное применение.$b$bИ давай больше не будем поднимать эту тему.

text.title: 滋扰难容
text.objectives: 在法罗纳尔或者邪魂堡垒消灭50只恶魔。
text.description:
虽然破碎海滩的恶魔正在被我们一一清除，但是依然有恶魔盘踞在附近的地区。我们再也不能容忍他们的存在了。

法罗纳尔和邪魂堡垒的腐臭要塞滋扰着阿苏纳和苏拉玛。选一个进攻地点，削弱恶魔的军力。

等你的双手沾满恶魔的鲜血后再向我回报，然后我们再一起去把基尔加丹从那座古墓里赶出去。
text.completion: Thinning the ranks of demons in locations like Faronaar and Felsoul Hold cuts the legs out from under the Legion.$B$BKil'jaeden will fall!

english.title: Intolerable Infestation
english.objectives: Slay 50 demons in Faronaar or Felsoul Hold.
english.description:
While we purge Legion filth from the Broken Shore, the fiends maintain their hold on nearby lands. Their presence can no longer be tolerated.

The fetid strongholds of Faronaar and Felsoul Hold infest Azsuna and Suramar. Choose an attack point and cut a swath through their insidious ranks.

Return to me with demon blood on your hands, then we can resume our campaign to drive Kil'jaeden from the Tomb.
english.completion: Thinning the ranks of demons in locations like Faronaar and Felsoul Hold cuts the legs out from under the Legion.$B$BKil'jaeden will fall!

text.title: 创世之柱
text.objectives: 使用创世之柱封印萨格拉斯之墓。
text.description:
我们在破碎海滩的行动已经迎来一个转折点。抗魔联军已经准备好入侵萨格拉斯之墓，封印军团进入我们世界的通道。

进攻的时候到了，$n。

我们已经在大教堂中放置好了阿格拉玛之盾。护法者艾格文的回响说过，必须加上其它所有创世之柱才能封印墓穴。还是应该由你来把这些古老的神器放进各自的位置，永远终止这场邪能风暴。这是你应得的荣誉。
text.completion: The Pillars of Creation are in place. The Tomb of Sargeras is sealed, and Aegwynn's echo is at rest.$B$B<Khadgar gestures toward the sky.>$B$BUnfortunately, we do not have that luxury.$B$BThough you won a great victory this day, there is no time for revelry. The final battle awaits us. Make ready.

english.title: Pillars of Creation
english.objectives: Use the Pillars of Creation to seal the Tomb of Sargeras.
english.description:
Our campaign on the Broken Shore has reached a turning point. The Armies of Legionfall stand ready to breach the Tomb of Sargeras and seal the Legion's gateway to our world.

The time to strike is now, $n.

The Aegis of Aggramar has been secured in the Cathedral. The echo of Magna Aegwynn said that the other Pillars of Creation are needed to seal the tomb. It is fitting that you have the honor of locking those ancient relics in place and closing down the Felstorm once and for all.
english.completion: The Pillars of Creation are in place. The Tomb of Sargeras is sealed, and Aegwynn's echo is at rest.$B$B<Khadgar gestures toward the sky.>$B$BUnfortunately, we do not have that luxury.$B$BThough you won a great victory this day, there is no time for revelry. The final battle awaits us. Make ready.

text.title: 干扰X个不稳定的传送门，击败1个世界首领。

english.title: X Unstable Portals Disrupted, 1 World Boss Defeated

text.title: 找到X个宝箱，尝试1次挑战。
风暴后的宁静
text.objectives: 把末日石带给大漩涡的耐普图隆。
text.description: 你让元素免遭军团的控制，我们十分感激。但这是用你和你的萨满们的健康换来的，这代价实在过于惨痛。很多人都是遍体鳞伤，被他们的萨满同伴抬回来的。$b$b我们已经目睹了末日石的强大破坏力。它不属于任何生物，不管是凡人还是别的什么。在你昏睡时，我和元素领主商讨了如何处置它。$b$b把它带去耐普图隆那里吧，他会解释的。
text.completion: You have witnessed the destruction the Doomstone can wreak firsthand. You are a trusted warden of Azeroth, but even in your hands the power caused chaos and panic amongst your people. Imagine it in the control of someone with ill intent...$B$BWe cannot let that happen.$B$BWe discussed what to do with this artifact at length while we waited for you to awaken. We considered giving it a new home in one of the elemental planes, but each one provided its own danger.$B$BThere is no safer place for it than here.

english.title: The Calm After the Storm
english.objectives: Bring the Doomstone to Neptulon in the Maelstrom.
english.description: You have saved the elements from the Legion's control, and for that we thank you. However, it came at a great cost to both your health and your fellow shaman. Many came back to us wounded, dragged along by their fellow shaman.$b$bWe have seen the havoc the Doomstone can wreak. It does not belong in the hands of any being, mortal or otherwise. While you were asleep, the elemental lords and I discussed its fate.$b$bBring it to Neptulon. He will explain.
english.completion: Тебе довелось ощутить на себе, на какие разрушения способен Камень Рока. Ты – верный страж Азерота, но даже в твоих руках сила Камня привела к хаосу и панике. Представь, что будет, если им завладеет тот, чьи намерения не так чисты... $b$bМы не можем позволить этому случиться.$b$bВ ожидании твоего пробуждения мы обсудили, что делать с артефактом. Мы думали отправить его в одну из обителей стихий, но каждый вариант таил в себе опасность.$b$bДля Камня Рока нет более надежного хранилища, чем Сердце Азерота.

text.title: 黑暗使者的难题
text.objectives: 消灭黑暗使者艾丽萨丝。
text.description: 啊，是德拉丝派你来的，我明白了。$b$b幸好她没有亲自来。看到我们家族的遭遇，她一定会心碎的。$b$b有个恶魔正在附近的废墟里亵渎我们的死者。她在对我们的祖先使用邪能魔法，把他们变成无脑的恐魔来为燃烧军团效力。$b$b我没法对付鹰身人和这个恶魔，但你或许可以帮忙？$b$b消灭这个折磨我们的亡者的黑暗使者，月牙家族剩下的遗物随你挑选。
text.completion: You have my thanks, $n. The Moonfang family has certainly seen better days.

english.title: Darkbinder Dilemma
english.objectives: Kill Darkbinder Elissath.
english.description: Ah, Delas sent you. I see.$B$BIt's good she didn't come herself. It would break her heart to see what is happening to our family.$B$BA demon is defiling our dead in the ruins nearby. She's using her fel magic on our ancestors, turning them into mindless horrors that do the bidding of the Burning Legion.$B$BI can't deal with the harpies and this demon, but maybe you could help?$B$BGet rid of the darkbinder that torments our dead, and I will grant you access to whatever's left of the Moonfang family relics.
english.completion: You have my thanks, $n. The Moonfang family has certainly seen better days.

text.title: 融入暗影
text.objectives: 回到暗影大厅，与乔拉齐·拉文霍德公爵见面。
text.description: 我们该回去见议会的其他成员了，告诉他们我们今天的战绩。你有空时就回来吧。我们会等你的。
text.completion: We've been discussing your recent success, $n. We walk the shadows, and that often goes taken for granted. But without us, the Armies of Legionfall would have a great many more powerful demons to deal with.$B$BWe do not need the fame. We reap the rewards.

english.title: Meld Into the Shadows
english.objectives: Return to the Hall of Shadows, and meet Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.
english.description: We should meet back up with the rest of the council and tell them of what we have achieved this day. At your leisure, return to us. We shall be waiting.
english.completion: We've been discussing your recent success, $n. We walk the shadows, and that often goes taken for granted. But without us, the Armies of Legionfall would have a great many more powerful demons to deal with.$B$BWe do not need the fame. We reap the rewards.

text.title: 屠魔者归来
text.objectives: 向邪能之槌号上的考瓦斯复命。
text.description:
如果你是我，你肯定也更想呆在地面上！

不幸的是，你最好还是马上回到邪能之槌号上去，这样考瓦斯才能完成修理工作。
text.completion: Your quick blades have proven your worth to the Illidari yet again, Slayer $n. We will begin the repairs to the Fel Hammer immediately. $B$BWe cannot allow the Legion to catch us with our pants down again!

english.title: Return of the Slayer
english.objectives: Return to Kor'vas aboard the Fel Hammer.
english.description:
If you're anything like me, I'm sure you'd prefer to remain here on solid ground.

Unfortunately, it is probably best to return to the Fel Hammer right away so Kor'vass can finish the repairss.
english.completion: Твои клинки снова выручили иллидари, $gистребитель:истребительница; $n. Мы немедленно приступим к ремонту. $b$bМы больше не позволим Легиону застать нас врасплох!

text.title: 战争领主归来
text.objectives: 与苍穹要塞的奥丁谈一谈。
text.description:
战争领主$n，奥丁非常想听听你的辉煌胜利！

你准备好后，我会帮你返回苍穹要塞。
text.completion: Your return is triumphant indeed, Battlelord $n!$B$BUnder your leadership, the warriors of Skyhold are truly a force to be reckoned with!

english.title: Return of the Battlelord
english.objectives: Talk to Odyn in Skyhold.
english.description:
Battlelord $n, Odyn will want to hear the tale of your glorious victories here!

I will assist you in returning to Skyhold when you are ready.
english.completion: Your return is triumphant indeed, Battlelord $n!$B$BUnder your leadership, the warriors of Skyhold are truly a force to be reckoned with!

text.title: 重拾记忆
text.objectives: 把罗盘带给暴风要塞中的安度因·乌瑞恩国王。
text.description:
<这个小玩意精美的黄铜外壳上镶嵌着繁复的金银丝线，但是许多细致的花纹都被岩石和海浪磨蚀殆尽了。把锁扣上的尘垢和盐渍清理掉后，你终于把它打开了。>

这是个罗盘——或者说，至少曾经是。玻璃的表面已经碎裂，指针也已弯曲，无法动弹。

罗盘的盖子里有一张画像。颜料在水里泡了很久，已经褪色，但是画中人依然清晰可辨：这是安度因·乌瑞恩的年轻脸庞。>
text.progress: Well met, $n. What brings you to Stormwind this day?
text.completion: <As the king examines the compass, his expression turns from recognition to sorrow.>$B$BWhen I went through my father's things and didn't find this compass, I assumed it was with him on the Broken Shore when Gul'dan...$B$B<The king's voice breaks.>
text.completed: 把罗盘交给暴风要塞的安度因国王。

english.title: A Found Memento
english.objectives: Bring the compass to King Anduin Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.
english.description:
<The trinket's fine brass exterior is inlaid with intricate filigree, though much of the detail has been battered by rocks and waves. Clearing away the grime and salt encrusting the clasp, you manage to open it.

It is a compass--or was, at least. The glass face is shattered, the needle bent, unmoving.

Set into the lid is a portrait. The paint is faded and waterlogged, but the subject is unmistakable: the face of a young Anduin Wrynn.>
english.progress: Приветствую тебя, $n. Что привело тебя сегодня в Штормград?
english.completion:
<The king recognizes the compass at once, but the fleeting joy on his face is quickly replaced by sadness. >

When I was parsing my father's things and didn't find his compass among them, I assumed that he was there on the Cracked Beach when Gul'Dan...

< The king's voice is broken...>
english.completed: Bring the compass to King Anduin Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.

text.title: 应召前来
text.objectives: 前往暴风要塞，与吉恩·格雷迈恩见面。
text.description:
你好，$n，

宫廷要召见你。王室急需你的帮助！

请尽快赶回暴风城。

格雷迈恩国王正在等待你的到来。
text.completion: You've arrived at last, Huntmaster!$B$BYou may have noticed that King Anduin is conspicuous by his absence.$B$BThis is a situation that only you can rectify.
text.completed: 到暴风要塞与吉恩·格雷迈恩见面。

english.title: Summons to the Keep
english.objectives: Meet with Genn Greymane at Stormwind Keep.
english.description:
Greetings, $n.

Your presence has been requested in the royal court. The crown has urgent need of you!

Please return to Stormwind at your earliest convenience.

King Greymane is anticipating your swift arrival.
english.completion:
$n, you finally arrived!

As you can see, there is no King of Andoin.

You're the only one who can make this right.
english.completed: Meet with Genn Greymane at Stormwind Keep.

text.objectives: asdf
text.description: asdf

english.objectives: asdf
english.description: asdf

text.title: 安慰国王
text.objectives: 到暴风城大教堂寻找安度因·乌瑞恩国王。
text.description:
你把安度因父亲的罗盘带给他之后，他整个人都变了。他变得无精打采……心烦意乱。

我们努力安慰他，但没有用。昨天早上，他就离开了要塞，一句话都没有说。

当然，我派了守卫跟在他后面。他去了大教堂进行祈祷，然后就一直留在那里没有出来。

是你让他变得如此忧郁的！你必须去说服那个孩子继续履行自己的职责。眼下还有场战争要打呢！
text.completion: Let me guess... Genn sent you.$B$BI wonder which he's more concerned about... my well-being, or keeping up the appearance that everything is normal?

english.title: Consoling the King
english.objectives: Look for King Anduin Wrynn inside Stormwind Cathedral.
english.description:
Anduin hasn't been the same since you brought him his father's compass. He has become listless... distracted.

We attempted to console him, to no avail. Yesterday morning, he left the keep without so much as a word.

I ordered the guards to follow him, of course. He went to pray at the cathedral, where he's remained ever since.

You brought this melancholy upon him! You must convince the boy to resume his duties. There's a war to be won!
english.completion:
Let me guess ... Genn sent you, right?

Interestingly, he really worries about my state of mind - or does he just need everything to be "as expected"?

text.title: 王国之心
text.objectives: 陪伴安度因国王在暴风城里走走。
text.description:
我的父亲是个传奇。他曾经监督过暴风城的重建工作，与巨龙针锋相对过，还领导联盟获得过无数次胜利。

然后，有一天，他就……走了。

我虽然戴着他的王冠，继承了他的王位，但我没有为赢得这一切而付出过什么……也没有为赢得人民的信任而努力过。

在这场战争中，我一直把自己隔绝在那座要塞里，身边围满了卫兵和顾问。我要去暴风城的街道上走走，看看我的人民心中究竟怀着希望还是恐惧。

欢迎你与我同行。
text.completion: They're right. They're absolutely right.

english.title: A Kingdom's Heart
english.objectives: Accompany King Anduin on his walk through Stormwind.
english.description:
My father was a legend. He oversaw the rebuilding of Stormwind, stood toe-to-toe with dragons, led the Alliance to numerous victories.

Then, one day, he was just... gone.

I wear his crown, I hold his title. But I've done nothing to earn them... or the faith of my people.

I've spent the war sequestered in the keep, surrounded by guards and advisors. I need to walk the streets of Stormwind, to know whether it is hope or fear that beats in the hearts of my people.

I welcome your company.
english.completion: Они правы. Они все совершенно правы.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送安度因前往雄狮之眠

text.title: 王者之路
text.objectives: 与安度因国王一起前往萨格拉斯之墓。
text.description:
我现在亲眼见证了破碎海滩的战事，看到了燃烧军团带来的恐惧。真相打开了我的双眼。

我所说的真相并不是指敌人那难以想象的邪恶，而是指面对这样的邪恶力量时，我们的人民心中迸发出的大无畏的勇气与牺牲精神。

父亲曾经告诉我，每一个国王都必须承担自己头上王冠的重量。在这一刻，我感觉这顶王冠前所未有地沉重……

带我到父亲阵亡的地方去吧，让我向他的牺牲致敬。
text.completion: You have helped me more than I can say, $n. For that, you will always have my thanks.
text.completed: 与安度因国王一起前往萨格拉斯之墓。

english.title: The King's Path
english.objectives: Accompany King Anduin to the Tomb of Sargeras.
english.description:
Now that I have seen the Broken Shore and the terror of the Burning Legion first hand, my eyes have been opened to the truth.

I speak not of the unfathomable evil of the enemy, but of the bravery and sacrifice that such evil brings about in the hearts of our people.

My father once told me that every king must carry the weight of his own crown. Mine has never felt heavier than it does at this very moment...

Please take me to the place where my father died, so that I may honor his sacrifice.
english.completion: Ты даже не представляешь, как ты мне помог, Вержилий. За это я буду вечно тебе благодарен.
english.completed: Accompany King Anduin to the Tomb of Sargeras.

text.title: 7.2 Broken Shore - Buildings - Mage Tower - Personal Reward Received

english.title: 7.2 Broken Shore - Buildings - Mage Tower - Personal Reward Received

text.title: 抗魔联军物资
text.objectives: 完成破碎海滩的世界任务或者消灭破碎海滩的稀有精英，获得抗魔联军战争物资。
text.description:
如果不修筑几座大点的建筑的话，我们在破碎海滩的据点很快就会失守的。

但是，有我在，这样的情况就绝对不会发生，伙计！

我们已经开始修建三种关键建筑：法师塔、虚空干扰器和指挥中心。我们把燃烧军团揍扁的过程中，每种建筑都会扮演关键的角色。

为了完成建造，我们就需要抗魔联军战争物资……我的意思是，需要很多很多！你把这些物资带来给我，我来负责分配。明白了吗？
text.completion: That's what I'm talkin' about, mate!$B$BOi! Time to get to work.

english.title: Legionfall Supplies
english.objectives: Complete World Quests or slay Rare Elites on the Broken Shore to earn Legionfall War Supplies.
english.description:
If we don't build up some respectable fortifications, we'll lose our foothold on the Broken Shore.

That ain't gonna happen on my watch, mate!

We started construction on three key structures: the Mage Tower, the Nether Disruptor, and the Command Center. Each will play a key role in helping us pound the tar out of the Burning Legion.

To make progress, we need Legionfall War Supplies... and I mean lots of 'em! You bring 'em to me, and I'll handle distribution. Got it?
english.completion: Это то, что нужно!$b$bПора приниматься за работу.

objectiveDetails.description: 收集抗魔联军战争物资

text.title: 大魔法师归来
text.objectives: 与守护者圣殿的梅瑞尔谈一谈。
text.description:
达拉然重新得到了保护，我们也能稍微喘口气了。

我们该回守护者圣殿了。梅瑞尔肯定在焦急地等着我们胜利的消息。
text.completion: We must not forget that this is a temporary measure. I cannot overstate the devastation that will ensue if Kathra'natir escapes... $B$BStill, thanks to you, Dalaran's teeth are sharpened once more. Well done, Archmage $n!

english.title: Return of the Archmage
english.objectives: Speak to Meryl in the Hall of the Guardian.
english.description:
With Dalaran protected once again, we can all breathe a little easier. 

It is time for us to return to the Hall of the Guardian. I'm sure Meryl is anxiously awaiting word of our success.
english.completion: Мы ни на секунду не должны забывать о том, что это лишь временная мера. Если Катра'натир выберется на волю, это повлечет за собой разрушения колоссального масштаба... $b$bОднако благодаря тебе Даларан теперь снова в состоянии защитить себя. Отличная работа, верховный маг $n!

text.title: 死亡矿井反击战
text.objectives: 在死亡矿井击败曲奇的剩菜。
text.description:
布琳妮派你来的？只要是她，情报绝对不收一分钱。只是别告诉其他人是我说的。

这些年，我一直在死亡矿井地区游荡。大多数时候，这里的生活都风平浪静。但从几天前开始，我听到矿井里传来各种声音。如果你想悄无声息地溜进去，我可以弄辆矿车来，这样就能避开所有人的视线潜入矿井深处。

准备出发时，请告诉我。
text.completion: Someone took something from Cookies' cauldron? I'll report this to Breanni immediately. It seems the Wailing Caverns was not a singular incident. There is something big going on and I feel you have unknowingly stepped into the middle of it.

english.title: The Deadmines Strike Back
english.objectives: Defeat Cookies' Leftovers in the Deadmines.
english.description:
Breanni sent you? For her, info is always free. Just don't call me a snitch.

I've been hangin' around the Deadmines for years. For the most part, it's a pretty easy livin'. But a few days ago, I started hearing noises of all sorts comin' from the mines. If you want to get in unnoticed, I'll grab us a mine cart and we can get most of the way down without so much as an awkward glace in our direction.

Just let me know when you're ready to head in.
english.completion: Someone took something from Cookies' cauldron? I'll report this to Breanni immediately. It seems the Wailing Caverns was not a singular incident. There is something big going on and I feel you have unknowingly stepped into the middle of it.

objectiveDetails.description: 让马库斯·布朗带你进入死亡矿井

text.title: 宠物对战挑战：死亡矿井
text.objectives: 在死亡矿井击败曲奇的剩菜。
text.description:
死亡矿井仍然需要清理，你上次好像没有把这里清理干净。

我们还得再用一下那辆老矿车。但这次，我们要加点儿新花样。你觉得来点火怎么样？不行？好吧，那算了。你准备好就告诉我。
text.completion: Impressive work. Here's the supplies I promised you. I believe that shadowy figure left it behind.

english.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Deadmines
english.objectives: Defeat Cookies' Leftovers in the Deadmines.
english.description:
The Deadmines could still use some cleaning up, seems you didn't clear the place out last time.

We'll use the ol' mine cart trick again. Cept, we're going to put some flair into it. How do you feel about fire? No? Okay, fine. Just let me know when you're ready.
english.completion: Impressive work. Here's the supplies I promised you. I believe that shadowy figure left it behind.

text.title: 死亡矿井，第三部？
text.objectives: 在西部荒野的死亡矿井外找到“掮客”马库斯·布朗。
text.description:
我听说了关于死亡矿井异动的可疑谣言。经过哀嚎洞穴一役，我相信你是调查此事的最佳人选！

我在西部荒野有个朋友。他看上去可能不怎么样，但特别活络，而且对西部荒野的情况更加了解。我们已经解决范克里夫……两次了。所以矿井里到底是什么东西在捣鬼？
text.completion: I don't know nothing about nothing! Better get going before my shiv finds your face! Don't test me, cause I ain't all that bright!$B$BOh, Breanni? Yeah, sure! She's an old friend!

english.title: Deadmines, Part Three?
english.objectives: Find Marcus "Bagman" Brown outside the Deadmines in Westfall.
english.description:
I've heard suspicious rumors of movement in the Deadmines. After everything you pulled off in the Wailing Caverns, you'd be the perfect person to look into this!

I have a friend in Westfall. He may not look like much, but he's quick as a whip and may have more information on what is happening in Westfall. We've already dealt with the Van Cleefs... twice. So what could be making that sort of ruckus down there?
english.completion: I don't know nothing about nothing! Better get going before my shiv finds your face! Don't test me, cause I ain't all that bright!$B$BOh, Breanni? Yeah, sure! She's an old friend!

text.title: 压倒能量
text.objectives: 消灭$4oa个恶魔。
text.description: 我们将无法在这个世界上找到庇护之所，如今军团已倾尽全力防御阿古斯。$B$B下面那个布满恶魔渣滓的营地，就挡在我们和瞄准着维迪卡尔的武器之间。$B$B在它完成充能前，必须要把这些恶魔处理掉，否则阿古斯就会变成我们的葬身之地。
text.completion: Now for the main weapon.
text.completed: 与毁灭之冠的伊利丹见面。

english.title: Overwhelming Power
english.objectives: Kill $4oa demons.
english.description: We will find no sanctuary on this world. Even now the full might of the Burning Legion rises to defend Argus.$B$BThe siege camp below overflows with demon filth that stand between us and the weapon trained on the Vindicaar.$B$BThey must be dealt with before it can fully charge, or Argus will be our grave.
english.completion: Now let's get to the main gun.
english.completed: Meet Illidan Stormrage at the Crown of Destruction.

text.title: 托里姆之焰
text.objectives: 说服德克加尔祭坛守卫让你拿走托里姆之焰。
text.description: 就在不久前，德克加尔和托林尼尔巨龙还一直互相尊重。可自从斯科瓦尔德掌权后，这一切就变了。有个古老的德克加尔幽灵看守着这座山峰，这里似乎是片神圣的墓地。他是仪式火焰的守护者，而我们恰好需要这火焰来召唤龙母。$b$b我们去说服他交出火焰吧，好吗？相信他一定会……非常友善的。
text.completion: See? Totally convinced. Let's take this torch down to the beacon.

english.title: Thorim's Flame
english.objectives: Convince the Drekirjar Shrine-Keeper to let you take Thorim's Flame.
english.description: Not too long ago, the Drekirjar and the Thorignir respected each other. This only changed when Skovald came into power. An ancient Drekirjar spirit watches over this peak, which seems to be a sacred graveyard of some sort. He is the keeper of the ceremonial flame, which happens to be exactly what we need to call down the broodmother.$b$bWhy don't we go convince him to let us take the flame? I'm sure he'll be nothing but... amiable.
english.completion: You see that? You're convinced! Now let's take the torch to the lighthouse.

objectiveDetails.description: 说服德克加尔祭坛守卫

text.title: 复仇恶魔猎手：寻找考瓦斯
text.objectives: 在达拉然街道上找到考瓦斯·血棘。
text.description:
还好，在揭穿燃烧军团潜入城市的阴谋这件事上，我们并不是在孤军奋战。$b$b伊利达雷的考瓦斯·血棘正独自在城市街道中巡逻，想找出最近几次袭击的幕后主使。$b$b我并不是很信任你们这些家伙，但我承认你们至少还是对得起这个名号的。我建议你去找考瓦斯，看看她发现了些什么线索。绝对不能让燃烧军团再次发动攻击。

|cFF660000专精：复仇恶魔猎手|r
text.completion: Slayer $n, you're a sight for sore eyes.$B$BWe need to move quickly!

english.title: Vengeance: Seeking Kor'vas
english.objectives: Find Kor'vas Bloodthorn in the streets of Dalaran.
english.description:
Thankfully, we are not quite alone in uncovering the Legion's plots to infiltrate the city.$B$BOne of your Illidari, Kor'vas Bloodthorn, has taken to patrolling the city streets on her own to find the source behind the recent attacks.$B$BI do not entirely trust your kind, but I will concede that you have at least proved adept at your namesake. I suggest you find Kor'vas and see what she has uncovered before the Legion strikes once more.

|cFF660000Specialization: Vengeance Demon Hunter|r
english.completion: $gFighter:Slayer; $n! It's so good to see you! $B$BWe need to act as fast as we can!

text.title: 勇士：坎雷萨德·埃伯洛克
利爪的召唤
text.objectives: 与梦境林地的希萨莉·黑鸦谈一谈。
text.description:
军团再次向海加尔山的艾维娜圣殿发动了袭击！

希萨莉·黑鸦正在组织反击，她请求你立刻前往梦境林地。

我们会负责这里的战斗。祝你好运，大德鲁伊！
text.completion: Archdruid! We don't have much time, the shrine burns as we speak!

english.title: Talon's Call
english.objectives: Speak with Thisalee Crow in the Dreamgrove.
english.description:
The Legion is launching a renewed assault against the Shrine of Aviana in Hyjal!

Thisalee Crow is organizing a counter-offensive, she requests your presence in the Dreamgrove at once.

We will handle the offensive here. Good luck, Archdruid!
english.completion: Supreme Druid! We don't have much time - the sanctuary is in danger of destruction!

text.title: 保卫艾维娜
text.objectives: 协助希萨莉保卫海加尔山的艾维娜圣殿，然后回到梦境林地去向她复命。
text.description:
形势很危急。军团又在攻击海加尔山的艾维娜圣殿了！他们肯定是想要抢什么东西，但是我不清楚到底是什么。

我们利爪德鲁伊是优秀的斥候和渗透者，但是缺乏……长久作战的能力。他们坚持不了多久的！我们得去帮忙！
text.completion: The Legion will pay for what we've lost today. We escaped with as many of us as we could, but too many died in vain, trying to protect the Shrine and the Idol of Aviana, which was lost anyway, thanks to that demon scum, Shadegrove.

english.title: Defense of Aviana
english.objectives: Assist Thisalee in the defense of the Shrine of Aviana in Hyjal, then return to her in the Dreamgrove.
english.description:
The situation is dire. The Legion is attacking the Shrine of Aviana in Hyjal, AGAIN! They must be after something specific, but I'm not sure what.

Us Druids of the Talon are skilled scouts and infiltrators, but are lacking in... durability. They won't be able to hold out for long! We must go to help!
english.completion: Легион заплатит за все, чего мы сегодня лишились. Мы старались спасти всех, кого могли, но многие погибли напрасно, пытаясь защитить святилище и идол Авианы, который мы все равно потеряли из-за этого мерзавца Тенистой Рощи.

text.title: 别想夺走我的天空
text.objectives: 解决“暗影”伊法扎尔，然后取回艾维娜雕像。
text.description:
艾维娜圣殿已经落入恶魔手中，艾维娜雕像也被盗了。

艾维娜就是通过那座雕像来赐予利爪德鲁伊飞行能力的。

利爪德鲁伊已经决定在更安全的地方建造一座新的圣殿：就在梦境林地。

与此同时，我要去把我们的雕像夺回来。来阿苏纳找我吧，我们已经追踪到伊法扎尔了。如果你想帮忙的话，我们在那一带见。
text.progress: <Place the Corrupted Idol of Aviana on the pedestal.>
text.completion: You place the Corrupted Idol of Aviana on the pedestal.

english.title: You Can't Take the Sky from Me
english.objectives: Deal with Infazzar the Shade, and retrieve the Idol of Aviana.
english.description:
The Shrine of Aviana has fallen to the demons, and the Idol of Aviana has been stolen.

That idol acts as a link between the Druids of the Talon and the powers of flight granted to us by Aviana.

The Druids of the Talon have decided to rebuild a new shrine in a more secure location: here in the Dreamgrove.

Meanwhile, I'm going to get our idol back. Meet me in Azsuna, near where we've tracked Infazzar to, if you want to help.
english.progress: <You put Aviana’s defiled idol on a pedestal.>
english.completion: You place the Corrupted Idol of Aviana on the pedestal.

text.title: 痊愈的希望
text.objectives: 返回五晨寺，向酒仙布兰琪的灵魂复命。
text.description:
但愿你找到了足够的邪能毒药样本，我们要用它们来调制解药。

我们五晨寺见吧！
text.completion: Hmm let me take a look... Yes, I think I can counter these!

english.title: Hope For a Cure
english.objectives: Return to the Spirit of Brewmaster Blanche in the Temple of Five Dawns.
english.description:
Hopefully you found enough fel poison samples with which to brew a cure.

Let's meet back to the Temple of Five Dawns!
english.completion: Хм... давай-ка посмотрим... Да, думаю, я смогу нейтрализовать яд.

text.title: 海盗湾
text.objectives: 前往阿苏纳的亡者海湾，与莉莉安·沃斯和特塞斯会面。
text.description: 我们在破碎海滩取得了一些进展，我觉得现在该让无冕者的精妙战术登场了。$b$b我们得到消息说，主岛屿外有个巨大的洞穴，一些强大的恶魔正聚集在那里，密谋毁灭我们。我们的一位潜行者，莉莉安·沃斯已经跟特塞斯制定出了一个计划，但是他们需要你帮忙才能成功。他们正在阿苏纳的亡者海湾等你。
text.completion: Finally... my time to shine. Let's do this right.

english.title: The Pirate's Bay
english.objectives: Meet up with Lilian Voss and Tethys at Dead Man's Bay in Azsuna.
english.description: While we've made some progress on the Broken Shore, I think it is time for the more subtle tactics of the Uncrowned.$b$bWe've received word of a large cave off the main island, where powerful demons meet to plot our downfall. One of our rogues, Lilian Voss, has formulated a plan with Tethys to take care of them, but they require your aid. They are waiting for you at Dead Man's Bay in Azsuna.
english.completion: Наконец-то пришло мое время! Мы должны преуспеть.

text.title: 邪能火药箱
text.objectives: 消灭神枪手派瑞克丝，获得灌注邪能的火药箱。
text.description: 我们的目标是获得一箱灌注了某种邪能的火药。我不知道这里海盗是怎么弄到的，但这种火药远比他们想象的还要危险。我向你保证，它在我们手里会更……有用。$b$b神枪手派瑞克丝应该就在海湾后头的沙滩上。把我们想要的东西从她手上抢过来吧。
text.progress: Did you get it?
text.completion: Yes... the gunpowder. It is the key to my plan!

english.title: What's the Cache?
english.objectives: Kill Master Gunner Prix and obtain the Fel-Infused Gunpowder Cache.
english.description: Our goal is to retrieve a cache of gunpowder which has been infused with some sort of fel power. I don't know how the pirates here acquired it, but it is more dangerous than they know. I assure you that it will be more... effective in our hands.$b$bMaster Gunner Prix should be toward the back of the cove, near the water. Take what we need from her.
english.progress: Ну что, $gдостал:достала;?
english.completion: Порох у нас... отлично! Он сыграет ключевую роль в моем плане.

text.title: 伪造的指令
text.objectives: 把伪造的指令放在指定的地方。
text.description: 我们得先采取一些预防措施。只要你成功刺杀了那个神枪手，她的同伙就会来找你的。我让特塞斯模仿她的笔迹伪造了一些指令，它们应该可以为我们争取一点时间。$b$b把伪造的指令放在指定的位置。这样就可以化险为夷了。
text.completion: They left with such purpose... fools.

english.title: False Orders
english.objectives: Plant the False Orders in the marked locations.
english.description: We must take some precautions. As soon as you assassinate the gunner, the crew will be looking for you. I had Tethys forge some orders in her handwriting that should buy us some time.$b$bPlant the orders in the marked locations. That will take care of the danger.
english.completion: Они рванули на выход с такой скоростью... кретины.

objectiveDetails.description: 放置第二批伪造的指令
放置第一批伪造的指令

text.title: 乔拉齐的召唤
text.objectives: 返回暗影大厅，向乔拉齐·拉文霍德公爵复命。
text.description: 这样一来，我第一阶段的计划就完成了。我们回去找乔拉齐吧，告诉他可以继续了。
text.completion: Welcome back, Shadowblade. I assume you've retrieved the gunpowder?

english.title: Jorach's Calling
english.objectives: Return to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt in the Hall of Shadows.
english.description: And with that, the first phase of my machination is complete. Let's return to Jorach and tell him it is time to continue.
english.completion: С возвращением, |3-6($ct). Я так понимаю, тебе удалось достать порох?

text.title: 暗影契约
text.objectives: 前往达拉然地下的守护者大厅与雷特森·焰怒见面。
text.description:
从你拼凑起来的线索看，莱维娅是想在达拉然下面的图书馆举行仪式，很可能就是为了召唤这个她迷恋的“阿加莎”。这件事恐怕有点超出我的能力范围了，所以我得请人来帮忙。

我会请求黑暗收割议会来帮忙。他们的一个术士会去守护者大厅见你，协助你进行调查。

但愿我们还来得及。
text.completion: You are lucky that Modera contacted me for assistance. $B$BAgatha is beyond you, $C. She is beyond any of us.

english.title: Bargaining with Shadows
english.objectives: Meet Ritssyn Flamescowl in the Chamber of the Guardian beneath Dalaran.
english.description:
From the clues you've been able to piece together, it appears that Levia was looking to conduct a ritual in the libraries beneath Dalaran - most likely to summon this "Agatha" she has become so infatuated with. I'm afraid this is a little out of my area of expertise, so I'm going to have to call in a favor.

I'll send for assistance from the Council of the Black Harvest. One of their warlocks will meet you in the Chamber of the Guardian to assist with your investigation.

I hope we're not too late.
english.completion:
Тебе повезло, что Модера обратилась ко мне за помощью. 

Агата тебе не по зубам, |3-6($c). Да и никому из нас не справиться с ней в одиночку.

text.title: 岩架上的生活
text.objectives: 返回邪能之槌号，与主母玛沃伦丝谈一谈。
text.description: 屠魔者$p，主母玛沃伦丝请你回邪能之槌号见她一面。请你方便时尽快去见她。
text.completion: Slayer $n, I have something I would like to speak with you about when you have a moment.

english.title: Livin' on the Ledge
english.objectives: Return to the Fel Hammer and speak with Matron Mother Malevolence.
english.description: Slayer $p, Matron Mother Malevolence requests an audience with you back at the Fel Hammer. Please see her at your earliest convenience.
english.completion: $gFighter:Slayer; $p, I need to talk to you about something when you have a minute.

text.title: 邪能之旅
text.objectives: 与凯拉·光刃谈一谈，飞往邪翼岩架，然后完成邪翼岩架场景战役。
text.description: 马顿充满了秘密，我们在夺取了邪能之槌号后不久就发现了其中一个。那是个繁育地之类的地方，里面挤满了魔蝠。$b$b我们一直在捕捉这些幼崽，想将它们训练成对抗军团的战力。$b$b但是有一天，我们抓到了一个大家伙，一份能配得上你地位的大礼，屠魔者。$b$b去跟凯拉谈一谈吧，她会送你去岩架的。
text.completion: Never would I have thought an adult fel bat could be tamed, but your efforts seemed to have prove otherwise. This is a promising revelation for us.$B$BBut for now, let all see what you have accomplished.

english.title: To Fel and Back
english.objectives: Speak with Kyra Lightblade to secure a ride to Felwing Ledge. Then complete the Felwing Ledge scenario.
english.description: Mardum has its fair share of secrets, one of which we found not too long after we took control of the Fel Hammer. It's a breeding ground of sorts, festering with fel bats.$b$bWe've been capturing the pups and trying to train them up for our efforts against the Legion.$b$bBut the other day, we caught an even greater prize, something worthy of your position, Slayer.$b$bSpeak with Kyra and she'll provide you a ride to the ledge.
english.completion: Я была уверена, что взрослые сквернотопыри совершенно не поддаются дрессировке, однако тебе удалось доказать обратное. Это открытие может стать очень полезным для нас.$b$bПора и тебе получить заслуженную награду.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“邪翼岩架”场景战役

text.title: 提瑞斯秘法会的宝库
text.objectives: 在守护者圣殿找到5个古代神器。
text.description:
达拉然的武器源于奥术，但这不等于我们就不能试试别的。

提瑞斯秘法会的宝库里存放了大量的魔法器具……去看看里面有没有我们用得上的东西，好吗？
text.progress: Have you found anything promising?
text.completion: Now that's quite the eclectic collection if I ever saw one!$B$BThese are all powerful in their own way to be sure, but none are useable for our needs. At least not in their current form.$B$BI wonder...

english.title: The Vault of the Tirisgarde
english.objectives: Find 5 Ancient Artifacts within the Hall of the Guardian.
english.description:
Dalaran's weapons are arcane in origin, but that doesn't mean we can't try something different. 

Our order's vaults contain a vast store of magical devices... Why don't you take a look around and see if there's anything we can use?
english.progress: Ну что, удалось отыскать что-нибудь интересное?
english.completion: What a selection! Hmm... each of these things certainly have their uses, but they are unlikely to benefit us. Anyway, in its present form. Although...

text.title: 金色的信
text.objectives: 阅读神射手营地里的金色的信。
text.description:
狩猎大师，我们得到神射手营地的消息，说是有一封用金光铸造的信正放在一张桌子上，而且上面还写着你的名字。

谁都不知道那封信是怎么出现的，有个猎人的狼想去咬开那封信，结果满嘴的毛都被烧焦了。看来只有你才能打开这封信。

你前去调查的时候，我们会守住堡垒。
text.completion: <You gingerly pick up the shimmering letter and open it.>

english.title: A Golden Ticket
english.objectives: Read the Golden Letter in Trueshot Lodge.
english.description:
Huntmaster, we've gotten word from the Lodge that there is a letter wrought from golden light sitting on one of the tables, and it's got your name on it.

No one is sure how it got there, and someone's wolf may have tried to open it and gotten a mouth full of singed fur. Seems like it's meant only for you.

We'll hold down the fort here while you investigate.
english.completion: < You gently take a glowing envelope and open it. >

text.title: 荒野之夜
text.objectives: 与奥丁的使徒交谈，让她带你前往永恒猎场。
text.description:
<这封信的笔迹流动着金光。你在阅读的时候几乎可以听到奥丁的声音在你耳边轰隆作响。>

荒野之夜即将到来。

今晚，我们会设宴纪念传说的野兽。而它们会再度在永恒猎场现身。

在我们当中，会有一个人进入荒野，再度让它们的灵魂安息。

如果你想加入我们的话，我的使徒在等你，猎人。
text.completion: <An empty saddle sits here, as if it is waiting for your new companion.$B$BYou feel a warm kinship with the beast as you recall your meeting. and you know what you must do to call the Wolfhawk. You put your fingers to your lips...>

english.title: Night of the Wilds
english.objectives: Ask the Herald of Odyn to take you to the Fields of the Eternal Hunt.
english.description:
<The letter is written in a flowing, golden script. You can practically hear Odyn's booming voice speak the words as you read it.>

The Night of the Wilds is upon us. 

Tonight, we will feast in honor of the beasts of legend, and they will rise once more in the Fields of the Eternal Hunt.

One among us will set out into the fields to put their spirits to rest once more. 

My herald awaits you, hunter, if you will join us.
english.completion: <The empty saddle feels like it's waiting for your new companion. $B$BByou remember meeting the beast, and it's like a wave of heat is pumping you. Now you know what you have to do to summon the beast hawk. You are preparing to whistle... >

objectiveDetails.description: 让使徒带你前往永恒猎场

text.title: 创意方案
text.objectives: 和艾丽对话。
text.description:
夜之子灵魂石是我们最大的希望了。只要我们想出能够安全地使用它而又不会让卡萨纳提尔逃出来的方法就行。如果他在达拉然失去控制……

我们应该与我们的朋友艾丽讨论一下。她应该知道需要对灵魂石进行什么改造。
text.completion: So word has gotten out about Ryanna already? Ha!

english.title: A Creative Solution
english.objectives: Talk to Ari.
english.description:
The Nightborne Soulstone may be our best hope if we can come up with a way to safely use it without Kathra'natir escaping. If he were to get loose in Dalaran...

We should consult with our friend, Ari. She will know what modifications need to be done.
english.completion: Так о Рианне уже все знают? Ха!

text.title: 钥匙管理者奥里斯
text.objectives: 消灭钥匙管理者奥里斯，并搜索他的尸体。
text.description:
邪脉叛军似乎在前面的林地里看守着一个传送器。不知道这个传送器可以通向哪里？

我们大概得干掉钥匙管理者奥里斯才能进去。
text.progress: Did you find anything?
text.completion: This appears to be some sort of attunement crystal. Perfect.

english.title: Keymaster Orlis
english.objectives: Kill Keymaster Orlis and search his body.
english.description:
The Felborne insurgents appear to be guarding a teleporter pad within the glade ahead. I wonder where it leads?

It is probably safe to assume that we'll need to kill Keymaster Orlis in order to gain access.
english.progress: Удалось что-нибудь отыскать?
english.completion: Судя по всему, это что-то вроде направляющего кристалла. Превосходно.

text.title: 大门紧闭
text.objectives: 向达拉然的紫罗兰城堡的大法师卡德加复命。
text.description:
一定要在希格林与奥丁对峙之前追上她，但是我们的路被堵住了。奥丁发现希格林入侵后，就会关闭勇者之门。要想进入英灵殿的话，你得另寻他法了。

我在传送门方面没有什么天赋，但是你在肯瑞托的朋友们似乎对此非常精通。请去找他们吧，让他们找到进去的方法。

感谢你一路对希格林的帮助，$c。我只希望我们能让她不要再迷失自我了。
text.completion: So the daughter of Skovald followed in her father's footsteps? A pity, but it may have been inevitable. I believe this may be the "fall" the scrolls mentioned.$B$BIf this is true, there may still be hope! I will work on a way to get us into the Halls of Valor to pursue this Sigryn. I will be in touch when we find a way.$B$BIn the meantime, you have done a great service to bring her this far. I would not let that go unrewarded.

english.title: The Gates Are Closed
english.objectives: Return to Archmage Khadgar at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
english.description:
Sigryn must be reached before she can confront Odyn, but our path is blocked. Odyn will close the Gates of Valor as soon as he becomes aware of Sigryn's assault. You will have to find another way into the Halls.

I have no talent with portals, but your friends at the Kirin Tor seem to be very adept. Go now to them, and find a way though.

I thank you for what you've done to help Sigryn this far, $c. I only hope we can save her from herself.
english.completion:
Значит, дочь Сковальда пошла по стопам своего отца? Жаль, хотя, скорее всего, это было неизбежно. Но, быть может, это и есть то самое "падение", о котором упоминается в свитках?

Если так, надежда еще остается! Я пока подумаю, как нам проникнуть в Чертоги Доблести вслед за этой Сигрин. Когда мы найдем способ сделать это, я свяжусь с тобой.

Да – и спасибо тебе, что $gпомог:помогла; ей пройти этот путь. За это тебе полагается награда.

text.title: 班禄的故事
text.objectives: 聆听卜大师的故事。
text.description:
噢，你好，你一定就是新晋的大宗师了。

<卜大师眯着眼打量了一下你，然后抽了抽鼻子。>

现在你们这些年轻人都没什么耐心，总是急匆匆地跑去参加自以为了不起的战争。

从来没时间听故事，不管故事有多棒，是吧？

你不妨暂时把拳头放下，让一个老人给你讲个故事。

而且顺便给那个老人买点喝的？
text.completion: Thank you for listening, and for paying for this beverage.

english.title: The Tale of Ban-Lu
english.objectives: Listen to Master Bu's story.
english.description:
Oh, hello, you must be the new Grandmaster.

<Master Bu squints at you and sniffs.>

You young ones have no patience these days, always running off to fight your great battles.

No time for stories, even good ones, eh?

Why don't you put your fists down for a moment and allow an old man to tell you a tale.

Maybe buy an old man a drink while you are at it?
english.completion: Thank you for listening, and for paying for this beverage.

text.title: 回到破碎之峰
text.objectives: 与晴日峰的卜大师见面。
text.description:
当然，这可不只是个故事。班禄向来是历代大宗师的私人坐骑，一直都在旅途中陪伴他们，是忠实的好伙伴。

可是……从你成为大宗师到现在，他一直没有露面。这就麻烦了。

上次有人看到他，是在晴日峰，大宗师海特去世后。

我们就从那里开始搜索吧。
text.completion: A senseless loss of life, and for what?$B$B<Master Bu looks heavily at the portal and shakes his head.>

english.title: Return to the Broken Peak
english.objectives: Meet Master Bu at the Peak of Serenity.
english.description:
Of course, this is no mere story. Ban-Lu served as the personal mount of each of the previous Grandmasters, accompanying them through their travels as a faithful and trusted companion.

But... he has not revealed himself since you have become Grandmaster. This is troubling.

The last time he was seen was at the Peak of Serenity, after the fall of Grandmaster Hight.

It is there that we must begin our search for him.
english.completion: Сколько бессмысленных смертей... И во имя чего?$B$B<Мастер Бу угрюмо смотрит на портал и качает головой.>

text.title: 班禄的足迹
text.objectives: 追寻班禄的足迹。
text.description:
大宗师海特曾经行走在这片土地上，现在回想起来仿佛是上辈子的事情了。

虽然班禄服侍过之前的历代大宗师，但他与海特的情谊却是最深的。

许多年来，他们在这片土地上四处旅行，与这里的人民交流，维系我们脆弱的和平。

我无法想像，他的逝去令班禄的内心受到了多大的冲击。

这附近一定有关于他的去向的线索，仔细找找。
text.completion: These old bones just need a little rest. But we appear to be one step further on our journey.$B$BThat grummle over there looks like he could use some assistance. Why don't you talk to him while I get some rest?

english.title: The Trail of Ban-Lu
english.objectives: Follow the trail of Ban-Lu.
english.description:
It seems a lifetime ago that Grandmaster Hight was walking these grounds. 

While Ban-Lu has served every previous Grandmaster, he and Hight were the greatest of friends.

For many years they traveled the land, connecting with its people and maintaining our fragile peace.

I cannot imagine how deeply Ban-Lu must have been affected by his passing.

There must be some clues to his whereabouts around here. Look sharply.
english.completion: Старым костям нужен отдых. Но мы продвинулись еще на шаг вперед в наших поисках.$B$BКажется, вон тому груммелю нужна помощь. Поговори с ним, а я пока немного передохну.

text.title: 发臭的土山头的幸运符
text.objectives: 收集发臭的土山头的幸运符的3个残片。
text.description:
你！请帮我！愚蠢的猢狲偷走了发臭的土山头的幸运符！

现在，发臭的土山头总是很倒霉。刚才我回过头才发现，背包着火了。

但我不会把火扑灭，因为这样做的话，其他倒霉的事情就又会发生。也许那件事会倒霉得多！

你能打败猢狲，把我的幸运符拿回来吗？发臭的土山头会尽全力帮助你的！
text.progress: Find my luckydo yet? Getting kind of hot here.
text.completion: Smelly has a new idea! Leave his pack on fire!$B$BNothing else bad happen while pack on fire! Pack on fire IS Smelly's new luckydo! You keep old one.$B$BOh, you looking for big tiger? Smelly saw big glowy tiger. Went towards monastery. Smelly was helpful?

english.title: Smelly's Luckydo
english.objectives: Collect 3 parts of Smelly's Luckydo.
english.description:
You! Please help! Stupid hozen stole Smelly's luckydo! 

Now, Smelly always unlucky. Just turned around and look, pack is on fire.

Not going to put fire out because then something ELSE unlucky happen. Maybe something worse!

You beat up hozen, yes? Get back luckydo? Smelly will help you, any way he can!
english.progress: Ну что, $gнашел:нашла; мою удачку? Мне уже становится жарко.
english.completion: У Вонючки есть идея! Пусть рюкзак горит!$B$BТогда больше не случится ничего плохого! Горящий рюкзак будет новой удачкой Вонючки! А старую оставь себе.$B$BТы, кажется, $gискал:искала; большого тигра? Вонючка видел большого сияющего тигра. Он направлялся к монастырю. Вонючка помог?

objectiveDetails.description: 收集发臭的土山头的幸运符残片

text.title: 进入马蜂窝
text.objectives: 使用传送板。
text.description: 我希望你准备好冒险了。我们要不要看看那个传送板通向哪儿？
text.completion: I think we have stumbled upon their headquarters. Be careful in here!

english.title: Into the Hornet's Nest
english.objectives: Use the teleporter pad.
english.description: I hope you are up for an adventure. Shall we see where that teleporter goes?
english.completion: Кажется, мы попали прямиком в штаб врага. Нужно соблюдать осторожность!

text.title: 班禄之影
text.objectives: 与影踪禅院的卜大师见面。
text.description:
大宗师，你帮助了发臭的土山头，真是个好心人。而且我们也对班禄的命运有了更多的了解。

我就不劳烦你陪我去影踪禅院了。我自己能行。

我们到那儿见吧，然后我们再继续搜索。
text.completion: I've just begun my meditation, Grandmaster. But we may have another lead...

english.title: The Shadow of Ban-Lu
english.objectives: Meet Master Bu at the Shado-Pan Monastery.
english.description:
That was good of you to assist Smelly Mountaintop, Grandmaster, and we have learned more about the fate of Ban-lu.

I won't bother you with escorting me to Shado-Pan Monastery. I can manage on my own.

Meet me there and we'll continue our search.
english.completion: I've just begun my meditation, Grandmaster. But we may have another lead...

text.title: 清理煞魔
text.objectives: 帮助指挥官沈利处理残余的煞魔。
text.description:
我跟影踪派谈过了，他们愿意告诉我们情报，只要我们能帮助他们完成他们的任务。

与指挥官沈利谈一谈。你帮助他们时，我会继续冥想。
text.completion: The Shado-pan appear greatful, Grandmaster.$B$BShall we cont... what is that black residue on your foot?

english.title: Clean-up on Aisle Sha
english.objectives: Help Commander Shen-Li with the remaining Sha.
english.description:
I've spoken with the Shado-pan and they are willing to give us information if we can assist them with a task of their own.

Speak with Commander Shen-Li. While you're assisting them, I shall continue to meditate.
english.completion: Шадо-Пан благодарны тебе, великий мастер.$b$bМы можем продо... а что это такое черное у тебя на ноге?

text.title: 水语班禄
text.objectives: 与东南面的水语者云离见面。
text.description:
我们还是不知道班禄去哪儿了，但是有人也许知道。

东南边住着一个锦鱼人，叫水语者云离。

也许他看到过班禄，又或者，可以请他询问河流，了解班禄最近的去向？

这趟旅途下来，我这把老骨头实在消受不起，大宗师。我得在这里多歇会儿，然后再来找你。
text.completion: Greetings. It is not every day that a Grandmaster $C comes to visit me. How can I be of service?

english.title: The River to Ban-Lu
english.objectives: Meet with Waterspeaker Ryuli to the southeast.
english.description:
We still do not know where Ban-Lu has gone to, but I do know who might.

To the southeast lives a jinyu, Waterspeaker Ryuli.

Perhaps he has seen Ban-Lu, or can ask him to inquire with the river about where Ban-Lu has been seen recently?

All this travel has done a number on my old joints, Grandmaster. I shall rest here a bit longer, and then catch up with you later on.
english.completion: Приветствую. Не каждый день ко мне великие мастера в гости захаживают. Чем я могу помочь?

text.title: 给云离的百合
text.objectives: 为水语者云离收集$1oa朵月光百合。
text.description:
我没有看到过班禄，但是水流定然知道他在哪里。

白虎寺旁边的山坡上有湖，湖上生长着一种花，只有心灵纯净的人到访时才会开放。

请帮我找六朵这种月光百合，我会使用它们与河流对话。
text.progress: How goes the Moon Lily collection, Grandmaster?
text.completion: Thank you. Allow me to search for answers for you.

english.title: Lilies for Ryuli
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Moon Lilies for Waterspeaker Ryuli.
english.description:
I have not seen Ban-Lu, but the waters will surely know where he is.

There is a flower that grows in the lakes of the mountain slopes near the Temple of the White Tiger, that only blooms in the presence of someone pure of heart.

Bring me six of these Moon Lilies and I shall use them to speak to the river.
english.progress: Ну что, ты $gнарвал:нарвала; лунных лилий, великий мастер?
english.completion: Спасибо. Сейчас я попробую получить нужные тебе ответы.

text.title: 班禄的试练
text.objectives: 在瀑布下方找到班禄。
text.description:
啊，我在水流中感受到了强烈的涟漪！水滴落下的位置距离我们并不遥远。

班禄离我们很近。

<云离闭上双眼，把百合放进水中。它们缓缓漂向了东面。>

他正在等你，就在东面的瀑布下方。
text.completion: It will be my honor to carry you on the ceremonial path from this shrine to the temple, as I have done for the Grandmasters before you.
text.completed: 回到迷踪岛的心光神龛，与班禄见面。

english.title: The Trial of Ban-Lu
english.objectives: Find Ban-Lu at the bottom of the waterfall.
english.description:
Ah, the ripples I feel in the water are strong! The droplet does not fall far from our location.

Ban-Lu is quite close. 

<Ryuli closes his eyes and releases the lilies into the water. They drift slowly to the east.>

He waits for you now, at the bottom of the waterfall to the east.
english.completion: Я почту за честь отнести тебя от святилища к храму, как когда-то носил твоих предшественников.
english.completed: Return to Ban-Lu at the Shrine of Inner-Light on the Wandering Isle.

text.title: 天知地知，你知我知
text.objectives: 向守护者圣殿的艾丽复命。
text.description:
你找到的护盾发生器虽然其貌不扬，但却非常厉害。我觉得我的长者不会同意与外来者分享如此先进的技术……

但是……我们的性命，我们的自由，我们欠你太多。

你可以使用它，我祝福你。只是……不要太张扬，大法师$n。
text.completion: What is this?$B$BThis is not just any old shield generator - it is almost... a sentient entity...$B$BAnd it is very eager for a job to do. Yes, I think it will be quite content to work with us.

english.title: Keep it Secret, Keep it Safe
english.objectives: Return to Ari in the Hall of the Guardian.
english.description:
The shield generator you found is much more than it appears. I do not think my elders would approve of such advanced technology being shared with outlanders...

And yet... We owe you our lives and our freedom. 

You may use it, with my blessing. Just... please be discreet about its existence, Archmage $n.
english.completion: Что это такое?$b$bЭто не простой генератор защитного поля... это же практически... разумное создание!$b$bИ, похоже, оно очень хочет заняться своим делом. Мне кажется, мы с ним сработаемся!

text.title: 神秘大师
text.objectives: 与五晨寺外晨息村的卜大师见面。
text.description:
你好。我刚刚得知，卜大师已经从一次漫长的灵魂之旅归来，目前他正在五晨寺外的晨息村歇脚。

已经很久没有人看到过他，或者听过他的消息了，但是他指名要求与你面谈。

你不在这里的时候，我们会处理这里的情况，大宗师。
text.completion: Thank you for coming, Grandmaster.

english.title: Master Who?
english.objectives: Meet Master Bu at Morning Breeze Village outside Temple of the Five Dawns.
english.description:
Greetings. I've just received word that Master Bu has returned from a long spirit journey, and is currently resting his feet at Morning Breeze Village outside of the Temple of Five Dawns.

It's been quite a long time since anyone has seen or heard from him, but he's asking to speak to you.

We will handle the situation here while you are absent, Grandmaster.
english.completion: Спасибо, что $gоткликнулся:откликнулась; на зов, великий мастер.
