text.title: 区区蜘蛛
text.objectives: 在惊悚洞穴寻找传闻中的宝箱。
text.description:
我依然感觉自己全身都是蜘蛛。我只不过是挤扁了一个蛋，忽然之间，我从头到脚就全都爬满了小蜘蛛。

<颤抖>。

那个宝箱现在就在那里。下一个人最好不要有恐蜘……惧蜘？恐蛛？就是怕蜘蛛！
text.progress: I'm always lookin' for more treasure!
text.completion: Oh, look here! You went and got that treasure! Hey... You still got a spider on your shoulder.$B$BLets see what fantastic treasure you brought me... This is it? This is worthless! Here you keep it.$B$BTough break, kid. Keep at it.

english.title: Spiders, Huh?
english.objectives: Look for the rumored treasure in the Creeping Grotto.
english.description:
I feel like they're still crawling all over me. I squished one egg and all of a sudden I'm covered head to toe in baby spiders.

<Shivers>.

That treasure is just sitting there now. The next guy better not be arachnaphlipic... arachnaphonetic? Arachniphant? Afraid of spiders!
english.progress: Сокровищ много не бывает!
english.completion: Ого! Ты все-таки $gпошел:пошла; за сокровищем! Ой... У тебя паук на плече.$B$BДай-ка взглянуть на твою фантастическую добычу. И это все? Это же ничего не стоит! Оставь себе.$B$BНе везет так не везет. Но не вешай нос.

text.title: Tomb of Sargeras: Legend of the Deep

english.title: Tomb of Sargeras: Legend of the Deep

text.title: 盗墓
text.objectives: 在幽灵废墟寻找传闻中的宝箱。
text.description: 我不是盗墓贼，但是如果宝箱放在满是白骨的土地上，那事实上这就是盗墓了吧？并不是说只要没埋在地下就没关系了。为了以防万一，我还是在一边呆着好了。
text.progress: I'm always lookin' for more treasure!
text.completion: You found a key in a chest? Nothing else?$B$BI'm guessing the last guy took all the goods, then accidentally locked the key in the chest. So, you just found a key to a chest that you've already looted. Fantastic work... And people say I suck at this job.

english.title: Grave Robbin'
english.objectives: Look for the rumored treasure in the Soul Ruins.
english.description: I am not a grave robber, but is it technically grave robbing if the treasure is sitting on a field of bones? It's not like it's buried or nothin'. I'm just gonna sit this one out, just in case.
english.progress: Сокровищ много не бывает!
english.completion: Ты $gнашел:нашла; в сундуке ключ? И больше ничего?$B$BНаверное, тот, кто забрал его содержимое, случайно оставил там ключ. То есть ты $gнашел:нашла; ключ к сундуку, который $gсам же и обчистил:сама же и обчистила;. Фантастика! А еще говорят, что это у меня руки не из того места растут.

text.title: 古墓丽影
text.objectives: 在萨格拉斯之墓外寻找传闻中的宝箱。
text.description: 我一遍又一遍地对自己说：“别去大教堂。别去大教堂。”但我做了什么？我还是去了大教堂。我马上就要摸到那个宝箱时，却被一群疯狂的恶魔赶了出来。还好我成功逃脱，保住了我的头盔和小命！
text.progress: I'm always lookin' for more treasure!
text.completion: Did you bother to read the label on this potion? I'm going to assume, no. You may find some sucker who will pay you for it.$B$BBetter luck next time kid.

english.title: Tomb Raidering
english.objectives: Look for the rumored treasure outside the Tomb of Sargeras.
english.description: I said to myself over and over, "Don't go near the citadel. Don't go near the citadel." But what did I do? I went to the citadel. Almost had my hands on that sweet treasure chest before I got chased off by a bunch of crazy demons. I made it out of there with just my helmet and my life!
english.progress: Сокровищ много не бывает!
english.completion: Ты $gпрочел:прочла; надпись на этом зелье? Видимо, нет. Может, и найдется придурок, готовый за это заплатить.$B$BНичего, в следующий раз повезет больше.

text.title: 舰船墓场
text.objectives: 在荒弃海湾深处寻找传闻中的宝箱。
text.description: 我没有告诉你，我是之前那次登陆队伍的成员，我们几乎失去了一切。我不在乎那里还有什么宝箱，我绝对不会回到那片海滩了。绝不。
text.progress: I'm always lookin' for more treasure!
text.completion: It's... Wet. This thing is most likely worthless now.$B$BIs there a good piece of treasure on this cursed island? I may not be the brightest tool in the bag, but I'm starting to think this place doesn't really fit my "chance of death versus treasure" ratio.

english.title: Ship Graveyard
english.objectives: Look for the rumored treasure deep in the Forlorn Depths.
english.description: I haven't told you that I was part of the original landing party when we lost almost everything.  I don't care what treasure is left there, I'll never go back to that beach. Never.
english.progress: Сокровищ много не бывает!
english.completion: Он же... Промок. Скорее всего, теперь эта штука ни на что не годится.$B$BНа этом острове вообще найдется хоть одно стоящее сокровище? Я, может быть, и не семи пядей во лбу, но даже до меня уже доходит, что здесь у нас куда больше шансов умереть, чем найти что-нибудь ценное.

text.title: 我们是宝藏猎人
text.objectives: 在邪怒海滩寻找传闻中的宝箱。
text.description:
我感觉你只不过是在利用我，想用我的线索来寻找宝箱。从现在开始，我不会告诉你纳迦有个宝箱了。我刚才说的是纳迦的宝箱吗？我本来想说的是我不会告诉你。我的意思是这是我的秘密！该死！

好的。看来你抓住我的把柄了。我告诉你吧，去那些纳迦怪物附近，给我把宝箱里的东西找回来，我会好好报答你的。
text.progress: You fetch that treasure yet?
text.completion: This is it? You sure you didn't find anything else? Like a giant pile of gold on top of a statue made of diamonds which was holding a scroll listing the combination to the vault in Ironforge? That would have been pretty sweet.$B$BOh well. I can make this into a paper weight or throw it at a squirrel.$B$BCome back tomorrow, I'll have another job for you.

english.title: We're Treasure Hunters
english.objectives: Look for the rumored treasure on the Felrage Strand.
english.description:
I have a feeling you're just using me for tips on where all the best treasure is. From now on I'm naga tell you anything. Did I say, "naga" just then? I meant to say, I'm not gonna to tell you naga. I mean nada! Darn it!

Okay. Seems you got me on this one. I'll tell you what, fetch me whatever is in that chest near those naga freaks and I'll make it worth your while.
english.progress: Ну что, удалось найти сокровища?
english.completion: И это все? Ты точно $gуверен:уверена;, что больше там ничего не было? Какой-нибудь кучи золота, на которой стояла статуя, высеченная из цельного алмаза, со свитком в руке, на котором записаны все комбинации от сейфов хранилищ Стальгорна? Эх, вот это была бы находка.$B$BНу ладно. Глядишь, и эта штуковина сойдет для чего-нибудь: как пресс-папье, ну или в белок кидаться.$B$BЗагляни завтра, может, найдется еще какая работенка для тебя.

text.title: 发大财
text.objectives: 调查挖掘者卡拉说的那个山洞。
text.description:
嘘……来这边！我收到信儿说，这座岛上有个山洞，里面是个藏宝库！这可能是我这辈子干的最大的一笔了。

问题是，我，呃……脚崴了。没错，我本来肯定会陪你跟那些恶魔血战，然后拿到宝藏的，但是现在我这条腿没办法承受任何重量了。真悲剧。

你自己去那个山洞里看看，然后向我回报吧。我会在地图上把山洞的入口标记出来。我听说那个山洞藏得很深，所以你得好好找找。
text.completion: Looks like we hit the motherlode! Now all we need is a key... Huh. Why don't you go work on getting some keys for these chests and I'll hang out with goofy-nose here.

english.title: The Motherlode
english.objectives: Investigate the cave that Excavator Karla told you about.
english.description:
Pst... Come 'ere! I just got a tip about a cave on this island that is a treasure trove of loot! This could be my biggest score yet.

Problem is, I uhh... sprained my ankle. Yeah, I would be right there with you battling those demons to get this treasure, but I shouldn't be putting any weight on this leg of mine. Shucks.

How about you go check on this cave and report back to me. I'll mark your map where the cave entrance is. I've been told it's pretty hidden, so you've got to look around.
english.completion: Похоже, мы напали на золотую жилу! Теперь нам нужен только ключ. Хм... Почему бы тебе не заняться поиском ключей к этим сундукам? А я пока тут посижу.

objectiveDetails.description: 调查挖掘者卡拉的山洞

text.title: 自然的守护
text.objectives: 在破碎海滩的救赎岗哨找到希萨莉·黑鸦。
text.description: 恐怕这次对戈德林的袭击只是个开始，$n。一定要把下令袭击的人找出来解决掉。$b$b希萨莉之前不是跟你一块的吗？她一直没回来……真是莽撞的孩子。我猜她已经去破碎海滩了，想在那里找到这个指挥官的踪迹。请你找到她，别让她独自行动。
text.completion: Look at him squirm. He gave in easily!

english.title: The Preservation of Nature
english.objectives: Find Thisalee Crow near Deliverance Point on Broken Shore.
english.description: I fear this attack on Goldrinn is only the beginning, $n. Whoever is ordering these attacks must be found and defeated.$b$bWasn't Thisalee with you? She never returned... brash child. I assume she is already on the Broken Shore, trying to track down this commander. Please, find her. Do not let her take this on alone.
english.completion: Look at him squirm. He gave in easily!

text.title: 寻找恶魔
text.objectives: 从鬼哭小径的恶魔身上收集$1oa个鬼哭公函。
text.description: 我主动侦察了周围，然后抓到了那个虫语者。看来他们的军队营地藏在鬼哭小径。可我想弄明白的是，他们的指挥官是谁，他是否在附近。$b$b如果他在别处指挥，那部队就必须携带一些指令。我们去看看能不能找到……当然是从他们的尸体上找！
text.progress: Collecting some missives should allow me to figure out the commander's position.
text.completion: Let me take a look at these... I think I've got it!

english.title: To Track a Demon
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Impsorrow Missives from demons in Impsorrow Approach.
english.description: I took the initiative to scout around before I grabbed that wyrmtongue. It seems like their forces are holed up in a camp in Impsorrow Approach. What I've struggled to figure out, however, is who their commander is and if he's nearby.$b$bIf he's leading from elsewhere, the troops need to have some commands on them. Let's go see if we can find any... on their dead bodies!
english.progress: С помощью этих приказов я выясню, где находится их командующий.
english.completion: Let me take a look at these... I think I've got it!

text.title: 自然之触
text.objectives: 在鬼哭小径治疗$1oa个受伤的德鲁伊。
text.description: 显然除了我们，还有别的德鲁伊也遇到了这些恶魔。军团抓获了许多俘虏，把他们带回了自己的营地。我们的兄弟姐妹受伤了，躺在那里……$b$b你会治疗！我们去救他们吧！
text.completion: I feel a lot better knowing we were able to save some of the other druids. We did what we could.

english.title: Nature's Touch
english.objectives: Heal $1oa Injured Druids in Impsorrow Approach.
english.description: Apparently we're not the only druids that have run into these demons. The Legion took a ton of captives and brought them back to their camp. Our brothers and sisters lay wounded and hurting...$b$bYou can heal! Let's go save them!
english.completion: I feel a lot better knowing we were able to save some of the other druids. We did what we could.

text.title: 拔掉蓟刺
text.objectives: 在黑石岛消灭指挥官卡提萨克斯。
text.description: 他们的指挥官名叫卡提萨克斯。是他组织了这些攻击，现在又在带领部队进行攻击。幸好，他看来就在不远处。$b$b海岸对面有个小岛，他好像就藏在那里发号施令，从不弄脏自己的手。$b$b可我却恰恰相反，弄脏手这种事情我很喜欢。你呢？
text.completion: Revenge feels so good.$B$BBut stopping the attacks on the ancients feels even better.

english.title: Prick of a Thistle
english.objectives: Kill Commander Katith'rax on Darkstone Isle.
english.description: Their commander's name is Katith'rax. He's the one who organized these attacks, and now the one who leads them. Luckily, it doesn't seem as though he's far off.$b$bRight off the coast is a small island. Seems as though he hides there, barking orders without getting his hands dirty.$b$bI, on the other hand, enjoy getting my hands a little dirty. Don't you?
english.completion: Revenge feels so good.$B$BBut stopping the attacks on the ancients feels even better.

text.title: 丝线传说
text.objectives: 把艾里扎尔丢失的《夜之子之夜》带给他。
text.description: 裁缝是最高贵的专业，因为衣服是普世的。多数人穿衣服时什么都不会想。如果你研究一下传说，你会发现有些种族特别优秀。$b$b夜之子是时尚大师！他们的智慧很大程度上都体现在使用的材料里——尤其是他们的纺线和织布机。我们要利用一下这两者。你在收集材料前，我需要先确认一下我的清单。把我之前随身携带的那部时尚专著给我找来。也许我把它落在飞行管理员那里了？
text.progress: I need a copy of Nights with the Nightborne so we can focus our efforts. I probably left it on my flight over.
text.completion: Ah thank you for locating that. Let me see--we'll want to target the most stylish of the Nightborne... this seems like the perfect list... oh, she's dangerous... so's that one... very well. $B$BThere is a lot to do so you should get started!

english.title: The Legend of the Threads
english.objectives: Bring Eliezer his lost copy of Nights with the Nightborne
english.description: Tailoring is the noblest of professions because clothing is universal. Most dress with nary a thought. If you analyze the legends, some races stand out from all others. $b$bThe Nightborne are masters of style! Much of the brilliance is in their materials--in particular their thread and their looms. We will take advantage of both. Before you gather materials, I need to confirm my list. Find the fashion treatise I brought with me. Perhaps I dropped it by the flight master?
english.progress: I need a copy of Nights with the Nightborne so we can focus our efforts. I probably left it on my flight over.
english.completion: Ah thank you for locating that. Let me see--we'll want to target the most stylish of the Nightborne... this seems like the perfect list... oh, she's dangerous... so's that one... very well. $B$BThere is a lot to do so you should get started!

objectiveDetails.description: 发现艾里扎尔的时尚卷轴

text.title: 暗影传说
text.objectives: 在史诗难度下击败魔法回廊的顾问凡多斯，并从他的长袍中抽取暗影线。
text.description: 夜之子凡多斯。他是个擅长服装打扮的精灵。他还是法罗迪斯宫廷中一个初出茅庐的贵族时，就已经因为他时髦前卫的服饰而闻名。$b$b我从没能够在近距离仔细观察他的服饰，但是我的研究表明，他的裁缝的技巧并不在于布匹，而是在于丝线。这种丝线似乎是用纯粹的暗影纺织而成。$b$b你肯定有自己的办法拿到这种线。拿到他的长袍，再拿到那种线。
text.progress: Vandros maybe be difficult to defeat but we really need that shadow thread from his robes.
text.completion: Excellent, $n! Oh the things you will sew!

english.title: The Thread of Shadow
english.objectives: Defeat Advisor Vandros in the Arcway in Mythic difficulty and extract Shadow Thread from his robes.
english.description: Vandros of the Nightborne. There is an elf who knows how to dress. Ever since he was a young noble in the Court of Farondis, Vandros has been known for snappy, fashion forward outfits. $b$bI've never been able to see his garments up close but my research tells me that his tailor's technique is not so much in the fabric as it is in the thread. It appears to be spun of the very shadows themselves. $b$bYou have your methods to obtain it, I'm sure. Get his robes and get the thread.
english.progress: Vandros maybe be difficult to defeat but we really need that shadow thread from his robes.
english.completion: Excellent, $n! Oh the things you will sew!

objectiveDetails.description: 从凡多斯的织影长袍中抽取暗影线

text.title: 星光传说
text.objectives: 击败群星庭院的顾问麦兰杜斯并从他的护腕中提取星光线。
text.description: 夜之子麦兰杜斯是艾利桑德的首席剑士。也许你听说过他？在夜之子眼里，他是个大英雄。但老实说，他的时尚品味简直一团糟。$b$b他对饰品的搭配要稍微好点，尤其是那对护腕，相当漂亮。老实说，缝制这对护腕的线非常适合你要制作的服装。去把那种线带回来给我，我们再作进一步的打算。
text.progress: Did you get the thread from Melandrus' Star-Touched Bracers?
text.completion: Excellent work, my friend! I will find an appropriate use for this as soon as I can.

english.title: The Thread of Starlight
english.objectives: Defeat Advisor Melandrus in the Court of Stars and extract Starlight Thread from his bracers.
english.description: Melandrus of the Nightborne is First Blade of Elisande. Perhaps you've heard of him? He is a great hero to the Nightborne but, to be absolutely honest, he is a mess with regards to style. $b$bHis accoutrements are somewhat better and a particular pair or bracers are rather nice. In fact, the thead that binds them will be absolutely perfect for your pending outfits. Why don't you get that for me and we will talk further.
english.progress: Did you get the thread from Melandrus' Star-Touched Bracers?
english.completion: Excellent work, my friend! I will find an appropriate use for this as soon as I can.

objectiveDetails.description: 从麦兰杜斯的星触护腕抽取星光线

text.title: 灵魂传说
text.objectives: 击败暗夜要塞的大魔导师艾利桑德并从她的裹手中提取灵魂线。
text.description: 你有机会仔细端详过夜之子大魔导师艾利桑德吗？她真叫人目醉神迷！她是时尚先锋！而且仪态大方！$b$b只要从她的书里汲取一页精华，你就能化身时尚潮人！事实上，如果你能从她的苏拉玛灵魂裹手中抽取灵魂线，那就太棒了！她的裹手对她的人民来说有强烈的象征意义，所以我怀疑她不会心甘情愿地把它交给你。$b$b既然如此，那就干掉她，再拿到那种线吧。
text.progress: Grand Magistrix Elisande's Soul Wraps have the most beautiful thread! I don't meant to be pushy but... I'm waiting.
text.completion: The soul thread is so beautiful! I am very pleased, $n.

english.title: The Thread of Souls
english.objectives: Defeat Grand Magistrix Elisande in the Nighthold and extract Soul Thread from her wraps.
english.description: Have you ever had a chance to lay eyes on Elisande, Grand Magistrix of the Nightborne? Stunning! Fashion-forward! Nice posture! $b$bYou'd do well to take a page from her book! In fact, you'd tell well to take the thread from her Suramari Soul Wraps! These hold great symbolic value to her people so it's doubtful she will give them willingly. $b$bSo be it, take her out and get that thread.
english.progress: Grand Magistrix Elisande's Soul Wraps have the most beautiful thread! I don't meant to be pushy but... I'm waiting.
english.completion: The soul thread is so beautiful! I am very pleased, $n.

objectiveDetails.description: 从苏拉玛灵魂裹手抽取灵魂线

text.title: 远古大氅
text.objectives: 从破碎海滩的人型生物身上获取$1oa块古代灌魔丝纹布。
text.description: $n，我们需要优质的布料才行。幸好，夜之子的匠人们长久以来的纺织工艺都非常优秀。虽然这技艺在某种程度上已经失传，但是我感觉你还是可以把他们的杰作发扬光大。$b$b附近地区的一些敌人依旧穿着古代灌魔丝纹布制作的护甲。只要你在破碎海滩上找到了这样的护甲，就可以把丝纹布从上面拆下来。
text.progress: Keep your eye out for Ancient Imbued Silkweave. We need a lot of it to start making fabulous things.
text.completion: Ah, that is just what we need, young $R!

english.title: Drapings of the Ancients
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Ancient Imbued Silkweave from humanoids in Broken Shore.
english.description: $n, we are going to need a high quality cloth to work with. Thankfully, the weaving quality of nightborne craftspeople from long ago was very good. It is a lost art to some degree but I feel like you can take their masterworks and do even more with it. $b$bSome of the hostiles in these parts still wear Ancient Imbued Silkweave Armor. Start to unstitch the silkweave cloth from any of that armor that you find on Broken Shore.
english.progress: Keep your eye out for Ancient Imbued Silkweave. We need a lot of it to start making fabulous things.
english.completion: Ah, that is just what we need, young $R!

text.title: 星纹布和暗影布
text.objectives: 制作一卷星纹布和一卷暗影布。
text.description: 你终于准备好了，可以接受真正的裁缝的知识了。我认为你确实是通过自己的努力赢得了这一切。$b$b我把你收集到的材料放进了一袋传奇裁缝的原材料里。$b$b前往女王的优雅织布机，然后织出两卷布就好。通过我对时尚、英雄和传说的仔细研究，我相信你制作的这些新的布料会流传千古。赶快！
text.progress: Please make a bolt of Starweave and a bolt of Shadowcloth at the loom as soon as you can and bring it back to me for final inspection.
text.completion: The cloth you've created is like none I've ever seen. Beautiful! $B$BTake these elements and make something wonderful with them. I will be the first to write of your accomplishments and I truly believe you will become, at last, an icon of heroic style, $n!

english.title: Starweave and Shadowcloth
english.objectives: Make a bolt of Starweave and a bolt of Shadowcloth.
english.description: At last, you are ready for true tailoring knowledge. I truly think you've earned it. $b$bI've fashioned the materials you've gathered into a satchel of Legendary Tailor's Materials. $b$bGo to the Queen's Grace Loom and weave two bolts of cloth. With my careful research of fashion, heroes, and legends. I believe the new cloth you will make will echo through the ages. Hurry!
english.progress: Please make a bolt of Starweave and a bolt of Shadowcloth at the loom as soon as you can and bring it back to me for final inspection.
english.completion: The cloth you've created is like none I've ever seen. Beautiful! $B$BTake these elements and make something wonderful with them. I will be the first to write of your accomplishments and I truly believe you will become, at last, an icon of heroic style, $n!

objectiveDetails.description: 制作一卷星纹布和一卷暗影布

text.title: 古皮传说
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉捕捉上古小精灵。
text.description: 制皮是世界上最古老的专业之一。最早的衣服都是用动物皮做的。传说有一种特殊的皮革处理方式，现在已经失传。$b$b通过融合大地魔法与目前能找到的部分最优质的皮革，再加上你详细的分析和我对时尚的理解，这项技术终于获得了重生。$b$b作为第一步，你必须去捕捉一些上古小精灵来引导那种独特的自然魔法，才能进行硬化处理。
text.completion: Ancient wisps? Beautiful! This is a strong start, $n.

english.title: The Legend of the Elderhide
english.objectives: Capture Ancient Wisps in Val'sharah.
english.description: Leatherworking is one of the oldest forms of craftsmanship in the world. Hides of animals were the first clothing. Legends tell of a particular form of leather curing that has been lost to us in modern times. $b$bCombining magic of the earth with some of the finest leathers ever found, this technique has been recreated by yours truly through careful analysis and my understanding of style. $b$bTo begin, you must capture some ancient wisps to channel the exact nature magic for the curing process.
english.completion: Ancient wisps? Beautiful! This is a strong start, $n.

text.title: 小精灵与暗影
text.objectives: 在史诗难度下击败黑心林地的萨维斯之影并给他的裹布染色。
text.description: $n，你听说过梦魇之王萨维斯吧？他的影子萦绕在黑心林地。我听说，人们有时候看到这个影子穿着无色的裹布。$b$b这裹布充满了强大的魔法，小精灵会帮你把它抽取出来。$b$b如果你能战胜这个影子，拿到裹布，并使用你的技术来给它染色，我就会向你展示怎么制造奇迹！
text.progress: Have you obtained and dyed the shroud yet? Make your way to Darkheart Thicket and get it done.
text.completion: The shroud is perfect, $n. Well done!

english.title: The Wisp and the Shadow
english.objectives: Defeat the Shade of Xavius in Darkheart Thicket on Mythic Difficulty and dye his shroud.
english.description: $n, have you heard of the nightmare lord, Xavius, whose shade haunts Darkheart Thicket? I have heard that this shade is sometimes seen wearing a colorless shroud. $b$bThis shroud is steeped in powerful magic and the wisp will draw it out for you. $b$bIf you can fight the shade, take the shroud, and use your skills to dye it, I will show you how to work wonders!
english.progress: Have you obtained and dyed the shroud yet? Make your way to Darkheart Thicket and get it done.
english.completion: The shroud is perfect, $n. Well done!

objectiveDetails.description: 给萨维斯的无色裹布染色

text.title: 小精灵与海
text.objectives: 在史诗难度下从艾萨拉之怒身上获得浸水的女仆手套，然后对其进行处理。
text.description: 艾萨拉女王和她的女仆是许多悲伤传说的主角。她的力量和傲慢让她走上了歧途，但是即使这样，她的女仆至今还是对她忠心耿耿。这其中就包含了力量。$b$b艾萨拉之怒是个令人憎恶的东西，但真相其实是，它是艾萨拉的一名女仆，她为了保护她的女王而甘愿献出自己的生命。这一点很少有人知道。上古小精灵知道这一点，如果你把它带去与艾萨拉之怒交战，你就会发现女仆的手套。请修复那双手套。
text.progress: You need to battle the Wrath of Azshara and find and restore a pair of handmaiden's gloves.
text.completion: These gloves have an air of sadness about them, do they not? Regardless, thank you for restoring them and bringing them here.

english.title: The Wisp and the Sea
english.objectives: Retrieve the Waterlogged Handmaiden's Gloves from the Wrath of Azshara on Mythic Difficulty, then treat them.
english.description: Queen Azshara and her handmaidens are the subjects of many a tragic tale. Her power and her hubris lead her badly astray but, even so, her handmaidens are loyal to her to this day. There is power in such a thing. $b$bThe Wrath of Azshara is an abomination but, truthfully, it is actually one of her handmaidens who willing gave her life to protect her queen. Few know this. The Ancient Wisp knows this truth and if you take it to battle the Wrath of Azshara, you may find the handmaiden's gloves. Restore them.
english.progress: You need to battle the Wrath of Azshara and find and restore a pair of handmaiden's gloves.
english.completion: These gloves have an air of sadness about them, do they not? Regardless, thank you for restoring them and bringing them here.

text.title: 小精灵与梦魇
text.objectives: 从翡翠梦魇的萨维斯身上获得法术腰带，并修复它。
text.description: 瓦尔莎拉的梦魇之王萨维斯的一部分力量来自他的腰带。腰带上附了魔，与他脚下的世界深深联系在一起，无法从他身上拿走。$b$b然而，有了上古小精灵的帮助，只要你能在战斗中击败萨维斯，就可以拿走这条法术腰带。我相信这件事只需要你使用一点小技巧即可完成。$b$b把小精灵带到翡翠梦魇，获取法术腰带，并使用你的技巧修复你在战斗中对它造成的损伤。
text.progress: $n, defeat Xavius and obtain his spellsash for me. Make sure that it is repaired to perfect condition!
text.completion: The spellsash looks perfect, $n! I couldn't have done a better repair myself.

english.title: The Wisp and the Nightmare
english.objectives: Get the spellsash from Xavius in the Emerald Nightmare and repair it.
english.description: Xavius, the Nightmare Lord in Val'Sharah, derives some of his power from his spellsash. It is enchanted and tied to the world beneath his feet and cannot be removed from his body. $b$bHowever, with the ancient wisp's help, the spellsash can be removed if you can but defeat Xavius in combat. Trivial for one of your skill, I'm sure. $b$bTake the wisp to the Emerald Nightmare, take the spellsash, and use your skills to repair any damage you've caused in the battle.
english.progress: $n, defeat Xavius and obtain his spellsash for me. Make sure that it is repaired to perfect condition!
english.completion: The spellsash looks perfect, $n! I couldn't have done a better repair myself.

objectiveDetails.description: 修复萨维斯的破损法术腰带

text.title: 古代皮革
text.objectives: 从破碎海滩的人型生物身上获取$1oa张古代恐皮。
text.description: $n，我们需要使用优质的皮革。古代恐皮是这一带最好的皮革，以前本地的鞣制技术也非常棒。不过没经过训练的人可能分辨不出它们与普通恐皮的区别，所以就需要小精灵帮忙了。$b$b破碎海滩上的许多敌人身上都或多或少有点古代恐皮。只要你击败了他们，就可以开始辨识用古代恐皮制作的护甲，然后你就可以收集这种皮革，从而达成我们的目的。
text.progress: Keep your eye out for ancient dreadleather. We will need a good amount for our purposes.
text.completion: That is, indeed, dreadleather. Should be enough for our needs, $n. My thanks!

english.title: Leather of the Ancients
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa pieces of Ancient Dreadleather from humanoids in Broken Shore.
english.description: $n, we are going to need high quality leather to work with. Ancient Dreadleather is the best hereabouts and local tanning techniques were exceptional in the past. To the untrained eye, it may look like normal dreadleather. That is where the wisp comes in. $b$bMany of your enemies across Broken Shore will have some amount of ancient dreadleather.  As you defeat them, you will start to recognize armor made from it and you can harvest the leather for our purposes.
english.progress: Keep your eye out for ancient dreadleather. We will need a good amount for our purposes.
english.completion: That is, indeed, dreadleather. Should be enough for our needs, $n. My thanks!

text.title: 灵触古皮
text.objectives: 在雷霆图腾何鲁尔·锐蹄的居所使用传奇皮匠的工具箱。
text.description: 通过细致的逆向工程，从古代文献中获得的知识可以用来把恐皮加工成古皮。其中一方面要采用高超的工艺，另一方面要采用一种简单的大地魔法。$b$b有了你捕捉的远古小精灵，你收集的材料，再加上我的悉心研究，我终于为你制作了一个传奇皮匠的工具箱。把它带到雷霆图腾的何鲁尔·锐蹄流传下来的皮革那里。小精灵会帮你使用工具箱，制作古皮。
text.progress: Hrul Sharptooth has hides in his dwelling in Thunder Totem. When you approach them, you will be able to use your kit. Bring it back to me for final inspection.
text.completion: The Elderhide leather that you've created is magnificent. Take this, and work your magic to create something of wonder and beauty. $B$BIt is an extraordinary accomplishment and you will look quite dashing--and I should know!

english.title: Wisp-Touched Elderhide
english.objectives: Use the Legendary Tanner's Kit in Hrul Sharptooth's dwelling in Thunder Totem.
english.description: Dreadleather, with knowledge carefully reverse-engineered from ancient texts, can be worked into elderhide. It is partly a matter of advanced craftsmanship and partly a simple magic of the earth. $b$bWith the ancient wisps you caught and the materials you've captured and the research I have done, I have put together a Legendary Tanner's Kit for you. Take it to the heirloom hides of Hrul Sharptooth in Thunder Totem. The wisp will help you use the kit there to create Elderhide.
english.progress: Hrul Sharptooth has hides in his dwelling in Thunder Totem. When you approach them, you will be able to use your kit. Bring it back to me for final inspection.
english.completion: The Elderhide leather that you've created is magnificent. Take this, and work your magic to create something of wonder and beauty. $B$BIt is an extraordinary accomplishment and you will look quite dashing--and I should know!

objectiveDetails.description: 在雷霆图腾何鲁尔·锐蹄的居所制造灵触古皮。

text.title: 守护之鳞的传说
text.objectives: 在守望岛捕捉夜枭之父。
text.description: 我最喜欢的传说之一就是守望岛的夜枭之父的故事。据说，他的圣灵会在危难时前来安慰他的造物。$b$b军团登上守望岛后，许多夜枭都遭到了屠杀，所以你能够在那里看到他。$b$b我们得“借用”他一下，因为他见证过许多场战斗，其中那些鼎鼎有名的战士和恶徒都穿着守护之鳞制成的护甲。有了他的圣灵，你就能辨识出这些物品，我们就能从中提取守护之鳞，用它来创造时尚！
text.progress: Have you captured the Father of Owls yet?
text.completion: What a magnificent creature! Allow me to attune him to you...there! With his ancient knowledge, we are ready to begin.

english.title: The Legend of the Wardenscale
english.objectives: Capture the Father of Owls on the Isle of the Watchers.
english.description: One of my favorite legends is of the Father of Owls on Isle of the Watchers. It is said that his spirit comes to comfort his creatures during times of trouble. $b$bWith the Legion's arrival on the Isle of Watchers, many of the owls are being slain so you can find him there. $b$bWe need to "borrow" him for a short time as he has seen many of the battles where famous warriors and villains have worn armor made of Wardenscale. With his spirit, you can identify items we can extract it from and use it for style!
english.progress: Have you captured the Father of Owls yet?
english.completion: What a magnificent creature! Allow me to attune him to you...there! With his ancient knowledge, we are ready to begin.

text.title: 夜枭与叛徒
text.objectives: 在史诗难度的守望者地窟中找到并修复科达娜·邪歌的披肩。
text.description: 我在传说和故事中寻找关于具有守护之鳞的护甲的蜘丝马迹时，发现了科达娜·邪歌的名字。$b$b显然，她有件家传的披肩，里面有我们所需的东西。干掉她这个叛徒，在她身上拿到这件披肩。有了这只夜枭，你就能找到它。$b$b因为多年高强度使用，披肩很可能已经开裂了，所以你需要先回复它原有的风貌，再把它交给我。
text.progress: Have you gotten Cordana's mantle and restored it yet? Rumor has it she is in the Vault of the Wardens.
text.completion: The mantle looks brand new! Excellent craftsmanship, $n!

english.title: The Owl and the Traitor
english.objectives: Find and repair Cordana Felsong's Mantle in the Vault of the Wardens in Mythic difficulty.
english.description: I've scoured the tales and legends for armor that might have Wardenscale components and one Cordana Felsong is a name that caught my attention. $b$bEvidently she has a family mantle that has what we need. Kill her and find it on her traitor's corpse. The owl will make sure that you spot it. $b$bIt is likely chipped from years of hard use so restore it to prime condition and bring it back to me.
english.progress: Have you gotten Cordana's mantle and restored it yet? Rumor has it she is in the Vault of the Wardens.
english.completion: The mantle looks brand new! Excellent craftsmanship, $n!

text.title: 夜枭与恐惧魔王
text.objectives: 在史诗难度的永夜大教堂中击败孟菲斯托斯，从而找到并修复孟菲斯托斯的腿甲。
text.description: 恶魔孟菲斯托斯是纳斯雷兹姆——也就是恐惧魔王——中的最强者之一。从你的眼中我已经看出，你知道我要你去做什么。但是这是为了你好！你不能再像现在这样闲逛了。$b$b最近，孟菲斯托斯受到军团的调遣，出现在了永夜大教堂。毫无疑问的是，他肯定会穿着腿甲，而我相信，其中就包含有守护之鳞。取得腿甲，把腿甲抛光，然后交给我。
text.progress: Have you defeated Mephistroth and added some shine to his legplates?
text.completion: Those legplates are rather large! I'm surprised you survived that encounter--and you've refinished them beautifully!

english.title: The Owl and the Dreadlord
english.objectives: Find and restore the Legplates of Mephistroth by defeating him in the Cathedral of Eternal Night in Mythic Difficulty.
english.description: The demon Mephistroth is one of the most powerful of the Nathrezim--the dreadlords. I can see in your eyes that you know what I am going to ask you to do. But it is for your own good! You can't keep wandering the lands looking like you do. $b$bMost recently, Mephistroth has been dispatched by the Legion to the Cathedral of Eternal Night. No doubt, he will be wearing some legplates that I believe contain Wardenscale. Take them, shine them up, and bring them to me.
english.progress: Have you defeated Mephistroth and added some shine to his legplates?
english.completion: Those legplates are rather large! I'm surprised you survived that encounter--and you've refinished them beautifully!

objectiveDetails.description: 给孟菲斯托斯的生锈腿甲抛光

text.title: 夜枭与眼魔
text.objectives: 在史诗难度下消灭重返卡拉赞地下城中的维兹艾德姆，获得并修复一战护腕。
text.description: 我研究过我那个时代的一些邪恶生物，监视者维兹艾德姆绝对是其中的佼佼者。我是说，他是个巨大、恶心而又危险的眼球！$b$b目前他正盘踞在卡拉赞——你知道这个地方吗？在麦迪文的时代，那里储存了我们的许多常识。唉，时代变啦……$b$b我离题了。维兹艾德姆还收藏着第一次大战时代的护甲——具体地说是护腕——而且这对护腕极其珍贵。虽然这么做令我痛心，但请你把护腕抢过来，然后修好。之后，我们会用到里面的守护之鳞。
text.progress: Have you killed that horrible beast and brought me the Bracers of the First War?
text.completion: These bracers have legends of their own--too bad we need to sacrifice them to build a proper reputation for you but we all must suffer for fashion. $B$BI would also like to personally thank you for killing Viz'aduum. It just shouldn't... exist. I mean... well you know what I mean.

english.title: The Owl and the Observer
english.objectives: Kill Viz'aduum in the Return to Karazhan dungeon on Mythic difficulty, and retrieve and repair the Bracers of the First War.
english.description: I've researched some foul creatures in my time but Viz'aduum the Watcher may top the list. I mean, he is a giant, disgusting, dangerous eyeball! $b$bCurrently he haunts Karazhan--do you know the place? In Medivh's time, much of our common knowledge was stored there. Alas, the time has passed... $b$bI digress. Viz'aduum is in possession of armor from the First War--bracers to be specific--and they are incredibly valuable. It pains me but take them, repair them, and then we must use their wardenscale.
english.progress: Have you killed that horrible beast and brought me the Bracers of the First War?
english.completion: These bracers have legends of their own--too bad we need to sacrifice them to build a proper reputation for you but we all must suffer for fashion. $B$BI would also like to personally thank you for killing Viz'aduum. It just shouldn't... exist. I mean... well you know what I mean.

text.title: 远古锁甲
text.objectives: 从破碎海滩的人型生物身上获取$1oa片古代刻鳞。
text.description: 在破碎群岛各地，散落着一些守护之鳞。除了各种敌人，本地的怪物也会试图模仿我们这样的高级种族，他们会捡起这些东西并穿在身上。$b$b我们需要的那种鳞片是其中最古老的，叫做古代刻鳞。请把你找到的所有古代刻鳞都保留下来并交给我。我们要从当中收集有用的部分。
text.progress: Do you have the Ancient Gravenscale that we need?
text.completion: That should be enough Ancient Gravenscale. Well done, $n!

english.title: Mail of the Ancients
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Ancient Gravenscale from humanoids in Broken Shore.
english.description: There is some wardenscale scattered here and there in the Broken Isles. Various enemies and local monsters seeking to ape the superior races like ourselves will have picked it up and worn it. $b$bThe kind we need is amongst the oldest ever made. It is ancient gravenscale. Keep all that you find and and bring it to me. We will harvest what useful bits we can from it.
english.progress: Do you have the Ancient Gravenscale that we need?
english.completion: That should be enough Ancient Gravenscale. Well done, $n!

text.title: 完整的守护之鳞
text.objectives: 找到阿苏纳的塞莉娅并在魔法匹配的地方制造守护之鳞。
text.description: 我感觉，时机终于成熟了，我们可以制作真正的了不起的东西了。要制作出让你鹤立鸡群的护甲，我们需要制作最好的守护之鳞。$b$b到阿苏纳去找暗夜精灵塞莉娅吧。她调整并净化了她那里的土地。她在那里等待着聚焦我们世界的魔法。你只有在那里才能制作我们需要的东西。快去吧，$n。
text.progress: Have you found Celea in Azsuna and prepared the Wardenscale beside her? It will only work at that spot. Bring it back to me when you have finished.
text.completion: The Wardenscale is incredibly light yet strong--I have never seen its equal. $n, there is nothing else I can do. It is all up to you now. $B$BTake what you have earned and make wonders with it. Stylish, stylish wonders.

english.title: Prime Wardenscale
english.objectives: Find Celea in Azsuna and create the Wardenscale where the magic aligns.
english.description: I feel like it is finally time for use to create something truly remarkable. To create the armor that will set you apart from the rest, we need to make the best wardenscale. $b$bFind the nightelf, Celea, in Azsuna. She has attuned and sanctified the ground where she waits to focus the magic of our world and only there can you make what we need. Go with speed, $n.
english.progress: Have you found Celea in Azsuna and prepared the Wardenscale beside her? It will only work at that spot. Bring it back to me when you have finished.
english.completion: The Wardenscale is incredibly light yet strong--I have never seen its equal. $n, there is nothing else I can do. It is all up to you now. $B$BTake what you have earned and make wonders with it. Stylish, stylish wonders.

text.title: 四锤传说
text.objectives: 前往达拉然，寻找《四锤传说》。
text.description: $n，开始前，我们应该对彼此坦诚。你是个专业的铁匠，而这是个高尚的专业。但是我很看重风格与时尚。沉重的盔甲和武器会令英雄的形象产生一种笨重感，我觉得这对衣服的式样没有帮助。$b$b但不要着急——至少我可以教你提高对优质材料的品味。$b$b前往达拉然，寻找一本由我的兄弟翻译的书，写的是三个被遗忘的英雄。这样一来，我们就可以找到有史以来最优质的金属！
text.progress: Did you find that dusty old tome of Fafnir's? I have to admit that he may have found something interesting in it.
text.completion: Ah, the book! Let's see... blah, blah, blah, 3 heroes... blah, blah, blah, forge 3 hammers and create the ultimate hammer... blah, blah, blah, forger will be metaphorically crushed and possibly literally killed under impossible expectations, etc. Looks good! $B$BIt appears I can help you find what remains of the armor and weapons of these heroes and these incredible materials can be used to make amazing things!

english.title: The Legend of the Four Hammers
english.objectives: Go to Dalaran and find the Legend of the Four Hammers.
english.description: $n, we should be honest with each other before we begin. You are a blacksmith by trade and this a noble profession. Yet I value style and fashion. Heavy armor and weapons create a certain bulkiness in a hero's profile that I think does no service whatsoever to the cut of one's clothes. $b$bFret not--I can at least teach you something about taste in finer materials. $b$bGo to Dalaran and find a book translated by my brother about 3 forgotten heroes. We will find the finest metals ever forged!
english.progress: Did you find that dusty old tome of Fafnir's? I have to admit that he may have found something interesting in it.
english.completion: Ah, the book! Let's see... blah, blah, blah, 3 heroes... blah, blah, blah, forge 3 hammers and create the ultimate hammer... blah, blah, blah, forger will be metaphorically crushed and possibly literally killed under impossible expectations, etc. Looks good! $B$BIt appears I can help you find what remains of the armor and weapons of these heroes and these incredible materials can be used to make amazing things!

text.title: 斗神者
text.objectives: 在史诗难度下从英灵殿的奥丁身上夺取白色电钢，并铸造成一把锤子。
text.description: 斗神者守护凡人，在他眼中，不朽的存在压迫和凌虐着凡人，他需要为此抗争。根据传说，众神都害怕他，但是他最终还是陨落了。$b$b我的研究表明，与他作战的是风暴峡湾的众神，尤其是奥丁。斗神者的盾牌受到了太多闪电的打击，变成了电钢。斗神者死后，奥丁夺走了那面盾牌，并把它熔铸成了战利品。你要从他身上夺取那块电钢，并铸造成锤子。
text.progress: Have you taken the white lightningsteel from Odyn and forged it into a hammer?
text.completion: What a remarkable metal! I feel like it tingles just to hold it. Incredible!

english.title: The Godfighter
english.objectives: Take White Lightningsteel from Odyn in the Halls of Valor in Mythic difficulty and forge it into a hammer.
english.description: The Godfighter championed the mortals against what he saw as oppression and abuse by immortal beings. The legends say the gods feared him but he did fall in time. $b$bMy research shows that the gods he fought were the gods of Stormheim. Odyn, in particular. The Godfighter's shield took so much damage from lightning bolts that it became lightningsteel. After the Godfighter died, Odyn took the shield and melted it down as a trophy. Get that lightningsteel from him and forge a hammer from it.
english.progress: Have you taken the white lightningsteel from Odyn and forged it into a hammer?
english.completion: What a remarkable metal! I feel like it tingles just to hold it. Incredible!

objectiveDetails.description: 把白色电钢铸造成一把锤子

text.title: 猎龙者
text.objectives: 在史诗难度下击败奈萨里奥的巢穴的达古尔，然后用他的红热巨龙熔渣铸造一把锤子。
text.description: 猎龙者的时代还没有文字，她的故事是口耳相传的。$b$b好像巨龙折磨了她的人民，她的村子被摧毁后，她集结了当地的部族，成为了女王，并杀死了所有的巨龙。她后来因为某种原因被放逐了，随后便一直流浪，直到孤独地死去。这个故事的证据是，她出生的村子里的金属神像完成后，剩下了一块巨龙熔渣。目前这块熔渣被地底之王达古尔据为己有了。你要用这块熔渣来铸造一把锤子。
text.progress: Did you find the draconic slag from the Dragonhunter's birth village temple? When you do, forge a hammer from it.
text.completion: It is a powerful magic that kept the draconic slag hot so many years later. Is it the will of the Dragonhunter? Was dragon fire even more dangerous in ancient times? Or was it actually the dragon Neltharion, whom you know as Deathwing, whom she fought back then? $B$BI wonder if I shall ever find out. $B$BWell done! The hammer is extraordinary.

english.title: The Dragonhunter
english.objectives: Defeat Dargul in Neltharion's Lair in Mythic difficulty and create a hammer from his Red-Hot Draconic Slag
english.description: The Dragonhunter lived in a time before history was was written and her tale was passed down orally to us. $b$bIt seems that dragons tormented her people and after her village temple was destroyed, she rallied the local tribes, became a queen and killed all of the dragons. She was then banished for some reason and wandered until her death, alone. What proves the story is a piece of draconic slag from left over from a metal idol in her birth village. Dargul the Underking has it now. Forge a hammer from it.
english.progress: Did you find the draconic slag from the Dragonhunter's birth village temple? When you do, forge a hammer from it.
english.completion: It is a powerful magic that kept the draconic slag hot so many years later. Is it the will of the Dragonhunter? Was dragon fire even more dangerous in ancient times? Or was it actually the dragon Neltharion, whom you know as Deathwing, whom she fought back then? $B$BI wonder if I shall ever find out. $B$BWell done! The hammer is extraordinary.

objectiveDetails.description: 把红热巨龙熔渣铸造成一把锤子

text.title: 地狱杀手
text.objectives: 在勇气试炼中击败海拉，并使用霜脉页岩铸造一把锤子。
text.description: 地狱杀手的故事是个典型的复仇故事。奥丁想要获得最英勇的人的灵魂作为他的勇士，但是海拉则派遣她的克瓦迪尔抢先争夺这些灵魂。风暴峡湾的人们作为他们的棋子，深受其害。$b$b克瓦迪尔趁着夜色来到了地狱杀手的舰船，杀死了她的儿子，并夺走了他的灵魂，永世为海拉效力。地狱杀手拿起了她儿子的斧头和长枪，想要寻求复仇。完成她的使命，击败海拉，用霜脉页岩铸造一把锤子。
text.progress: The Frostveined Shale is what remains of the Hellslayer's weapons after they were destroyed on Helya's cold forge. It is powerful stuff and we need it.
text.completion: The hammer is perfect but rather cold. I do respect your craftsmanship!

english.title: The Hellslayer
english.objectives: Defeat Helya and forge a hammer from the Frostveined Shale in the Trial of Valor.
english.description: The Hellslayer's tale is a classic story of revenge. Odyn wished to take the souls of the bravest as champions but Helya sent her kvaldir to take the souls first. The people of Stormheim suffered as their pawns. $b$bThe kvaldir came to the Hellslayer's ship at night and killed her son and took his soul to serve Helya for eternity. The Hellslayer took up her axe and the spear of her son and sought vengeance. Finish her quest. Defeat Helya and forge a hammer from the Frostveined Shale.
english.progress: The Frostveined Shale is what remains of the Hellslayer's weapons after they were destroyed on Helya's cold forge. It is powerful stuff and we need it.
english.completion: The hammer is perfect but rather cold. I do respect your craftsmanship!

objectiveDetails.description: 把霜脉页岩铸造成一把锤子

text.title: 远古护甲
text.objectives: 从破碎海滩的人型生物身上获取$1oa块古代邪钢。
text.description: 光是这些锤子和我的详尽研究还不够，$n。我们还需要许多顶级的古代金属才能制作最终的锤子。$b$b身穿护甲的敌人遍布破碎海滩，他们的护甲会四处沾染一些古代邪钢。在战斗中收集足够的古代邪钢，完成我们的目标。
text.progress: Do you have the Ancient Demonsteel that we need?
text.completion: That will be enough for our needs. Good work, $n!

english.title: Armor of the Ancients
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Ancient Demonsteel from humanoids in Broken Shore.
english.description: It is not just the hammers and my careful research that we need, $n. We also need a lot of the very highest quality of ancient metal to make the final hammer. $b$bEnemies across Broken Shore that are able to wear armor often collect bits of Ancient Demonsteel here and there. Collect enough of it in your battles for our purposes.
english.progress: Do you have the Ancient Demonsteel that we need?
english.completion: That will be enough for our needs. Good work, $n!

text.title: 遗忘英雄之锤
text.objectives: 前往至高岭的苍穹石，铸造遗忘英雄之锤。
text.description: $n，我必须承认，这次我很激动。我已经把你收集到的所有东西都放到了补给箱里，而拥有足够的能量和魔法，能够处理最终的锤子的铸造的地方就是苍穹石。我相信，你身为具有绝世技艺的铁匠，也明白这一点吧？$b$b我知道，对锻造业来说，总是对矮人具有一种刻板印象，但是我真的不喜欢那些轰鸣和高温，所以我才走上了学者的道路。祝你好运！
text.progress: Be sure to take the chest of supplies I've given you to the Firmament Stone and forge the final hammer. Bring it back to me for inspection when you have done so.
text.completion: The Hammer is possibly the most perfect item you have ever forged. With this, you will create armor of such style and taste that you will become a figure of legends. $B$BI'm proud of you, $n. I'm so happy you will finally start to look good.

english.title: Hammer of Forgotten Heroes
english.objectives: Go to the Firmament Stone in Highmountain and forge the Hammer of Forgotten Heroes.
english.description: $n, this is exciting, I have to admit. I've put everything you've gathered into this chest of supplies and the only place with the power and magic to handle the creation of the final hammer is the Firmament Stone. I believe that blacksmiths of your rarified skills will know it? $b$bI realize that there are dwarf stereotypes out there about smithing but I really don't care for all of the banging and heat. Suppose that is why I followed the scholarly path. Good luck to you!
english.progress: Be sure to take the chest of supplies I've given you to the Firmament Stone and forge the final hammer. Bring it back to me for inspection when you have done so.
english.completion: The Hammer is possibly the most perfect item you have ever forged. With this, you will create armor of such style and taste that you will become a figure of legends. $B$BI'm proud of you, $n. I'm so happy you will finally start to look good.

text.title: 以牙还牙
text.objectives: 消灭7个邪脉叛军。
text.description:
我当然会帮你了！不过老实说，我不知道如今要在哪儿才能找到一个新的奥术护盾发生器。我们的工匠已经有太多被处死了……我会继续想办法的。

那你可以也顺便帮我一下吗？我观察附近的一群邪脉部队已经有一段时间了。他们的活动最近越来越猖獗了。

我想现在应该可以让他们体会一下受到暴力压迫是什么感觉了。
text.completion: Revenge is so sweet. Thank you.

english.title: Retaliation
english.objectives: Kill 7 Felborne Insurgents.
english.description:
Of course I will help you! Although to be honest, I am not certain where a new arcane shield generator can be found these days. So many of our craftspeople have been executed... I will think on it.

Would you mind helping me as well? I have been observing a nearby group of Felborne for some time. Their activities have become increasingly brazen of late.

I think it's time to teach them how it feels to be violently suppressed.
english.completion: Как же сладка месть. Спасибо.

text.title: 阿曼萨加德的信息
text.objectives: 与阿彻鲁斯的阿曼萨加德谈一谈。
text.description:
死亡领主，阿曼萨加德请求与你在阿彻鲁斯会面。

他一直与巫妖王保持着联系，修缮着与冰冠堡垒的关系。

这是为了他自己，还是为了你，我无从得知。
text.completion: Ah, Deathlord, you have returned.$B$BI have inscribed a series of frozen runes above Acherus. Once attuned, you will be able to communicate with the Lich King more... completely.$B$BHe will be able to show you things he could not before.$B$B<Amal'thazad emits a horrible, rasping noise, that you can only assume is a chuckle.>

english.title: Amal'thazad's Message
english.objectives: Speak with Amal'thazad in Acherus.
english.description:

While you are on the Broken Shore, please keep an eye out for strange objects or intelligence that could give us a clue as to what and where these threats are.

text.title: 欺诈者的陨落
text.objectives: 进入萨格拉斯之墓，击败基尔加丹。
text.description:
他曾经就如同我的兄弟一般。后来，他出卖我们的世界，为自己换取力量。他穿越群星，追杀我的人民。他把我儿子变成怪物。

如今，他来到这里，监督军团对艾泽拉斯的最终进攻。他要毁灭这个世界，正如他曾经毁灭无数世界一样。

基尔加丹。

这回我们一定不能让他逃出我们的手心，$n。突破墓穴，击退盘踞的军团，让欺诈者的统治就此终结。
text.completion: When we faced the Deceiver, millennia of rage flooded my heart. Hatred took hold, blinding me to every thought but revenge.$B$BThankfully the Light helped me see that the future must not be defined by vengeance, but by hope. Your courage showed me that as well, $n.$B$BIn those last moments of Kil'jaeden's life, I had to let go of the past. Not only for my own sake, but for the memory of my son.$B$BMy spirit and mind are clear and focused. Now we take the fight to Sargeras himself. Now we end the Legion.

english.title: The Deceiver's Downfall
english.objectives: Enter the Tomb of Sargeras and defeat Kil'jaeden.
english.description:
Once he was as a brother to me. Then he bartered the soul of my world for his own power. Hounded my people across the stars. Twisted my son into a monster.

Now he has come to oversee the final assault on Azeroth. To end this world as he has countless others.

Kil'jaeden.

We must ensure he does not escape our grasp this time, $n. Storm the tomb. Break the Legion's hold. End the Deceiver's reign.

Your courage showed me that as well, $n.$B$BIn those last moments of Kil'jaeden's life, I had to let go of the past. Not only for my own sake, but for the memory of my son.$B$BMy spirit and mind are clear and focused. Now we take the fight to Sargeras himself. Now we end the Legion.

text.title: 递送失落的知识
text.objectives: 与你的职业大厅的神器研究者谈一谈。
text.description:
这本古代暗夜精灵之书生来就是为了寻求知识。它可以成为你研究神器的利器。

我敢打赌，你职业大厅里的学者会发现它的巨大价值，甚至能解锁新的强化途径。

我建议你马上把书带给他们。为了击败燃烧军团，我们需要利用一切可以利用的条件！
text.completion: What have you brought today, Deathlord?$B$B<Illanna examines the ancient tome.>$B$BThis book... it changes everything!

english.title: Delivering Lost Knowledge
english.objectives: Speak with the artifact researcher in your class order hall.
english.description:
The very nature of this ancient night elf tome causes the book to seek out knowledge. This could prove to be a serious boon to your efforts to research your artifact weapon.

I'd wager the scholars in your order hall would find it of great use, possibly unlocking new avenues of empowerment.

I suggest you take it to them immediately. We need every advantage possible against the Legion!
english.completion: What have you brought today, Deathlord?$B$B<Illanna examines the ancient tome.>$B$BThis book... it changes everything!

text.title: 扔到熔炉里……
text.objectives: 把角斗士的破烂斗篷带到达拉然的抑魔金熔炉，并使用熔炉拆解它，然后把得到的东西带给灰牙之地的弗雷泽元帅。
text.description: 这斗篷已经破烂不堪，没法穿戴，但是可以在达拉然的抑魔金熔炉那里拆解掉。
text.progress: Visit the forge recently?
text.completion: If you find any other unwanted spoils of war, obliterate them at the forge and I can help you find something more desirable.

english.title: To the Forge It Goes...
english.objectives: Take the Gladiator's Tattered Cloak to the Obliterum Forge in Dalaran and use the forge to obliterate it, then take the result to Marshal Frazer in Greyfang Enclave.
english.description: This cloak is too tattered to be usable, but can be obliterated at the Obliterum Forge in Dalaran.
english.progress: Visit the forge recently?
english.completion: If you find any other unwanted spoils of war, obliterate them at the forge and I can help you find something more desirable.

objectiveDetails.description: 拆解角斗士的破烂斗篷

text.title: 巨龙的秘密
text.objectives: 在龙骨荒野的龙眠神殿审问特利索尔姆，然后按巫妖王的计划行事。
text.description:
<巫妖王的冰冷气息再度进入了你的脑海。>

阿尔萨斯一直没有找到他想要的宝藏，死亡领主。

它自然是属于我们的。

巨龙们肯定知道他们的亲族的安息之地在哪里。

找一个青铜龙军团的成员问问，他们是历史的维护者。不要手软。

<气息消散了。>
text.completion: < The codex contains information about many of the great red dragons of the past. >$B$B<blank page, you find a note about an ancient red dragon named Kiranastraz who fell in battle with "terrible damage" on an iceberg north of here. >$B$B<Fields marked where this iceberg was last seen. >

english.title: Draconic Secrets
english.objectives: Interrogate Trizormu in Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight, then follow the Lich King's plan.
english.description:
<The Lich King's icy presence enters your mind once more.>

Arthas never found the prize he sought, Deathlord.

It is ours by right.

The dragons must know where the resting place of their kin resides.

Find a member of the bronze flight, the tenders of history. Do not be merciful.

<The presence fades.>
english.completion: < The codex contains information about many of the great red dragons of the past. >$B$B<blank page, you find a note about an ancient red dragon named Kiranastraz who fell in battle with "terrible damage" on an iceberg north of here. >$B$B<Fields marked where this iceberg was last seen. >

text.title: 失落冰川
text.objectives: 前往失落冰川。
text.description:
<巫妖王的气息势不可挡。>

你知道为什么红龙军团想要阻止我们找到我们的宝藏吗？

伟大红龙的遗骨充满了生命的精华，就算是在死后数十年也依然如此。

你要吞噬这种生命精华，令它枯萎，把它转化为亡灵之力。

然后你要令一头巨龙复生。

立刻飞往北方，找到这个冰川，你的命运就在那里。

<气息消失了。>
text.completion: <A crack in the ice beneath the snow, it's very deep. You feel the unholy power surge within you, this would be the ideal location to unleash the energy to raise the dragon.>

english.title: The Lost Glacier
english.objectives: Travel to the Lost Glacier.
english.description:
<The Lich King's presence is overwhelming.>

Do you know why the red dragonflight seeks to prevent us from finding our prize?

The bones of a great red dragon teem with the essence of life, even decades after its passing.

You will consume this life essence, blight it, and turn it to undeath.

And then you will raise a dragon.

Fly now into the north. Find this glacier, and your destiny.

<The presence fades.>
english.completion: < There's a crack in the ice. It's barely visible, but it's deep enough that you can sink your weapon into it and fill the bones with impious energy.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到吉拉纳斯塔兹并复活他

text.title: 玛凯雷，阿古斯的瑰宝
text.objectives: 与维伦一起降落到玛凯雷。
text.description: 我们下方散落的废墟就是玛凯雷的残骸。$b$b我们曾经把这座城市称为“阿古斯的瑰宝”。曾经就在这里，我和三人执政团的其他同仁一起领导我们的人民迈向繁荣，但这是很早以前的事了。$b$b<维伦短暂地陷入了沉默。>$b$b到地表和我见面。我们将开始搜索执政团之冠。
text.completion: It is as if the battle never ceased. How long have they suffered like this?

english.title: Mac'Aree, Jewel of Argus
english.objectives: Descend to Mac'Aree with Velen.
english.description: The shattered ruin below us is all that remains of Mac'Aree.$b$bWe called it the Jewel of Argus. It was here that my fellows in the triumvirate guided our people to prosperity. That was a long time ago.$b$b<Velen lapses into a moment of silence.>$b$bJoin me on the surface. We will begin our search for the Crown of the Triumvirate.
english.completion: Такое ощущение, что битва не прекращалась ни на миг. Сколько же им пришлось так страдать?

text.title: 汇合
text.objectives: 使用信号水晶从维迪卡尔上召下一座光铸道标。
text.description: 在这场梦魇完结之前，我们还有很多事情要做。我们必须在吸引军团更多注意之前重整我们的部队。$B$B我设法在坠毁时保住了一个信号水晶，它原先是用来从泽尼达尔召唤运输道标的。$B$B运气好的话，我们应该能用它来在此地和你的部队之间建立联系。
text.completion: Lothraxion is an old friend, and a noble warrior. We are fortunate to have him among us.

english.title: Rendezvous
english.objectives: Use the Signal Crystal to call down a Lightforged Beacon from the Vindicaar.
english.description: There is much to be done before this nightmare can end, but we need to regroup before we draw more attention from the Legion.$B$BI managed to retain a signal crystal during the crash used to call transport beacons from the Xenedar.$B$BWith luck, we should be able to use it to establish a link between here and your forces as well.
english.completion: Лотраксион – давний друг и благородный воин. Нам очень повезло, что он с нами.

text.title: 无助而害怕
text.objectives: 从执政团之末的敌人身上收集失窃的晶塔核心，用来启动3座古代晶塔。
text.description: 在我等待吉尼达尔时，这场战斗爆发了。很多人跑来投奔我，但基尔加丹鼓动更多人拦住了他们。$b$b我的人民被残酷地屠杀。$b$b为了掩护撤退，我下令激活这个竞技场的防御系统。很显然，防御系统没有奏效。$b$b要想改变这场战斗的形势，让这些灵魂得以安息，我们必须做到之前没有做到的事。想办法启动那些晶塔。
text.completion: The tide is turning. We must press forward.

english.title: Defenseless and Afraid
english.objectives: Collect Stolen Pylon Cores from enemies in Triumvirate's End and use them to activate 3 Ancient Pylons.
english.description: This is the battle that raged while I awaited the Genedar. So many ran to join me, but Kil'jaeden inspired still more to stand in their way.$b$bMy people were slaughtered without mercy.$b$bTo cover our retreat I ordered for this arena's defenses to be activated. It is clear that they were unable.$b$bTo turn the tide in this battle, to give these spirits rest, we must do what they could not. Find a way to activate the pylons.
english.completion: Ситуация меняется на глазах. Мы должны двигаться дальше.
